function typeTitle(el, onDone){
  if(!el) return;
  const text = el.getAttribute("data-text") || "";
  el.textContent = "";

  const cursor = document.createElement("span");
  cursor.className = "why-title-cursor";
  el.appendChild(cursor);

  let i = 0;
  const speed = 38;

  function step(){
    if(i < text.length){
      cursor.insertAdjacentText("beforebegin", text.charAt(i));
      i++;
      setTimeout(step, speed);
    } else {
      setTimeout(() => {
        cursor.remove();
        if(typeof onDone === "function") onDone();
      }, 900);
    }
  }

  step();
}

document.querySelectorAll(".why-title").forEach(titleEl => {

  titleEl.addEventListener("animationend", (e) => {
    if(e.target === titleEl){
      typeTitle(textEl, () => {
        shell?.classList.add("why-cards-ready");
      });
    }
  }, { once:true });
});

            void other.offsetWidth;

            other.style.transitionDelay = `${i * 130}ms`;
            other.classList.add("why-fall-out");

            const rotateDeg = i % 2 === 0 ? "-7deg" : "7deg";

            requestAnimationFrame(()=>{
                other.style.transform = `translateY(150px) rotate(${rotateDeg})`;
                other.style.opacity = "0";
                other.style.filter = "blur(3px)";
            });

        });

        setTimeout(()=>{

            card.classList.remove("why-just-selected");

            const cardRect=card.getBoundingClientRect();
            const shellRect=shell.getBoundingClientRect();

            const cardCenterX=cardRect.left+(cardRect.width/2);
            const cardCenterY=cardRect.top+(cardRect.height/2);

            const shellCenterX=shellRect.left+(shellRect.width/2);
            const shellCenterY=shellRect.top+(shellRect.height/2);

            const moveX=shellCenterX-cardCenterX;

            card.style.zIndex="9999";

            const heroTransform=
                `translate(${moveX}px,${moveY}px)`;

            card.style.setProperty(

                heroTransform

            card.style.transition=
                "transform .85s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)";

            card.style.transform=
                `${heroTransform} scale(1.08)`;

            setTimeout(()=>{

                card.classList.add("why-bounce");

 SayBon Asset Manager

 asset-manager.js

import AssetConfig from "./asset-config.js";
import AssetRegistry from "./asset-registry.js";
import {
    getCriticalAssets,
    getLazyAssets
} from "./page-assets.js";

class SayBonAssetManager {

    constructor(){

        this.loading = false;

        this.queue = [];

        this.completed = 0;

        this.total = 0;

        this.listeners = new Map();

    }

    /* =======================================================
       EVENTS
    ======================================================= */

    on(eventName, callback){

        if(!this.listeners.has(eventName)){

            this.listeners.set(eventName, []);

        }

        this.listeners.get(eventName).push(callback);

    }

    emit(eventName, payload){

        const callbacks = this.listeners.get(eventName);

        if(!callbacks) return;

        callbacks.forEach(cb=>{

            try{

                cb(payload);

            }
            catch(e){

                if(AssetConfig.debug){

                    console.error(e);

                }

            }

        });

    }

    /* =======================================================
       PAGE LOADING
    ======================================================= */

    async loadPage(pageName){

        const critical = getCriticalAssets(pageName);

        const lazy = getLazyAssets(pageName);

        this.total = critical.length;

        this.completed = 0;

        this.loading = true;

        this.emit("loadstart",{

            page:pageName,

            critical,

            lazy

        });

        return {

            page:pageName,

            critical,

            lazy

        };

    }

    /* =======================================================
       QUEUE
    ======================================================= */

    enqueue(asset){

        this.queue.push(asset);

    }

    dequeue(){

        return this.queue.shift();

    }

    clearQueue(){

        this.queue.length = 0;

    }

    getQueueLength(){

        return this.queue.length;

    }

    /* =======================================================
       CACHE HELPERS
    ======================================================= */

    has(asset){

        return AssetRegistry.has(asset);

    }

    get(asset){

        return AssetRegistry.get(asset);

    }

    register(asset,promise){

        return AssetRegistry.register(asset,promise);

    }

    remove(asset){

        AssetRegistry.remove(asset);

    }

    clearCache(){

        AssetRegistry.clear();

    }

    /* =======================================================
       PROGRESS
    ======================================================= */

    progress(){

        return {

            completed:this.completed,

            total:this.total,

            percentage:
                this.total===0
                ? 0
                : Math.round(
                    (this.completed/this.total)*100
                )

        };

    }

    /* =======================================================
       PLACEHOLDERS
       Implemented in later phases
    ======================================================= */

    async preload(){

        throw new Error(
            "Phase C2 required."
        );

    }

    async preloadLazy(){

        throw new Error(
            "Phase C3 required."
        );

    }

    async prefetch(){

        throw new Error(
            "Phase C3 required."
        );

    }

    async decode(){

        throw new Error(
            "Phase C2 required."
        );

    }

}

const AssetManager =
    new SayBonAssetManager();

export default AssetManager;


===== FILE: public\js\core\assets\asset-registry.js (844 bytes) =====
/*
============================================================

 SayBon Asset Manager

 asset-registry.js

 Keeps track of every asset already loaded by the app.

============================================================
*/

class AssetRegistry {

    constructor() {

        this.cache = new Map();

    }

    has(path) {

        return this.cache.has(path);

    }

    get(path) {

        return this.cache.get(path);

    }

    register(path, promise) {

        this.cache.set(path, promise);

        return promise;

    }

    remove(path) {

        this.cache.delete(path);

    }

    clear() {

        this.cache.clear();

    }

    size() {

        return this.cache.size;

    }

    entries() {

        return [...this.cache.entries()];

    }

}

const registry = new AssetRegistry();

export default registry;

function updatePreviewAndList(){
  toggleFields();
  loadAssetsForLesson().then(function(assets){
    currentAssets = assets;
    var sameTypeCount = assets.filter(function(a){ return a.type === typeEl.value && a.part == partEl.value; }).length;

function renderAssetList(assets){
  var list = document.getElementById("adAssetList");
  if(!assets || assets.length === 0){
    list.innerHTML = '<p class="ad-empty">No content added yet for this lesson</p>';
    return;
  }
  list.innerHTML = assets.map(function(a){
    return '<div class="ad-row">' +
      '<div><div class="ad-row-name">' + a.name + '</div><div class="ad-row-type">Part ' + a.part + ' - ' + a.type + '</div></div>' +
      '<div class="ad-row-actions"><button class="ad-edit-btn" data-id="' + a.id + '">Edit</button><button class="ad-delete-btn" data-id="' + a.id + '">Delete</button></div>' +
      '</div>';

  document.querySelectorAll(".ad-delete-btn").forEach(function(btn){
    btn.addEventListener("click", function(){ deleteAsset(btn.getAttribute("data-id")); });

function startEditAsset(id){
  var asset = currentAssets.find(function(a){ return a.id === id; });
  if(!asset) return;

  editingAssetId = id;
  partEl.value = asset.part;
  document.getElementById("adPartTitle").value = asset.partTitle || "Part " + asset.part;
  document.getElementById("adTransitionMode").value = asset.transitionMode || "button";
  typeEl.value = asset.type;
  toggleFields();

  var fileLabel = document.querySelector("#adFileField label");
  fileLabel.textContent = asset.url ? "File (already attached - choose a new one only to replace it)" : "File";
  var imgLabel = document.querySelector("#adTeacherImageField label");
  if(imgLabel){
    imgLabel.textContent = asset.imageUrl ? "Teacher Image (already attached - choose a new one only to replace it)" : "Teacher Image (the file above should be the audio)";
  }

  if(asset.type === "text"){
    document.getElementById("adTextInput").value = asset.content || "";
  }
  if(asset.type === "image" || asset.type === "video"){
    document.getElementById("adSize").value = asset.size || "medium";
  }
  if(asset.recordPrompt){
    document.getElementById("adRecordPrompt").value = asset.recordPrompt || "";
    document.getElementById("adExpectedText").value = asset.expectedText || "";
  }

  document.getElementById("adUploadBtn").textContent = "Save Changes";
  previewName.textContent = "Editing: " + asset.name + " (file optional - only upload to replace)";

  var status = document.getElementById("adUploadStatus");
  status.innerHTML = '<span id="adCancelEdit" style="cursor:pointer;text-decoration:underline;color:#d4af6a;">Cancel edit</span>';
  document.getElementById("adCancelEdit").addEventListener("click", cancelEdit);

  document.getElementById("adPanel").scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth" });
}

function saveEditedAsset(status){
  status.textContent = "Saving changes...";
  status.className = "ad-status";

  var updatePayload = {
    assetId: editingAssetId,
    part: parseInt(partEl.value),
    partTitle: document.getElementById("adPartTitle").value || "Part " + partEl.value,
    transitionMode: document.getElementById("adTransitionMode").value,
    recordPrompt: recordPromptField.style.display !== "none" ? document.getElementById("adRecordPrompt").value : null,
    expectedText: recordPromptField.style.display !== "none" ? document.getElementById("adExpectedText").value : null,
    size: (typeEl.value === "image" || typeEl.value === "video") ? document.getElementById("adSize").value : null
  };

  if(typeEl.value === "text"){
    updatePayload.content = document.getElementById("adTextInput").value;
    finishEditSave(updatePayload, status);
    return;
  }

  var fileInput = document.getElementById("adFileInput");
  var imgInput2 = document.getElementById("adTeacherImageInput");

  function maybeUploadTeacherImage(){
    if(typeEl.value === "teacher-audio" && imgInput2.files[0]){
      var imgFile = imgInput2.files[0];
      var imgRef = ref(storage, "levelAssets/" + levelEl.value + "/edit-img-" + Date.now() + "-" + imgFile.name);
      return uploadBytes(imgRef, imgFile).then(function(snap){ return getDownloadURL(snap.ref); }).then(function(imgUrl){ updatePayload.imageUrl = imgUrl; });
    }
    return Promise.resolve();
  }

  if(fileInput.files[0]){
    var file = fileInput.files[0];
    var storageRef = ref(storage, "levelAssets/" + levelEl.value + "/edit-" + Date.now() + "-" + file.name);
    uploadBytes(storageRef, file).then(function(snapshot){
      return getDownloadURL(snapshot.ref);
    }).then(function(url){
      updatePayload.url = url;
      return maybeUploadTeacherImage();
    }).then(function(){
      finishEditSave(updatePayload, status);
    }).catch(function(err){
      console.error(err);
      status.textContent = "Upload failed: " + (err.message || "check console");
      status.className = "ad-status ad-error";
    });
  } else {
    maybeUploadTeacherImage().then(function(){
      finishEditSave(updatePayload, status);
    }).catch(function(err){
      console.error(err);
      status.textContent = "Upload failed: " + (err.message || "check console");
      status.className = "ad-status ad-error";
    });
  }
}

    editingAssetId = null;

import { auth } from "/js/firebase-init.js";
import { onAuthStateChanged } from "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.0/firebase-auth.js";

function applyUnlocks(maxUnlocked){
  var buttons = document.querySelectorAll(".lesson");
  buttons.forEach(function(btn){
    var numSpan = btn.querySelector(".tp-num");
    if(!numSpan) return;
    var num = parseInt(numSpan.textContent);
    if(num <= maxUnlocked){
      btn.classList.remove("locked");
      btn.classList.add("unlocked");
      var lockIcon = btn.querySelector(".tp-lock");
      if(lockIcon) lockIcon.style.display = "none";
      btn.onclick = function(){ window.location.href = "lesson" + num + ".html"; };
    }
  });
}

var isAdmin = sessionStorage.getItem("saybon_admin_unlocked") === "true";
if(isAdmin){
  applyUnlocks(25);
} else {
  onAuthStateChanged(auth, function(user){
    if(!user){ applyUnlocks(1); return; }
    if(String(user.email||'').toLowerCase()==='saybon.fr@gmail.com'){ applyUnlocks(100); return; }
    fetch(API_BASE + "/api/levelProgress?uid=" + user.uid + "&level=" + LEVEL)
      .then(function(res){ return res.json(); })
      .then(function(data){
        var completed = data.completedLessons || [];
        var maxCompleted = completed.length ? Math.max.apply(null, completed) : 0;
        applyUnlocks(maxCompleted + 1);
      })
      .catch(function(){ applyUnlocks(1); });
  });
}

    const ex = plan.existing[n];
    if (ex.length && !replace) { skipped++; continue; }
    ex.forEach(a => jobs.push({ kind: "del", id: a.id }));
    plan.byLesson[n].forEach(b => jobs.push({ kind: "add", b }));
  }
  const dels = jobs.filter(j => j.kind === "del"), adds = jobs.filter(j => j.kind === "add");
  let done = 0; const total = jobs.length;
  async function run(list, fn) {
    let i = 0;
    await Promise.all([1, 2, 3, 4].map(async () => {
      while (i < list.length) { const j = list[i++]; let ok = false;
        for (let t = 0; t < 3 && !ok; t++) { try { await fn(j); ok = true; } catch (e) { await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 800)); } }
        if (!ok) failed++; done++; document.getElementById("fill").style.width = (done / total * 100) + "%"; }
    }));
  }
  await run(dels, async j => { await api("/api/levelAdminDeleteAsset", { assetId: j.id }); deleted++; });
  log("Old blocks removed: " + deleted);
  await run(adds, async j => { await api("/api/levelAdminAddAsset", j.b); added++; });
  log("DONE. Added " + added + " blocks, removed " + deleted + ", skipped " + skipped + " lessons, failed " + failed + ".");
  if (failed) log("Some blocks failed. Run the import again with 'Replace' ticked.");
};

  style.textContent = ".ls-teacher-audio-img{ max-width: 260px; display: block; margin: 0 auto; border-radius: 16px; } .ls-teacher-tap-overlay{ position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: rgba(20,16,10,.4); border-radius: 16px; cursor: pointer; color: #fff; font-weight: 700; font-size: .9rem; text-align: center; padding: 20px; opacity: 1; transition: opacity .3s ease; } .ls-teacher-tap-overlay.ls-teacher-tap-hidden{ opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; } .ls-teacher-audio-img.ls-teacher-bouncing{ animation: lsTeacherBounce 2.4s cubic-bezier(.45,0,.55,1) infinite; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 26px rgba(255,215,106,.9)) drop-shadow(0 12px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.4)); } @keyframes lsTeacherBounce { 0%,100% { transform: translateY(0); } 50% { transform: translateY(-10px); } }";
  document.head.appendChild(style);
}
async function setupTeacherAudioAnimation(imgId, audioId, btnId){
  injectTeacherAudioStyles();
  var img = document.getElementById(imgId);
  var audioEl = document.getElementById(audioId);
  var playBtn = btnId ? document.getElementById(btnId) : null;
  if(!img || !audioEl) return;
  img.style.opacity = "0";
  img.style.transition = "opacity .5s ease-in";
  if(img.complete){
    img.style.opacity = "1";
  } else {
    img.addEventListener("load", function(){ img.style.opacity = "1"; });
  }
  function showPlayButton(){
    if(playBtn){ playBtn.style.display = "inline-block"; }
  }
  if(playBtn){
    playBtn.addEventListener("click", function(){
      audioEl.play().then(function(){
        playBtn.style.display = "none";
      }).catch(function(err){
        console.error("TEACHER AUDIO MANUAL PLAY FAILED:", err);
      });
    });
  }
  try{
    var audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
    if(audioCtx.state === "suspended"){
      await audioCtx.resume();
    }
    var source = audioCtx.createMediaElementSource(audioEl);
    var analyser = audioCtx.createAnalyser();
    analyser.fftSize = 256;
    source.connect(analyser);
    analyser.connect(audioCtx.destination);
    try{
      await audioEl.play();
      setTimeout(function(){
        if(audioEl.paused){ showPlayButton(); }
      }, 400);
    }catch(playErr){
      console.error("TEACHER AUDIO PLAY BLOCKED:", playErr);
      showPlayButton();
    }
    var dataArray = new Uint8Array(analyser.frequencyBinCount);
    function animate(){
      if(!img.isConnected || !audioEl.isConnected){ return; }
      if(audioEl.paused || audioEl.ended){
        img.style.transform = "scale(1)";
        img.style.filter = "none";
        return;
      }
      analyser.getByteFrequencyData(dataArray);
      var avg = dataArray.reduce(function(a,b){ return a+b; }, 0) / dataArray.length;
      var intensity = Math.min(avg / 80, 1);
      var scale = 1 + (intensity * 0.06);
      var bounce = intensity * 8;
      var glow = 10 + (intensity * 30);
      img.style.transform = "scale(" + scale.toFixed(3) + ") translateY(-" + bounce.toFixed(2) + "px)";
      img.style.filter = "drop-shadow(0 0 " + glow.toFixed(0) + "px rgba(212,175,106," + (0.3 + intensity * 0.5).toFixed(2) + "))";
      requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    }
    audioEl.addEventListener("play", function(){ requestAnimationFrame(animate); });
    audioEl.addEventListener("playing", function(){ requestAnimationFrame(animate); });
    animate();
  }catch(err){
    console.error("TEACHER AUDIO ANIMATION ERROR:", err);
  }
}
function renderBlock(block){
  var sizeClass = block.size ? "ls-size-" + block.size : "ls-size-large";
  if(block.type === "text") return '<div class="ls-block ls-block-text">' + block.content + '</div>';
  if(block.type === "image") return '<div class="ls-block ' + sizeClass + '"><img src="' + block.url + '"></div>';
  if(block.type === "audio") return '<div class="ls-block"><audio controls controlsList="nodownload" oncontextmenu="return false;" src="' + block.url + '"></audio></div>';
  if(block.type === "video") return '<div class="ls-block ' + sizeClass + '"><video controls controlsList="nodownload" oncontextmenu="return false;" src="' + block.url + '"></video></div>';
  if(block.type === "teacher-audio"){
    injectTeacherAudioStyles();
    return '<div class="ls-block" style="text-align:center;">' +
      '<div style="position:relative;display:inline-block;min-width:220px;min-height:280px;">' +
      '<img class="ls-teacher-audio-img" src="' + block.imageUrl + '">' +
      '<div class="ls-teacher-tap-overlay ls-teacher-tap-hidden">Tap to hear the teacher</div>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<audio class="ls-teacher-audio-el" controlsList="nodownload" oncontextmenu="return false;" style="display:none;" autoplay src="' + block.url + '"></audio>' +
      '</div>';
  }
  return "";
}

function getPartAssets(partNum){
  return allAssets.filter(function(a){ return a.part === partNum; });
}
function getMaxPart(){ var max = 1; allAssets.forEach(function(a){ if(a.part > max) max = a.part; }); return max; }
function getPartLabel(partNum){ var match = allAssets.find(function(a){ return a.part === partNum; }); return (match && match.partTitle) ? ("Part " + partNum + " - " + match.partTitle) : ("Part " + partNum); }
function getPartTransitionMode(partNum){ var match = allAssets.find(function(a){ return a.part === partNum; }); return (match && match.transitionMode) ? match.transitionMode : "button"; }
window.lsGoToPart1 = function(){ recordedBlob = null; currentPart = 1; renderPart(1, getPartLabel(1)); };

function renderPart(partNum, label){if(window.psRender&&window.psRender(partNum,getPartAssets(partNum),{root:root,api:API_BASE})){return;}
  var blocks = getPartAssets(partNum);
  var promptBlock = blocks.find(function(b){ return b.recordPrompt; });
  var needsRecording = !!promptBlock;
  var transitionMode = getPartTransitionMode(partNum);

  var blocksHtml = blocks.map(renderBlock).join("");

  var recordSection = "";
  if(needsRecording){
    var promptText = promptBlock ? promptBlock.recordPrompt : "Record your answer";
    recordSection =
      '<div class="ls-prompt-bubble">' + promptText + '</div>' +
      '<canvas id="lsWaveCanvas" class="ls-wave-canvas" width="280" height="56" style="display:none;"></canvas>' +
      '<div class="ls-record-row">' +
      '<button class="ls-record-btn" id="lsRecordBtn">● Record</button>' +
      '<span class="ls-record-status" id="lsRecordStatus">' + (recordedBlob ? "Recorded" : "Not recorded yet") + '</span>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div class="ls-playback-row" id="lsPlaybackRow" style="display:none;">' +
      '<button class="ls-btn ls-btn-secondary" id="lsPlayBtn">&#9658; Play My Recording</button>' +
      '<button class="ls-btn ls-btn-secondary" id="lsRerecordBtn">&#8635; Re-record</button>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<audio id="lsPlaybackAudio" controlsList="nodownload" style="display:none;"></audio>' +
      '<div id="lsScoreDisplay"></div>' +
      '<div class="ls-btn-row"><button class="ls-btn ls-btn-primary" id="lsSubmitBtn" disabled>Submit</button></div>';
  }

  var continueBtn = (needsRecording || transitionMode === "auto") ? "" :
    '<div class="ls-btn-row"><button class="ls-btn ls-btn-primary" onclick="window.lsGoNext()">Continue</button></div>';

  var back1Btn = partNum > 1 ?
    '<div style="text-align:center;margin-top:10px;"><button class="ls-btn ls-btn-secondary" onclick="window.lsGoToPart1()">&#8634; Back to Part 1</button></div>' : '';

  render(
    '<p class="ls-part-label">' + label + '</p>' +
    '<div class="ls-card">' + blocksHtml + recordSection + '</div>' +
    continueBtn + back1Btn
  );

  root.querySelectorAll(".ls-teacher-audio-el").forEach(function(audioEl){
    setTimeout(function(){
      if(audioEl.paused){
        var wrapper = audioEl.previousElementSibling;
        var overlay = wrapper ? wrapper.querySelector(".ls-teacher-tap-overlay") : null;
        if(overlay){ overlay.classList.remove("ls-teacher-tap-hidden"); }
      }
    }, 500);
  });

  if(!needsRecording && transitionMode === "auto"){
    var autoMedia = root.querySelector("video, audio");
    if(autoMedia){
      autoMedia.addEventListener("ended", function(){ window.lsGoNext(); });
    } else {
      setTimeout(function(){ window.lsGoNext(); }, 2500);
    }
  }

  if(needsRecording){
    document.getElementById("lsRecordBtn").addEventListener("click", toggleRecording);
    document.getElementById("lsPlayBtn").addEventListener("click", playRecording);
    document.getElementById("lsRerecordBtn").addEventListener("click", reRecord);
    var expectedText = promptBlock ? promptBlock.expectedText : "";
    document.getElementById("lsSubmitBtn").addEventListener("click", function(){ submitRecording(expectedText, partNum); });
  }
}

function startWave(streamOrElement, isElement){
  var canvas = document.getElementById("lsWaveCanvas");
  var ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  canvas.style.display = "block";
  if(!lsAudioCtx){
    lsAudioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
  }
  var analyser = lsAudioCtx.createAnalyser();
  analyser.fftSize = 64;

  if(isElement){
    if(!streamOrElement._lsWaveSource){
      streamOrElement._lsWaveSource = lsAudioCtx.createMediaElementSource(streamOrElement);
      streamOrElement._lsWaveSource.connect(lsAudioCtx.destination);
    }
    streamOrElement._lsWaveSource.connect(analyser);
  } else {
    var source = lsAudioCtx.createMediaStreamSource(streamOrElement);
    source.connect(analyser);
  }

  var bufferLength = analyser.frequencyBinCount;
  var dataArray = new Uint8Array(bufferLength);

  function draw(){
    lsWaveAnimId = requestAnimationFrame(draw);
    analyser.getByteFrequencyData(dataArray);
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    var barWidth = (canvas.width / bufferLength) * 1.8;
    var x = 0;
    for(var i = 0; i < bufferLength; i++){
      var barHeight = (dataArray[i] / 255) * canvas.height;
      ctx.fillStyle = "#d4af6a";
      ctx.fillRect(x, canvas.height - barHeight, barWidth, barHeight);
      x += barWidth + 2;
    }
  }
  draw();
}

function stopWave(){
  if(lsWaveAnimId){
    cancelAnimationFrame(lsWaveAnimId);
    lsWaveAnimId = null;
  }
  var canvas = document.getElementById("lsWaveCanvas");
  if(canvas){
    canvas.getContext("2d").clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    canvas.style.display = "none";
  }
}

function toggleRecording(){
  var btn = document.getElementById("lsRecordBtn");
  var status = document.getElementById("lsRecordStatus");

  if(!mediaRecorder || mediaRecorder.state === "inactive"){
    navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true }).then(function(stream){
      currentStream = stream;
      recordedChunks = [];
      mediaRecorder = new MediaRecorder(stream);
      mediaRecorder.ondataavailable = function(e){ recordedChunks.push(e.data); };
      mediaRecorder.onstop = function(){ if(window.resumeAppBgMusicAfterRecording){ window.resumeAppBgMusicAfterRecording(); }
        recordedBlob = new Blob(recordedChunks, { type: "audio/webm" });
        stopWave();
        document.getElementById("lsRecordBtn").style.display = "none";
        document.getElementById("lsPlaybackRow").style.display = "flex";
        document.getElementById("lsSubmitBtn").disabled = false;
        currentStream.getTracks().forEach(function(t){ t.stop(); });
      };
      if(window.pauseAppBgMusicForRecording){ window.pauseAppBgMusicForRecording(); } mediaRecorder.start();
      startWave(stream, false);
      btn.textContent = "■ Stop";
      btn.classList.add("ls-recording");
      status.textContent = "Recording...";
    }).catch(function(err){
      status.textContent = "Microphone access denied";
      console.error(err);
    });
  } else {
    mediaRecorder.stop();
  }
}

function playRecording(){
  var playBtn = document.getElementById("lsPlayBtn");
  var audioEl = document.getElementById("lsPlaybackAudio");
  var originalLabel = playBtn.innerHTML;
  playBtn.innerHTML = '<span class="ls-loading-pulse"></span>Loading...';
  playBtn.disabled = true;

  audioEl.src = URL.createObjectURL(recordedBlob);

  var onReady = function(){
    playBtn.innerHTML = originalLabel;
    playBtn.disabled = false;
    startWave(audioEl, true);
    audioEl.currentTime = 0;
    audioEl.play();
  };

  audioEl.addEventListener("canplay", onReady, { once: true });
  audioEl.addEventListener("ended", stopWave, { once: true });
}

function reRecord(){
  recordedBlob = null;
  document.getElementById("lsPlaybackRow").style.display = "none";
  var btn = document.getElementById("lsRecordBtn");
  btn.style.display = "inline-block";
  btn.textContent = "● Record";
  btn.classList.remove("ls-recording");
  document.getElementById("lsRecordStatus").textContent = "Not recorded yet";
  document.getElementById("lsSubmitBtn").disabled = true;
  document.getElementById("lsScoreDisplay").innerHTML = "";
}

function submitRecording(expectedText, partNum){
  var scoreDisplay = document.getElementById("lsScoreDisplay");
  scoreDisplay.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:rgba(255,255,255,.7);">Scoring...</p>';

  fetch(API_BASE + "/api/assessPronunciation?referenceText=" + encodeURIComponent(expectedText || ""), {
    method: "POST",
    body: recordedBlob
  }).then(function(res){ return res.json(); }).then(function(data){
    var score = data.finalScore ?? data.score ?? data.AccuracyScore ?? data.accuracyScore ?? 0;
    score = Math.round(score);
    scoreDisplay.innerHTML =
      '<div class="ls-score">' + score + '%</div>' +
      '<div class="ls-btn-row">' +
      '<button class="ls-btn ls-btn-secondary" onclick="window.lsRetryRecording()">Try Again</button>' +
      '<button class="ls-btn ls-btn-primary" onclick="window.lsGoNext()">Continue</button>' +
      '</div>';
  }).catch(function(err){
    console.error(err);
    scoreDisplay.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:#ff8a8a;">Could not score - please try again.</p>' +
      '<div class="ls-btn-row"><button class="ls-btn ls-btn-secondary" onclick="window.lsRetryRecording()">Try Again</button></div>';
  });
}

window.lsRetryRecording = function(){
  recordedBlob = null;
  renderPart(currentPart, getPartLabel(currentPart));
};

window.lsGoNext = function(){
  recordedBlob = null;
  var nextPart = currentPart + 1;
  if(getPartAssets(nextPart).length > 0){
    currentPart = nextPart;
    renderPart(nextPart, getPartLabel(nextPart));
  }
  else {
    markLessonComplete();
    render(
      '<div class="ls-card" style="text-align:center;">' +
      '<p class="ls-part-label">Lesson Complete</p>' +
      '<p style="color:#fff;font-size:1.1rem;margin-bottom:20px;">Well done.</p>' +
      '<button class="ls-btn ls-btn-primary" onclick="window.location.href=\'./\'">Back to Lessons</button>' +
      '</div>'
    );
  }
};

function markLessonComplete(){
  var uid = window.lsCurrentUid;
  if(!uid) return;
  fetch(API_BASE + "/api/levelProgressComplete", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify({ uid: uid, level: LEVEL, lesson: LESSON })
  }).catch(function(err){ console.error("Could not save progress:", err); });
}

fetch(API_BASE + "/api/levelAssets?level=" + LEVEL + "&lesson=" + LESSON)
  .then(function(res){ return res.json(); })
  .then(function(assets){
    allAssets = assets || [];
    if(allAssets.length === 0){
      render('<div class="ls-card" style="text-align:center;"><p style="color:#fff;">This lesson\'s content hasn\'t been added yet.</p></div>');
      return;
    }
    renderPart(1, getPartLabel(1));
  })
  .catch(function(err){
    console.error(err);
    render('<div class="ls-card" style="text-align:center;"><p style="color:#ff8a8a;">Could not load this lesson.</p></div>');
  });

<script>

const API_BASE = "https://saybonapp-server.onrender.com";

async function convertToWav(blob){

  const arrayBuffer = await blob.arrayBuffer();
  const audioContext = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();

  let audioBuffer;
  try{
    audioBuffer = await audioContext.decodeAudioData(arrayBuffer);
  } finally {
    // Always release this AudioContext, whether decoding
    // succeeded or failed. Leaving these open across repeated
    // recordings in the same session can degrade or silently
    // break later attempts once the browser's context limit
    // is approached.
    audioContext.close();
  }

  const targetSampleRate = 16000;
  const offlineContext = new OfflineAudioContext(1, Math.ceil(audioBuffer.duration * targetSampleRate), targetSampleRate);
  const source = offlineContext.createBufferSource();
  source.buffer = audioBuffer;
  source.connect(offlineContext.destination);
  source.start();
  const renderedBuffer = await offlineContext.startRendering();

  const pcmData = renderedBuffer.getChannelData(0);

  return encodeWav(pcmData, targetSampleRate);

}

function encodeWav(samples, sampleRate){

  const buffer = new ArrayBuffer(44 + samples.length * 2);
  const view = new DataView(buffer);

  function writeString(offset, string){
    for(let i = 0; i < string.length; i++){
      view.setUint8(offset + i, string.charCodeAt(i));
    }
  }

  writeString(0, "RIFF");
  view.setUint32(4, 36 + samples.length * 2, true);
  writeString(8, "WAVE");
  writeString(12, "fmt ");
  view.setUint32(16, 16, true);
  view.setUint16(20, 1, true);
  view.setUint16(22, 1, true);
  view.setUint32(24, sampleRate, true);
  view.setUint32(28, sampleRate * 2, true);
  view.setUint16(32, 2, true);
  view.setUint16(34, 16, true);
  writeString(36, "data");
  view.setUint32(40, samples.length * 2, true);

  let offset = 44;
  for(let i = 0; i < samples.length; i++, offset += 2){
    const s = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, samples[i]));
    view.setInt16(offset, s < 0 ? s * 0x8000 : s * 0x7FFF, true);
  }

  return new Blob([view], { type: "audio/wav" });

}

const activities = [
  { prompt: "Bonjour, comment allez-vous ?", displayPrompt: "« Bonjour, comment allez-vous ? »" },
  { prompt: "Je m'appelle Marie et j'habite à  Paris.", displayPrompt: "« Je m'appelle Marie et j'habite à  Paris. »" }
];

let activityIndex = 0;
let mediaRecorder = null;
let recordedChunks = [];
let isRecording = false;
let pendingBlob = null;

const micBtn = document.getElementById("micBtn");
const micStatus = document.getElementById("micStatus");
const feedbackBox = document.getElementById("feedbackBox");
const errorBox = document.getElementById("errorBox");
const recordAgainBtn = document.getElementById("recordAgainBtn");
const nextBtn = document.getElementById("nextBtn");

function loadActivity(i){
  const a = activities[i];
  document.getElementById("stepLabel").innerText = "Activity " + (i + 1) + " of " + activities.length;
  document.getElementById("promptText").innerText = a.displayPrompt;
  feedbackBox.style.display = "none";
  errorBox.style.display = "none";
  recordAgainBtn.style.display = "none";
  nextBtn.style.display = "none";
  micBtn.style.display = "inline-flex";
  micStatus.innerText = "Tap to record";
}

micBtn.addEventListener("click", async () => {

  if(isRecording){
    mediaRecorder.stop(); if(window.resumeAppBgMusicAfterRecording){ window.resumeAppBgMusicAfterRecording(); }
    return;
  }

  try{

    const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true });
    mediaRecorder = new MediaRecorder(stream);
    recordedChunks = [];

    const livePassthrough = document.createElement("audio");
    livePassthrough.srcObject = stream;
    livePassthrough.autoplay = true;
    livePassthrough.id = "livePassthroughAudio";
    document.body.appendChild(livePassthrough);

    const meterCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();

    if(meterCtx.state === "suspended"){
      await meterCtx.resume();
    }

    const meterSource = meterCtx.createMediaStreamSource(stream);
    const analyser = meterCtx.createAnalyser();
    analyser.fftSize = 256;
    meterSource.connect(analyser);
    const meterData = new Uint8Array(analyser.frequencyBinCount);
    let peakLevel = 0;

    document.getElementById("debugBox").value = "AudioContext state at start: " + meterCtx.state + "\n\nAudio track settings:\n" + JSON.stringify(stream.getAudioTracks()[0].getSettings(), null, 2) + "\n\nTrack enabled: " + stream.getAudioTracks()[0].enabled + "\nTrack muted: " + stream.getAudioTracks()[0].muted + "\nTrack readyState: " + stream.getAudioTracks()[0].readyState;

    function updateMeter(){
      if(!isRecording) return;

      analyser.getByteTimeDomainData(meterData);

      let sumSquares = 0;
      for(let i = 0; i < meterData.length; i++){
        const normalized = (meterData[i] - 128) / 128;
        sumSquares += normalized * normalized;
      }
      const rms = Math.sqrt(sumSquares / meterData.length);
      const pct = Math.min(100, Math.round(rms * 400));

      peakLevel = Math.max(peakLevel, pct);
      document.getElementById("levelMeter").style.width = pct + "%";
      document.getElementById("levelMeterLabel").innerText = "Raw level: " + pct + "% (RMS: " + rms.toFixed(4) + ")";
      requestAnimationFrame(updateMeter);
    }

    mediaRecorder.ondataavailable = (e) => {
      if(e.data.size > 0) recordedChunks.push(e.data);
    };

    mediaRecorder.onstop = () => {
      stream.getTracks().forEach(t => t.stop());
      meterCtx.close();
      pendingBlob = new Blob(recordedChunks, { type: "audio/webm" });

      const url = URL.createObjectURL(pendingBlob);
      document.getElementById("reviewPlayer").src = url;

      micBtn.style.display = "none";
      micStatus.innerText = "";
      document.getElementById("levelMeterLabel").innerText = peakLevel > 3
        ? "Peak level detected: " + peakLevel + "% - the mic was receiving sound"
        : "No real sound was detected during this recording - check your microphone";
      document.getElementById("reviewWrap").style.display = "block";
    };

    if(window.pauseAppBgMusicForRecording){ window.pauseAppBgMusicForRecording(); } mediaRecorder.start();
    isRecording = true;
    micBtn.classList.add("recording");
    micStatus.innerText = "Recording... tap to stop";
    peakLevel = 0;
    updateMeter();

  }catch(err){
    errorBox.style.display = "block";
    errorBox.innerText = "Could not access your microphone. Please allow microphone permission and try again.";
  }

});

async function submitRecording(blob){

  isRecording = false;
  micBtn.classList.remove("recording");
  micStatus.innerText = "Processing your recording...";
  micBtn.disabled = true;
  errorBox.style.display = "none";

  const referenceText = activities[activityIndex].prompt;

  try{

    const res = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/assessPronunciation?referenceText=" + encodeURIComponent(referenceText) + "&_cb=" + Date.now(), {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "audio/wav" },
      body: blob,
      cache: "no-store"
    });

    const data = await res.json();

    document.getElementById("debugBox").value = JSON.stringify(data, null, 2);

    micBtn.disabled = false;
    micBtn.style.display = "none";
    micStatus.innerText = "";

    if(!res.ok){
      errorBox.style.display = "block";
      errorBox.innerText = data.error || "Could not assess your recording. Please try again.";
      recordAgainBtn.style.display = "block";
      return;
    }

    document.getElementById("scoreValue").innerText = data.finalScore;
    document.getElementById("accuracyNum").innerText = Math.round(data.accuracyScore);
    document.getElementById("fluencyNum").innerText = Math.round(data.fluencyScore);
    document.getElementById("completenessNum").innerText = Math.round(data.completenessScore);
    document.getElementById("recognizedText").innerText = data.recognizedText || "(nothing recognized)";

    const wordList = document.getElementById("wordList");
    wordList.innerHTML = "";
    (data.words || []).forEach(w => {
      const chip = document.createElement("span");
      const isGood = !w.errorType || w.errorType === "None";
      chip.className = "word-chip " + (isGood ? "word-good" : "word-bad");
      chip.innerText = w.word + (isGood ? "" : " (" + w.errorType + ")");
      wordList.appendChild(chip);
    });

    feedbackBox.style.display = "block";
    recordAgainBtn.style.display = "block";

    if(activityIndex < activities.length - 1){
      nextBtn.style.display = "block";
    }

  }catch(err){
    micBtn.disabled = false;
    micBtn.style.display = "none";
    micStatus.innerText = "";
    errorBox.style.display = "block";
    errorBox.innerText = "Could not reach the server. Please try again.";
    recordAgainBtn.style.display = "block";
  }

}

document.getElementById("useRecordingBtn").addEventListener("click", async () => {

  document.getElementById("reviewWrap").style.display = "none";
  micStatus.innerText = "Processing your recording...";

  try{
    const wavBlob = await convertToWav(pendingBlob);
    submitRecording(wavBlob);
  }catch(err){
    errorBox.style.display = "block";
    errorBox.innerText = "Could not process the recording. Please try again.";
    micBtn.style.display = "inline-flex";
    micStatus.innerText = "Tap to record";
  }

});

document.getElementById("reRecordBtn").addEventListener("click", () => {
  document.getElementById("reviewWrap").style.display = "none";
  micBtn.style.display = "inline-flex";
  micStatus.innerText = "Tap to record";
  pendingBlob = null;
});

recordAgainBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
  feedbackBox.style.display = "none";
  errorBox.style.display = "none";
  recordAgainBtn.style.display = "none";
  nextBtn.style.display = "none";
  micBtn.style.display = "inline-flex";
  micStatus.innerText = "Tap to record";
});

nextBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
  activityIndex++;
  loadActivity(activityIndex);
});

loadActivity(0);

</script>

<script type="module">
const API_BASE = "https://saybonapp-server.onrender.com";
const LEVEL = "a0-les-petits";

import { auth } from "/js/firebase-init.js";
import { onAuthStateChanged } from "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.0/firebase-auth.js";

function applyUnlocks(maxUnlocked){
  var buttons = document.querySelectorAll(".lesson");
  buttons.forEach(function(btn){
    var numSpan = btn.querySelector(".lp-num");
    if(!numSpan) return;
    var num = parseInt(numSpan.textContent);
    if(num <= maxUnlocked){
      btn.classList.remove("locked");
      btn.classList.add("unlocked");
      var lockIcon = btn.querySelector(".lp-lock");
      if(lockIcon) lockIcon.style.display = "none";
      btn.onclick = function(){ window.location.href = "lesson" + num + ".html"; };
    }
  });
}

var isAdmin = sessionStorage.getItem("saybon_admin_unlocked") === "true";
if(isAdmin){
  applyUnlocks(25);
} else {
  onAuthStateChanged(auth, function(user){
    if(!user){ applyUnlocks(1); return; }
    if(String(user.email||'').toLowerCase()==='saybon.fr@gmail.com'){ applyUnlocks(100); return; }
    fetch(API_BASE + "/api/levelProgress?uid=" + user.uid + "&level=" + LEVEL)
      .then(function(res){ return res.json(); })
      .then(function(data){
        var completed = data.completedLessons || [];
        var maxCompleted = completed.length ? Math.max.apply(null, completed) : 0;
        applyUnlocks(maxCompleted + 1);
      })
      .catch(function(){ applyUnlocks(1); });
  });
}
</script>

async function setupTeacherAudioAnimation(imgId, audioId, btnId){
  injectTeacherAudioStyles();
  var img = document.getElementById(imgId);
  var audioEl = document.getElementById(audioId);
  var playBtn = btnId ? document.getElementById(btnId) : null;
  if(!img || !audioEl) return;
  img.style.opacity = "0";
  img.style.transition = "opacity .5s ease-in";
  if(img.complete){
    img.style.opacity = "1";
  } else {
    img.addEventListener("load", function(){ img.style.opacity = "1"; });
  }
  function showPlayButton(){
    if(playBtn){ playBtn.style.display = "inline-block"; }
  }
  if(playBtn){
    playBtn.addEventListener("click", function(){
      audioEl.play().then(function(){
        playBtn.style.display = "none";
      }).catch(function(err){
        console.error("TEACHER AUDIO MANUAL PLAY FAILED:", err);
      });
    });
  }
  try{
    var audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
    if(audioCtx.state === "suspended"){
      await audioCtx.resume();
    }
    var source = audioCtx.createMediaElementSource(audioEl);
    var analyser = audioCtx.createAnalyser();
    analyser.fftSize = 256;
    source.connect(analyser);
    analyser.connect(audioCtx.destination);
    try{
      await audioEl.play();
      setTimeout(function(){
        if(audioEl.paused){ showPlayButton(); }
      }, 400);
    }catch(playErr){
      console.error("TEACHER AUDIO PLAY BLOCKED:", playErr);
      showPlayButton();
    }
    var dataArray = new Uint8Array(analyser.frequencyBinCount);
    function animate(){
      if(!img.isConnected || !audioEl.isConnected){ return; }
      if(audioEl.paused || audioEl.ended){
        img.style.transform = "scale(1)";
        img.style.filter = "none";
        return;
      }
      analyser.getByteFrequencyData(dataArray);
      var avg = dataArray.reduce(function(a,b){ return a+b; }, 0) / dataArray.length;
      var intensity = Math.min(avg / 80, 1);
      var scale = 1 + (intensity * 0.06);
      var bounce = intensity * 8;
      var glow = 10 + (intensity * 30);
      img.style.transform = "scale(" + scale.toFixed(3) + ") translateY(-" + bounce.toFixed(2) + "px)";
      img.style.filter = "drop-shadow(0 0 " + glow.toFixed(0) + "px rgba(212,175,106," + (0.3 + intensity * 0.5).toFixed(2) + "))";
      requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    }
    audioEl.addEventListener("play", function(){ requestAnimationFrame(animate); });
    audioEl.addEventListener("playing", function(){ requestAnimationFrame(animate); });
    animate();
  }catch(err){
    console.error("TEACHER AUDIO ANIMATION ERROR:", err);
  }
}

  }

  if(needsRecording){
    document.getElementById("lsRecordBtn").addEventListener("click", toggleRecording);
    document.getElementById("lsPlayBtn").addEventListener("click", playRecording);
    document.getElementById("lsRerecordBtn").addEventListener("click", reRecord);
    var expectedText = promptBlock ? promptBlock.expectedText : "";
    document.getElementById("lsSubmitBtn").addEventListener("click", function(){ submitRecording(expectedText, partNum); });
  }
}

function startWave(streamOrElement, isElement){
  var canvas = document.getElementById("lsWaveCanvas");
  var ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  canvas.style.display = "block";
  if(!lsAudioCtx){
    lsAudioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
  }
  var analyser = lsAudioCtx.createAnalyser();
  analyser.fftSize = 64;

  if(isElement){
    if(!streamOrElement._lsWaveSource){
      streamOrElement._lsWaveSource = lsAudioCtx.createMediaElementSource(streamOrElement);
      streamOrElement._lsWaveSource.connect(lsAudioCtx.destination);
    }
    streamOrElement._lsWaveSource.connect(analyser);
  } else {
    var source = lsAudioCtx.createMediaStreamSource(streamOrElement);
    source.connect(analyser);
  }

  var bufferLength = analyser.frequencyBinCount;
  var dataArray = new Uint8Array(bufferLength);

  function draw(){
    lsWaveAnimId = requestAnimationFrame(draw);
    analyser.getByteFrequencyData(dataArray);
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    var barWidth = (canvas.width / bufferLength) * 1.8;
    var x = 0;
    for(var i = 0; i < bufferLength; i++){
      var barHeight = (dataArray[i] / 255) * canvas.height;
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd93d";
      ctx.fillRect(x, canvas.height - barHeight, barWidth, barHeight);
      x += barWidth + 2;
    }
  }
  draw();
}

function stopWave(){
  if(lsWaveAnimId){
    cancelAnimationFrame(lsWaveAnimId);
    lsWaveAnimId = null;
  }
  var canvas = document.getElementById("lsWaveCanvas");
  if(canvas){
    canvas.getContext("2d").clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    canvas.style.display = "none";
  }
}

function toggleRecording(){
  var btn = document.getElementById("lsRecordBtn");
  var status = document.getElementById("lsRecordStatus");

  if(!mediaRecorder || mediaRecorder.state === "inactive"){
    navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true }).then(function(stream){
      currentStream = stream;
      recordedChunks = [];
      mediaRecorder = new MediaRecorder(stream);
      mediaRecorder.ondataavailable = function(e){ recordedChunks.push(e.data); };
      mediaRecorder.onstop = function(){ if(window.resumeAppBgMusicAfterRecording){ window.resumeAppBgMusicAfterRecording(); }
        recordedBlob = new Blob(recordedChunks, { type: "audio/webm" });
        stopWave();
        document.getElementById("lsRecordBtn").style.display = "none";
        document.getElementById("lsPlaybackRow").style.display = "flex";
        document.getElementById("lsSubmitBtn").disabled = false;
        currentStream.getTracks().forEach(function(t){ t.stop(); });
      };
      if(window.pauseAppBgMusicForRecording){ window.pauseAppBgMusicForRecording(); } mediaRecorder.start();
      startWave(stream, false);
      btn.textContent = "■ Stop";
      btn.classList.add("ls-recording");
      status.textContent = "Recording...";
    }).catch(function(err){
      status.textContent = "Microphone access denied";
      console.error(err);
    });
  } else {
    mediaRecorder.stop();
  }
}

function playRecording(){
  var playBtn = document.getElementById("lsPlayBtn");
  var audioEl = document.getElementById("lsPlaybackAudio");
  var originalLabel = playBtn.innerHTML;
  playBtn.innerHTML = '<span class="ls-loading-pulse"></span>Loading...';
  playBtn.disabled = true;

  audioEl.src = URL.createObjectURL(recordedBlob);

  var onReady = function(){
    playBtn.innerHTML = originalLabel;
    playBtn.disabled = false;
    startWave(audioEl, true);
    audioEl.currentTime = 0;
    audioEl.play();
  };

  audioEl.addEventListener("canplay", onReady, { once: true });
  audioEl.addEventListener("ended", stopWave, { once: true });
}

function reRecord(){
  recordedBlob = null;
  document.getElementById("lsPlaybackRow").style.display = "none";
  var btn = document.getElementById("lsRecordBtn");
  btn.style.display = "inline-block";
  btn.textContent = "● Record";
  btn.classList.remove("ls-recording");
  document.getElementById("lsRecordStatus").textContent = "Not recorded yet";
  document.getElementById("lsSubmitBtn").disabled = true;
  document.getElementById("lsScoreDisplay").innerHTML = "";
}

function submitRecording(expectedText, partNum){
  var scoreDisplay = document.getElementById("lsScoreDisplay");
  scoreDisplay.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:rgba(255,255,255,.7);">Scoring...</p>';

  fetch(API_BASE + "/api/assessPronunciation?referenceText=" + encodeURIComponent(expectedText || ""), {
    method: "POST",
    body: recordedBlob
  }).then(function(res){ return res.json(); }).then(function(data){
    var score = data.finalScore ?? data.score ?? data.AccuracyScore ?? data.accuracyScore ?? 0;
    score = Math.round(score);
    scoreDisplay.innerHTML =
      '<div class="ls-score">' + score + '%</div>' +
      '<div class="ls-btn-row">' +
      '<button class="ls-btn ls-btn-secondary" onclick="window.lsRetryRecording()">Try Again</button>' +
      '<button class="ls-btn ls-btn-primary" onclick="window.lsGoNext()">Continue</button>' +
      '</div>';
  }).catch(function(err){
    console.error(err);
    scoreDisplay.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:#ff8a8a;">Could not score - please try again.</p>' +
      '<div class="ls-btn-row"><button class="ls-btn ls-btn-secondary" onclick="window.lsRetryRecording()">Try Again</button></div>';
  });
}

window.lsRetryRecording = function(){
  recordedBlob = null;
  renderPart(currentPart, getPartLabel(currentPart));
};

window.lsGoNext = function(){
  recordedBlob = null;
  var nextPart = currentPart + 1;
  if(getPartAssets(nextPart).length > 0){
    currentPart = nextPart;
    renderPart(nextPart, getPartLabel(nextPart));
  }
  else {
    markLessonComplete();
    render(
      '<div class="ls-card" style="text-align:center;">' +
      '<p class="ls-part-label">Lesson Complete!</p>' +
      '<p style="color:#fff;font-size:1.1rem;margin-bottom:20px;">You did it! 🎉</p>' +
      '<button class="ls-btn ls-btn-primary" onclick="window.location.href=\'./\'">Back to Lessons</button>' +
      '</div>'
    );
  }
};

function markLessonComplete(){
  try{ if(window.SayBonActivity) window.SayBonActivity.complete("lesson_complete"); }catch(e){}
  var uid = window.lsCurrentUid;
  if(!uid) return;
  fetch(API_BASE + "/api/levelProgressComplete", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify({ uid: uid, level: LEVEL, lesson: LESSON })
  }).catch(function(err){ console.error("Could not save progress:", err); });
}

  .then(function(res){ return res.json(); })
  .then(function(assets){
    allAssets = assets || [];

async function setupTeacherAudioAnimation(imgId, audioId, btnId){
  injectTeacherAudioStyles();
  var img = document.getElementById(imgId);
  var audioEl = document.getElementById(audioId);
  var playBtn = btnId ? document.getElementById(btnId) : null;
  if(!img || !audioEl) return;
  img.style.opacity = "0";
  img.style.transition = "opacity .5s ease-in";
  if(img.complete){
    img.style.opacity = "1";
  } else {
    img.addEventListener("load", function(){ img.style.opacity = "1"; });
  }
  function showPlayButton(){
    if(playBtn){ playBtn.style.display = "inline-block"; }
  }
  if(playBtn){
    playBtn.addEventListener("click", function(){
      audioEl.play().then(function(){
        playBtn.style.display = "none";
      }).catch(function(err){
        console.error("TEACHER AUDIO MANUAL PLAY FAILED:", err);
      });
    });
  }
  try{
    var audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
    if(audioCtx.state === "suspended"){
      await audioCtx.resume();
    }
    var source = audioCtx.createMediaElementSource(audioEl);
    var analyser = audioCtx.createAnalyser();
    analyser.fftSize = 256;
    source.connect(analyser);
    analyser.connect(audioCtx.destination);
    try{
      await audioEl.play();
      setTimeout(function(){
        if(audioEl.paused){ showPlayButton(); }
      }, 400);
    }catch(playErr){
      console.error("TEACHER AUDIO PLAY BLOCKED:", playErr);
      showPlayButton();
    }
    var dataArray = new Uint8Array(analyser.frequencyBinCount);
    function animate(){
      if(!img.isConnected || !audioEl.isConnected){ return; }
      if(audioEl.paused || audioEl.ended){
        img.style.transform = "scale(1)";
        img.style.filter = "none";
        return;
      }
      analyser.getByteFrequencyData(dataArray);
      var avg = dataArray.reduce(function(a,b){ return a+b; }, 0) / dataArray.length;
      var intensity = Math.min(avg / 80, 1);
      var scale = 1 + (intensity * 0.06);
      var bounce = intensity * 8;
      var glow = 10 + (intensity * 30);
      img.style.transform = "scale(" + scale.toFixed(3) + ") translateY(-" + bounce.toFixed(2) + "px)";
      img.style.filter = "drop-shadow(0 0 " + glow.toFixed(0) + "px rgba(212,175,106," + (0.3 + intensity * 0.5).toFixed(2) + "))";
      requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    }
    audioEl.addEventListener("play", function(){ requestAnimationFrame(animate); });
    audioEl.addEventListener("playing", function(){ requestAnimationFrame(animate); });
    animate();
  }catch(err){
    console.error("TEACHER AUDIO ANIMATION ERROR:", err);
  }
}

  if(!needsRecording && transitionMode === "auto"){
    var autoMedia = root.querySelector("video, audio");
    if(autoMedia){
      autoMedia.addEventListener("ended", function(){ window.lsGoNext(); });
    } else {
      setTimeout(function(){ window.lsGoNext(); }, 2500);
    }
  }

  if(needsRecording){
    document.getElementById("lsRecordBtn").addEventListener("click", toggleRecording);
    document.getElementById("lsPlayBtn").addEventListener("click", playRecording);
    document.getElementById("lsRerecordBtn").addEventListener("click", reRecord);
    var expectedText = promptBlock ? promptBlock.expectedText : "";
    document.getElementById("lsSubmitBtn").addEventListener("click", function(){ submitRecording(expectedText, partNum); });
  }
}

var lsAudioCtx = null;
var lsWaveAnimId = null;

function startWave(streamOrElement, isElement){
  var canvas = document.getElementById("lsWaveCanvas");
  var ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  canvas.style.display = "block";
  if(!lsAudioCtx){
    lsAudioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
  }
  var analyser = lsAudioCtx.createAnalyser();
  analyser.fftSize = 64;

  if(isElement){
    if(!streamOrElement._lsWaveSource){
      streamOrElement._lsWaveSource = lsAudioCtx.createMediaElementSource(streamOrElement);
      streamOrElement._lsWaveSource.connect(lsAudioCtx.destination);
    }
    streamOrElement._lsWaveSource.connect(analyser);
  } else {
    var source = lsAudioCtx.createMediaStreamSource(streamOrElement);
    source.connect(analyser);
  }

  var bufferLength = analyser.frequencyBinCount;
  var dataArray = new Uint8Array(bufferLength);

  function draw(){
    lsWaveAnimId = requestAnimationFrame(draw);
    analyser.getByteFrequencyData(dataArray);
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    var barWidth = (canvas.width / bufferLength) * 1.8;
    var x = 0;
    for(var i = 0; i < bufferLength; i++){
      var barHeight = (dataArray[i] / 255) * canvas.height;
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd93d";
      ctx.fillRect(x, canvas.height - barHeight, barWidth, barHeight);
      x += barWidth + 2;
    }
  }
  draw();
}

function stopWave(){
  if(lsWaveAnimId){
    cancelAnimationFrame(lsWaveAnimId);
    lsWaveAnimId = null;
  }
  var canvas = document.getElementById("lsWaveCanvas");
  if(canvas){
    canvas.getContext("2d").clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    canvas.style.display = "none";
  }
}

function toggleRecording(){
  var btn = document.getElementById("lsRecordBtn");
  var status = document.getElementById("lsRecordStatus");

  if(!mediaRecorder || mediaRecorder.state === "inactive"){
    navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true }).then(function(stream){
      currentStream = stream;
      recordedChunks = [];
      mediaRecorder = new MediaRecorder(stream);
      mediaRecorder.ondataavailable = function(e){ recordedChunks.push(e.data); };
      mediaRecorder.onstop = function(){ if(window.resumeAppBgMusicAfterRecording){ window.resumeAppBgMusicAfterRecording(); }
        recordedBlob = new Blob(recordedChunks, { type: "audio/webm" });
        stopWave();
        document.getElementById("lsRecordBtn").style.display = "none";
        document.getElementById("lsPlaybackRow").style.display = "flex";
        document.getElementById("lsSubmitBtn").disabled = false;
        currentStream.getTracks().forEach(function(t){ t.stop(); });
      };
      if(window.pauseAppBgMusicForRecording){ window.pauseAppBgMusicForRecording(); } mediaRecorder.start();
      startWave(stream, false);
      btn.textContent = "■ Stop";
      btn.classList.add("ls-recording");
      status.textContent = "Recording...";
    }).catch(function(err){
      status.textContent = "Microphone access denied";
      console.error(err);
    });
  } else {
    mediaRecorder.stop();
  }
}

function playRecording(){
  var playBtn = document.getElementById("lsPlayBtn");
  var audioEl = document.getElementById("lsPlaybackAudio");
  var originalLabel = playBtn.innerHTML;
  playBtn.innerHTML = '<span class="ls-loading-pulse"></span>Loading...';
  playBtn.disabled = true;

  audioEl.src = URL.createObjectURL(recordedBlob);

  var onReady = function(){
    playBtn.innerHTML = originalLabel;
    playBtn.disabled = false;
    startWave(audioEl, true);
    audioEl.currentTime = 0;
    audioEl.play();
  };

  audioEl.addEventListener("canplay", onReady, { once: true });
  audioEl.addEventListener("ended", stopWave, { once: true });
}

function reRecord(){
  recordedBlob = null;
  document.getElementById("lsPlaybackRow").style.display = "none";
  var btn = document.getElementById("lsRecordBtn");
  btn.style.display = "inline-block";
  btn.textContent = "● Record";
  btn.classList.remove("ls-recording");
  document.getElementById("lsRecordStatus").textContent = "Not recorded yet";
  document.getElementById("lsSubmitBtn").disabled = true;
  document.getElementById("lsScoreDisplay").innerHTML = "";
}

function submitRecording(expectedText, partNum){
  var scoreDisplay = document.getElementById("lsScoreDisplay");
  scoreDisplay.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:rgba(255,255,255,.7);">Scoring...</p>';

  fetch(API_BASE + "/api/assessPronunciation?referenceText=" + encodeURIComponent(expectedText || ""), {
    method: "POST",
    body: recordedBlob
  }).then(function(res){ return res.json(); }).then(function(data){
    var score = data.finalScore ?? data.score ?? data.AccuracyScore ?? data.accuracyScore ?? 0;
    score = Math.round(score);
    scoreDisplay.innerHTML =
      '<div class="ls-score">' + score + '%</div>' +
      '<div class="ls-btn-row">' +
      '<button class="ls-btn ls-btn-secondary" onclick="window.lsRetryRecording()">Try Again</button>' +
      '<button class="ls-btn ls-btn-primary" onclick="window.lsGoNext()">Continue</button>' +
      '</div>';
  }).catch(function(err){
    console.error(err);
    scoreDisplay.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:#ff8a8a;">Could not score - please try again.</p>' +
      '<div class="ls-btn-row"><button class="ls-btn ls-btn-secondary" onclick="window.lsRetryRecording()">Try Again</button></div>';
  });
}

window.lsRetryRecording = function(){
  recordedBlob = null;
  renderPart(currentPart, getPartLabel(currentPart));
};

window.lsGoNext = function(){
  recordedBlob = null;
  var nextPart = currentPart + 1;
  if(getPartAssets(nextPart).length > 0){
    currentPart = nextPart;
    renderPart(nextPart, getPartLabel(nextPart));
  }
  else {
    render(
      '<div class="ls-card" style="text-align:center;">' +
      '<p class="ls-part-label">Lesson Complete!</p>' +
      '<p style="color:#fff;font-size:1.1rem;margin-bottom:20px;">You did it! 🎉</p>' +
      '<button class="ls-btn ls-btn-primary" onclick="window.location.href=\'./\'">Back to Lessons</button>' +
      '</div>'
    );
  }
};

fetch(API_BASE + "/api/levelAssets?level=" + LEVEL + "&lesson=" + LESSON)
  .then(function(res){ return res.json(); })
  .then(function(assets){
    allAssets = assets || [];
    if(allAssets.length === 0){
      render('<div class="ls-card" style="text-align:center;"><p style="color:#fff;">This lesson\'s content hasn\'t been added yet.</p></div>');
      return;
    }
    renderPart(1, getPartLabel(1));
  })
  .catch(function(err){
    console.error(err);
    render('<div class="ls-card" style="text-align:center;"><p style="color:#ff8a8a;">Could not load this lesson.</p></div>');
  });

 var wb=new Blob([bf],{type:'audio/wav'});wb.pk=pk;return wb;
}

function close(silent){
 if(!G)return;G.dead=true;cancelAnimationFrame(G.raf);G.timers.forEach(clearTimeout);
 try{if(G.media){G.media.pause();G.media.src='';}}catch(e){}

 try{if(G.stream)G.stream.getTracks().forEach(function(t){t.stop();});}catch(e){}

 try{document.documentElement.style.overflow='';}catch(e){}
 r.classList.remove('on');setTimeout(function(){try{r.remove();s.remove();}catch(e){}},silent?0:450);
}

function pcmToWav(d){

}

async function loadOverview(){

  const res = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/adminMusicOverview");
  const data = await res.json();

  const grid = document.getElementById("statGrid");
  grid.innerHTML = "";

  const cards = [
    { label: "Total Videos", value: data.totalVideos },
    { label: "Total Views", value: data.totalViews },
    { label: "Total Likes", value: data.totalLikes },
    { label: "Total Comments", value: data.totalComments },
    { label: "Playlists Created", value: data.totalPlaylists }
  ];

  cards.forEach((c,i)=>{
    const card = document.createElement("div");
    card.className = "stat-card cascade-card";
    card.style.animationDelay = (i * 0.08) + "s";
    card.innerHTML = "<div class='stat-label'>" + c.label + "</div><div class='stat-value'>" + c.value + "</div>";
    grid.appendChild(card);
  });

}

function extractYoutubeId(input){
  input = input.trim();
  if(/^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{11}$/.test(input)) return input;
  const patterns = [
    /(?:youtube\.com\/watch\?v=)([a-zA-Z0-9_-]{11})/,
    /(?:youtu\.be\/)([a-zA-Z0-9_-]{11})/,
    /(?:youtube\.com\/embed\/)([a-zA-Z0-9_-]{11})/
  ];
  for(const p of patterns){
    const m = input.match(p);
    if(m) return m[1];
  }
  return null;
}

async function loadVideos(){

  const res = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/musicVideos");
  const videos = await res.json();

  const table = document.getElementById("videosTable");

  if(!videos.length){
    table.innerHTML = "<tr><td colspan='6' class='empty-note'>No videos yet. Add one above.</td></tr>";
    return;
  }

  table.innerHTML = "";

  videos.forEach(v=>{
    const row = document.createElement("tr");
    row.innerHTML =
      "<td>" + (v.thumbnailUrl ? "<img class='thumb-sm' src='" + v.thumbnailUrl + "'>" : v.youtubeId ? "<img class='thumb-sm' src='https://img.youtube.com/vi/" + v.youtubeId + "/hqdefault.jpg'>" : "<div class='thumb-sm' style='display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:rgba(183,110,121,.15);color:#C9A0A5;font-size:10px;'>File</div>") + "</td>" +
      "<td>" + v.title + "<br><span style='color:#786367;font-size:10.5px;'>" + (v.artist||"") + "</span></td>" +
      "<td>" + v.genre + "</td>" +
      "<td>" + v.views + "</td>" +
      "<td>" + v.likeCount + "</td>" +
      "<td>" +
      "<button onclick=\"triggerThumbnailEdit('" + v.id + "', '" + v.genre + "')\">Edit Thumbnail</button> " +
      "<button class='btn-delete' onclick=\"deleteVideo('" + v.id + "')\">Delete</button>" +
      "<input type='file' accept='image/*' style='display:none;' id='thumbEdit-" + v.id + "' onchange=\"handleThumbnailEdit('" + v.id + "', '" + v.genre + "')\" />" +
      "</td>";
    table.appendChild(row);
  });

}

window.addVideo = async function(){

  const title = document.getElementById("addTitle").value.trim();
  const artist = document.getElementById("addArtist").value.trim();
  const genre = document.getElementById("addGenre").value;
  const description = document.getElementById("addDescription").value.trim();
  const btn = document.getElementById("addVideoBtn");
  const progressEl = document.getElementById("uploadProgress");
  const thumbnailFile = document.getElementById("addThumbnail").files[0];

  if(!title){
    alert("Please provide a title.");
    return;
  }

  let youtubeId = null;
  let fileUrl = null;
  let thumbnailUrl = null;

  if(thumbnailFile){

    if(!auth.currentUser){
      await signInAnonymously(auth);
    }

    try{
      const thumbSrc = await window.compressImageFile(thumbnailFile);
      const thumbRef = ref(storage, "musicThumbnails/" + genre + "/" + Date.now() + "_" + thumbSrc.name);
      await uploadBytesResumable(thumbRef, thumbSrc);
      thumbnailUrl = await getDownloadURL(thumbRef);
    }catch(err){
      alert("Thumbnail upload failed. Continuing without a custom thumbnail.");
    }

  }

  if(uploadMode === "youtube"){

    const youtubeInput = document.getElementById("addYoutube").value.trim();
    youtubeId = extractYoutubeId(youtubeInput);

    if(!youtubeId){
      alert("Please provide a valid YouTube URL or 11-character video ID.");
      return;
    }

  }else{

    const fileInput = document.getElementById("addVideoFile");
    const file = fileInput.files[0];

    if(!file){
      alert("Please choose a video file to upload.");
      return;
    }

    btn.disabled = true;
    btn.innerText = "Uploading...";

    try{

      if(!auth.currentUser){
        await signInAnonymously(auth);
      }

      const fileRef = ref(storage, "musicVideos/" + genre + "/" + Date.now() + "_" + file.name);
      const uploadTask = uploadBytesResumable(fileRef, file);

      fileUrl = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        uploadTask.on("state_changed",
          (snapshot) => {
            const pct = Math.round((snapshot.bytesTransferred / snapshot.totalBytes) * 100);
            progressEl.innerText = "Uploading: " + pct + "%";
          },
          (err) => reject(err),
          async () => resolve(await getDownloadURL(uploadTask.snapshot.ref))
        );
      });

      progressEl.innerText = "Upload complete.";

    }catch(err){
      alert("Video upload failed. Please try again.");
      btn.disabled = false;
      btn.innerText = "Add Video";
      return;
    }

  }

  const res = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/adminAddMusicVideo", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify({ title, artist, genre, youtubeId, fileUrl, thumbnailUrl, description })
  });

  btn.disabled = false;
  btn.innerText = "Add Video";

  if(res.ok){
    document.getElementById("addTitle").value = "";
    document.getElementById("addArtist").value = "";
    document.getElementById("addYoutube").value = "";
    document.getElementById("addDescription").value = "";
    document.getElementById("addVideoFile").value = "";
    document.getElementById("addThumbnail").value = "";
    progressEl.innerText = "";
    loadVideos();
    loadOverview();
  }else{
    alert("Could not add video.");
  }

}

window.deleteVideo = async function(videoId){

  if(!confirm("Delete this video? This cannot be undone.")) return;

  await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/adminDeleteMusicVideo", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify({ videoId })
  });

  loadVideos();
  loadOverview();

}

window.triggerThumbnailEdit = function(videoId, genre){
  document.getElementById("thumbEdit-" + videoId).click();
}

window.handleThumbnailEdit = async function(videoId, genre){

  const input = document.getElementById("thumbEdit-" + videoId);
  const file = input.files[0];

  if(!file) return;

  if(!auth.currentUser){
    await signInAnonymously(auth);
  }

  try{

    const thumbSrc = await window.compressImageFile(file);
    const thumbRef = ref(storage, "musicThumbnails/" + genre + "/" + Date.now() + "_" + thumbSrc.name);
    await uploadBytesResumable(thumbRef, thumbSrc);
    const thumbnailUrl = await getDownloadURL(thumbRef);

    const res = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/adminUpdateMusicThumbnail", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ videoId, thumbnailUrl })
    });

    if(res.ok){
      loadVideos();
    }else{
      alert("Could not update thumbnail.");
    }

  }catch(err){
    alert("Thumbnail upload failed. Please try again.");
  }

}

async function loadCommentsTab(){

  const videosRes = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/musicVideos");
  const videos = await videosRes.json();

  const table = document.getElementById("commentsTable");
  table.innerHTML = "<tr><td colspan='4' class='empty-note'>Loading…</td></tr>";

  let allComments = [];

  for(const v of videos){
    const cRes = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/musicComments?videoId=" + v.id);
    const comments = await cRes.json();
    comments.forEach(c => allComments.push({ ...c, videoTitle: v.title }));
  }

  if(!allComments.length){
    table.innerHTML = "<tr><td colspan='4' class='empty-note'>No comments yet.</td></tr>";
    return;
  }

  table.innerHTML = "";

  allComments.forEach(c=>{
    const row = document.createElement("tr");
    row.innerHTML =
      "<td>" + c.videoTitle + "</td>" +
      "<td>" + c.userName + "</td>" +
      "<td>" + c.text.replace(/</g,"&lt;") + "</td>" +
      "<td><button class='btn-delete' onclick=\"deleteComment('" + c.id + "')\">Delete</button></td>";
    table.appendChild(row);
  });

}

window.deleteComment = async function(commentId){

  if(!confirm("Delete this comment?")) return;

  await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/musicDeleteComment", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify({ commentId })
  });

  loadCommentsTab();
  loadOverview();

}
