===== FILE: public\support\donate.js (2657 bytes) =====
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {

  const payBtn = document.getElementById("payBtn");
  const form = document.getElementById("donationForm");

  if (!payBtn || !form) return;

  payBtn.addEventListener("click", function () {

    const firstName = form.firstName.value.trim();
    const lastName = form.lastName.value.trim();
    const email = form.email.value.trim();
    const amount = Number(form.amount.value);
    const currency = form.currency.value;
    const message = form.message.value.trim();

    if (!email || !amount || amount <= 0) {
      alert("Please enter a valid donation amount.");
      return;
    }

    if (currency === "USD") {
      payWithStripe(firstName, lastName, email, amount, message);
    } else {
      payWithPaystack(firstName, lastName, email, amount, currency);
    }

  });

  function payWithPaystack(firstName, lastName, email, amount, currency) {

    const handler = PaystackPop.setup({
      key: "pk_live_adbd997a6cb7382da7c9e3e77c0ca487b93d73ab",

      email: email,
      amount: amount * 100,
      currency: currency,

      ref: "SAYBON_" + Date.now(),

      metadata: {
        custom_fields: [
          {
            display_name: "Donor Name",
            variable_name: "donor_name",
            value: firstName + " " + lastName
          }
        ]
      },

      callback: function (response) {
        sessionStorage.setItem("donorName", firstName || "friend");
        sessionStorage.setItem("donationRef", response.reference);

        window.location.href = "thank-you.html";
      },

      onClose: function () {
        alert("Donation cancelled.");
      }
    });

    handler.openIframe();
  }

  async function payWithStripe(firstName, lastName, email, amount, message) {

    payBtn.disabled = true;
    payBtn.textContent = "Redirecting to payment...";

    try {

      const res = await fetch("https://saybonapp-server.onrender.com/api/createDonationCheckout", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ firstName, lastName, email, amount, message })
      });

      const data = await res.json();

      if (!res.ok || !data.url) {
        alert("Could not start payment. Please try again.");
        payBtn.disabled = false;
        payBtn.textContent = "Continue to Payment";
        return;
      }

      sessionStorage.setItem("donorName", firstName || "friend");
      window.location.href = data.url;

    } catch (err) {
      alert("Could not start payment. Please try again.");
      payBtn.disabled = false;
      payBtn.textContent = "Continue to Payment";
    }

  }

});

===== FILE: public\support\thank-you.js (1222 bytes) =====
const name = sessionStorage.getItem("donorName");

const title = document.getElementById("thankYouTitle");

if (name && name.trim() !== "") {
  title.textContent = "Thank you, " + name;
} else {
  title.textContent = "Thank you, friend";
}

// Verify and log the real payment - Stripe via session_id in URL,
// Paystack via the reference already stored during checkout.
(function verifyDonationPayment(){
  const API_BASE = "https://saybonapp-server.onrender.com";
  const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  const sessionId = params.get("session_id");
  const paystackRef = sessionStorage.getItem("donationRef");

  if(sessionId){
    fetch(API_BASE + "/api/verifyDonationSession?session_id=" + encodeURIComponent(sessionId))
      .catch(function(err){ console.error("Stripe donation verification failed:", err); });
  } else if(paystackRef){
    fetch(API_BASE + "/api/verifyPaystackDonation", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ reference: paystackRef })
    }).catch(function(err){ console.error("Paystack donation verification failed:", err); });
  }
})();

function goDashboard() {
  window.location.href = "/dashboard/";
}

<script type="module">

import { initializeApp } from "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.0/firebase-app.js";
import { getStorage, ref, uploadBytesResumable, getDownloadURL } from "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.0/firebase-storage.js";
import { getAuth, signInAnonymously } from "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.0/firebase-auth.js";

const firebaseConfig = {
  apiKey:"[REDACTED]",
  authDomain:"saybon-3e3c2.firebaseapp.com",
  projectId:"saybon-3e3c2",
  storageBucket:"saybon-3e3c2.firebasestorage.app",
  messagingSenderId:"75085012344",
  appId:"1:75085012344:web:0b18581cb0a30c3df47c8d"
};

const fbApp = initializeApp(firebaseConfig);
const storage = getStorage(fbApp);
const auth = getAuth(fbApp);



const API_BASE = "https://saybonapp-server.onrender.com"; window.addEventListener("adminAuthorized", function(){ document.getElementById("login").style.display = "none"; document.getElementById("panel").style.display = "block"; loadLocations(); loadAssets(); });

window.unlock = function(){
  const val = document.getElementById("passcode").value;
  if(false){
    document.getElementById("login").style.display = "none";
    document.getElementById("panel").style.display = "block";
    loadLocations();
    loadAssets();
  } else {
    alert("Incorrect passcode.");
  }
};

window.switchTab = function(tab){
  document.querySelectorAll(".tab-btn").forEach(b => b.classList.remove("active"));
  document.querySelectorAll(".tab-panel").forEach(p => p.classList.remove("active"));
  document.querySelector('.tab-btn[data-tab="' + tab + '"]').classList.add("active");
  document.getElementById("panel-" + tab).classList.add("active");
};

// ===== LOCATIONS =====

async function loadLocations(){

  const table = document.getElementById("locationsTable");
  table.innerHTML = "<tr><td colspan='5' class='empty-note'>Loading…</td></tr>";

  const res = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/locations");
  const locations = await res.json();

  if(!locations.length){
    table.innerHTML = "<tr><td colspan='5' class='empty-note'>No locations yet. Add your first one above.</td></tr>";
    return;
  }

  table.innerHTML = "";

  locations.forEach((loc, i) => {
    const row = document.createElement("tr");
    row.innerHTML =
      "<td><img class='thumb-sm' src='" + loc.imageUrl + "'></td>" +
      "<td>" + loc.name + "</td>" +
      "<td>" + loc.order + "</td>" +
      "<td>" + (loc.unlocked ? "<span class='badge-unlocked'>Unlocked</span>" : "<span class='badge-locked'>Locked</span>") + "</td>" +
      "<td>" +
      "<button class='btn-move' " + (i===0 ? "disabled" : "") + " onclick=\"moveLocation('" + loc.id + "','up')\">&#9650;</button> " +
      "<button class='btn-move' " + (i===locations.length-1 ? "disabled" : "") + " onclick=\"moveLocation('" + loc.id + "','down')\">&#9660;</button> " +
      "<button class='btn-delete' onclick=\"deleteLocation('" + loc.id + "')\">Delete</button>" +
      "</td>";
    table.appendChild(row);
  });

}

window.addLocation = async function(){

  const name = document.getElementById("addName").value.trim();
  const imageFile = document.getElementById("addImage").files[0];
  const btn = document.getElementById("addLocationBtn");
  const progressEl = document.getElementById("uploadProgress");

  if(!name){ alert("Please provide a location name."); return; }
  if(!imageFile){ alert("Please choose an image."); return; }

  btn.disabled = true;
  btn.innerText = "Uploading...";

  try{

    if(!auth.currentUser){ await signInAnonymously(auth); }

    const imgSrc = await window.compressImageFile(imageFile);
    const imgRef = ref(storage, "talkleticsLocations/" + Date.now() + "_" + imgSrc.name);
    const uploadTask = uploadBytesResumable(imgRef, imgSrc);

    const imageUrl = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      uploadTask.on("state_changed",
        (snapshot) => {
          const pct = Math.round((snapshot.bytesTransferred / snapshot.totalBytes) * 100);
          progressEl.innerText = "Uploading: " + pct + "%";
        },
        (err) => reject(err),
        async () => resolve(await getDownloadURL(uploadTask.snapshot.ref))
      );
    });

    const res = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/adminAddLocation", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ name, imageUrl })
    });

    if(res.ok){
      document.getElementById("addName").value = "";
      document.getElementById("addImage").value = "";
      progressEl.innerText = "Location added.";
      loadLocations();
    } else {
      alert("Could not add location.");
    }

  }catch(err){
    console.error(err);
    alert("Upload failed. Please try again.");
  }

  btn.disabled = false;
  btn.innerText = "Add Location";

};

window.moveLocation = async function(locationId, direction){
  await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/adminMoveLocation", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify({ locationId, direction })
  });
  loadLocations();
};

window.deleteLocation = async function(locationId){
  if(!confirm("Delete this location? This cannot be undone.")) return;
  await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/adminDeleteLocation", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify({ locationId })
  });
  loadLocations();
};

// ===== MEDIA ASSETS =====

async function loadAssets(){

  const table = document.getElementById("assetsTable");
  table.innerHTML = "<tr><td colspan='4' class='empty-note'>Loading…</td></tr>";

  const res = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/assets");
  const assets = await res.json();

  if(!assets.length){
    table.innerHTML = "<tr><td colspan='4' class='empty-note'>No assets yet. Add your first one above.</td></tr>";
    return;
  }

  table.innerHTML = "";

  assets.forEach(a => {
    const row = document.createElement("tr");
    row.innerHTML =
      "<td>" + a.name + "</td>" +
      "<td>" + a.type + "</td>" +
      "<td><a class='asset-link' href='" + a.url + "' target='_blank'>" + a.url.slice(0,50) + "…</a></td>" +
      "<td>" +
      "<button onclick=\"renameAsset('" + a.id + "','" + a.name.replace(/'/g, "\\'") + "')\">Rename</button> " +
      "<button class='btn-delete' onclick=\"deleteAsset('" + a.id + "')\">Delete</button>" +
      "</td>";
    table.appendChild(row);
  });

}

window.addAsset = async function(){

  const name = document.getElementById("assetName").value.trim();
  const type = document.getElementById("assetType").value;
  const file = document.getElementById("assetFile").files[0];
  const btn = document.getElementById("addAssetBtn");
  const progressEl = document.getElementById("assetUploadProgress");

  if(!name){ alert("Please provide an asset name."); return; }
  if(!file){ alert("Please choose a file."); return; }

  btn.disabled = true;
  btn.innerText = "Uploading...";

  try{

    if(!auth.currentUser){ await signInAnonymously(auth); }

    const fileSrc = await window.compressImageFile(file);
    const fileRef = ref(storage, "talkleticsAssets/" + Date.now() + "_" + fileSrc.name);
    const uploadTask = uploadBytesResumable(fileRef, fileSrc);

    const url = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      uploadTask.on("state_changed",
        (snapshot) => {
          const pct = Math.round((snapshot.bytesTransferred / snapshot.totalBytes) * 100);
          progressEl.innerText = "Uploading: " + pct + "%";
        },
        (err) => reject(err),
        async () => resolve(await getDownloadURL(uploadTask.snapshot.ref))
      );
    });

    const res = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/adminAddAsset", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ name, type, url })
    });

    if(res.ok){
      document.getElementById("assetName").value = "";
      document.getElementById("assetFile").value = "";
      progressEl.innerText = "Asset added.";
      loadAssets();
    } else {
      alert("Could not add asset.");
    }

  }catch(err){
    console.error(err);
    alert("Upload failed. Please try again.");
  }

  btn.disabled = false;
  btn.innerText = "Add Asset";

};

window.renameAsset = async function(assetId, currentName){
  var newName = prompt("Rename asset:", currentName);
  if(!newName || newName === currentName) return;
  await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/adminRenameAsset", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify({ assetId, newName })
  });
  loadAssets();
};

window.deleteAsset = async function(assetId){
  if(!confirm("Delete this asset?")) return;
  await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/adminDeleteAsset", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify({ assetId })
  });
  loadAssets();
};

===== FILE: public\talkletics\curriculum.js (115581 bytes) =====
/* Talkletics curriculum - single source of truth for the journey hub, the game player and the curriculum document.
   Every media item is a PLACEHOLDER until a real file named by its `key` exists in Talkletics assets:
     audio  = transcript only        (the voice will say this)
     video  = icon + transcript      (a video where this is said; scene in `description`)
     image  = icon + description     (an image to generate; this is what it shows)
   Real files are looked up by `key` in /api/assets (asset name === key). */
(function (root) {
  var TK = { levels: [], version: 1 };

  var KINDS = {
    echo:     ["Répétez", "Repeat after me"],
    see:      ["Dites ce que vous voyez", "Say what you see"],
    answer:   ["Répondez", "Answer the question"],
    role:     ["Jeu de rôle", "Role-play"],
    describe: ["Décrivez", "Describe"],
    opinion:  ["Donnez votre avis", "Give your opinion"],
    story:    ["Racontez", "Tell a story"],
    debate:   ["Débattez", "Debate"],
    summary:  ["Résumez", "Summarise"],
    present:  ["Présentez", "Present"],
    mediate:  ["Négociez", "Negotiate"]
  };
  TK.kinds = KINDS;

  // ---- item builders ------------------------------------------------------
  // ref items: graded by pronunciation assessment against the expected text
  function E(fr, en, key) {                       // echo: hear it, say it
    return { mode: "ref", expected: fr, en: en, showText: true, key: key || null,
             media: { type: "audio", transcript: fr } };
  }
  function S(icon, desc, fr, en, key) {           // see: say what the picture shows
    return { mode: "ref", expected: fr, en: en, showText: false, key: key || null,
             voice: "Qu'est-ce que c'est ?",
             media: { type: "image", icon: icon, description: desc } };
  }
  // free items: graded on transcript (content + language) + fluency + clarity
  function free(media, voice, en, task, must, sample, min, max, key) {
    return { mode: "free", voice: voice, en: en, task: task, must: must, sample: sample,
             min: min || null, max: max || null, key: key || null, media: media, showText: false };
  }
  function A(say, en, task, must, sample, min, max) {        // audio question
    return free({ type: "audio", transcript: say }, say, en, task, must, sample, min, max);
  }
  function V(scene, say, en, task, must, sample, min, max) { // video line
    return free({ type: "video", icon: "🎬", transcript: say, description: scene }, say, en, task, must, sample, min, max);
  }
  function I(icon, desc, voice, en, task, must, sample, min, max) { // image + guide question
    return free({ type: "image", icon: icon, description: desc }, voice, en, task, must, sample, min, max);
  }
  root.TK_BUILD = { E: E, S: S, A: A, V: V, I: I };

  // ---- level registration -------------------------------------------------
  function LEVEL(d) {
    d.order = TK.levels.length + 1;
    var n = 0;
    function prep(g, gid, isGrad) {
      g.id = gid; g.level = d.id; g.isGraduation = !!isGrad;
      g.kindLabel = KINDS[g.kind] || KINDS.answer;
      g.items.forEach(function (it, i) {
        it.id = gid + "-" + (i + 1);
        it.key = it.key || it.id;
        it.media.key = it.key;
        if (it.mode === "free") {
          it.min = it.min || d.defMin;
          it.max = Math.min(it.max || d.defMax, 55);   // Azure short-audio limit is 60 s
        }
      });
      g.passMark = isGrad ? d.gradPass : d.pass;
    }
    d.games.forEach(function (g, i) { prep(g, d.id.toLowerCase() + "g" + (i + 1), false); g.index = i + 1; });
    prep(d.graduation, d.id.toLowerCase() + "grad", true);
    d.graduation.index = d.games.length + 1;
    TK.levels.push(d);
  }
  root.TK_LEVEL = LEVEL;

  // ---- lookups ------------------------------------------------------------
  TK.allGames = function () {
    var out = [];
    TK.levels.forEach(function (l) { l.games.forEach(function (g) { out.push(g); }); out.push(l.graduation); });
    return out;
  };
  TK.game = function (id) { return TK.allGames().filter(function (g) { return g.id === id; })[0] || null; };
  TK.level = function (id) { return TK.levels.filter(function (l) { return l.id === id; })[0] || null; };
  root.TK_CURRICULUM = TK;
})(typeof window !== "undefined" ? window : globalThis);

===== FILE: public\talkletics\journey.js (2590 bytes) =====
import { whenUser, loadProgress, status, esc, CUR } from "./tk-common.js";

var main = document.getElementById("jyMain");
var params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
var unlockAll = params.get("preview") === "1";

(async function () {
  var user = await whenUser();
  if (!user) { main.innerHTML = '<p class="jy-loading">Please sign in to play.</p>'; return; }
  var scores = await loadProgress();
  var html = "";
  var firstOpen = null;

  CUR.levels.forEach(function (lv) {
    var gradSt = status(lv, lv.graduation, scores, unlockAll);
    var levelDone = gradSt.done;
    var firstSt = status(lv, lv.games[0], scores, unlockAll);
    var doneCount = lv.games.filter(function (g) { return status(lv, g, scores, unlockAll).done; }).length;
    html += '<section class="jy-level' + (firstSt.unlocked ? "" : " is-locked") + '" id="lv-' + lv.id + '">' +
      '<div class="jy-level-head"><span class="jy-cefr">' + esc(lv.cefr) + '</span><div><h2>' + esc(lv.place) +
      '</h2><p>' + esc(lv.placeEn) + ' · ' + esc(lv.tagline) + '</p></div><span class="jy-count">' +
      (levelDone ? "✓" : doneCount + "/" + lv.games.length) + '</span></div>' +
      '<div class="jy-scene">' + esc(lv.sceneImage.icon) + ' <small>' + esc(lv.sceneImage.description) + '</small></div>' +
      '<div class="jy-games">';
    lv.games.concat([lv.graduation]).forEach(function (g) {
      var st = status(lv, g, scores, unlockAll);
      if (st.unlocked && !st.done && !firstOpen) firstOpen = g.id;
      var tag = st.unlocked ? "a" : "div";
      var href = st.unlocked ? ' href="play.html?game=' + g.id + (unlockAll ? "&preview=1" : "") + '"' : "";
      html += "<" + tag + ' class="jy-game' + (g.isGraduation ? " is-grad" : "") + (st.done ? " is-done" : "") +
        (st.unlocked ? "" : " is-locked") + '" id="g-' + g.id + '"' + href + ">" +
        '<span class="jy-num">' + (g.isGraduation ? "🎓" : g.index) + "</span>" +
        '<span class="jy-gt"><b>' + esc(g.title) + "</b><i>" + esc(g.titleEn) + " · " + esc(g.kindLabel[1]) + "</i></span>" +
        '<span class="jy-stars">' + (st.unlocked ? (st.done ? "★".repeat(st.stars) + "☆".repeat(3 - st.stars) : (st.avg ? st.avg + "%" : "")) : "🔒") + "</span></" + tag + ">";
    });
    html += "</div>" +
      '<p class="jy-grad-note">🎓 <b>' + esc(lv.graduation.title) + '</b> - ' + esc(lv.graduationMeans) + '</p></section>';
  });

  main.innerHTML = html;
  if (firstOpen) {
    var el = document.getElementById("g-" + firstOpen);
    if (el) { el.classList.add("is-next"); el.scrollIntoView({ block: "center" }); }
  }
})();

  var waveAnimId = null;

  function startWave(streamOrElement, isElement){
    waveCanvas.style.display = "block";
    if(!waveAudioCtx){
      waveAudioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
    }
    waveAnalyser = waveAudioCtx.createAnalyser();
    waveAnalyser.fftSize = 64;

    if(isElement){
      if(!streamOrElement._msWaveSource){
        streamOrElement._msWaveSource = waveAudioCtx.createMediaElementSource(streamOrElement);
        streamOrElement._msWaveSource.connect(waveAudioCtx.destination);
      }
      streamOrElement._msWaveSource.connect(waveAnalyser);
    } else {
      waveSource = waveAudioCtx.createMediaStreamSource(streamOrElement);
      waveSource.connect(waveAnalyser);
    }

    var bufferLength = waveAnalyser.frequencyBinCount;
    var dataArray = new Uint8Array(bufferLength);

    function draw(){
      waveAnimId = requestAnimationFrame(draw);
      waveAnalyser.getByteFrequencyData(dataArray);
      waveCtx.clearRect(0, 0, waveCanvas.width, waveCanvas.height);
      var barWidth = (waveCanvas.width / bufferLength) * 1.8;
      var x = 0;
      for(var i = 0; i < bufferLength; i++){
        var barHeight = (dataArray[i] / 255) * waveCanvas.height;
        waveCtx.fillStyle = "#5fbf5f";
        waveCtx.fillRect(x, waveCanvas.height - barHeight, barWidth, barHeight);
        x += barWidth + 2;
      }
    }
    draw();
  }

  function stopWave(){
    if(waveAnimId){
      cancelAnimationFrame(waveAnimId);
      waveAnimId = null;
    }
    waveCtx.clearRect(0, 0, waveCanvas.width, waveCanvas.height);
    waveCanvas.style.display = "none";
  }

  var encourageMessages = [
    "You're SO close - I think one more try gets you there!",

  // ===== WAV encoding (proven pattern from Levels prototype) =====
  function encodeWAV(samples, sampleRate){
    var buffer = new ArrayBuffer(44 + samples.length * 2);
    var view = new DataView(buffer);
    function writeString(offset, str){
      for(var i=0;i<str.length;i++) view.setUint8(offset+i, str.charCodeAt(i));
    }
    writeString(0,"RIFF");
    view.setUint32(4, 36 + samples.length*2, true);
    writeString(8,"WAVE");
    writeString(12,"fmt ");
    view.setUint32(16,16,true);
    view.setUint16(20,1,true);
    view.setUint16(22,1,true);
    view.setUint32(24,sampleRate,true);
    view.setUint32(28,sampleRate*2,true);
    view.setUint16(32,2,true);
    view.setUint16(34,16,true);
    writeString(36,"data");
    view.setUint32(40, samples.length*2, true);
    var offset = 44;
    for(var i=0;i<samples.length;i++, offset+=2){
      var s = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, samples[i]));
      view.setInt16(offset, s<0 ? s*0x8000 : s*0x7FFF, true);
    }
    return buffer;
  }

  async function convertBlobToWav(blob){
    var arrayBuffer = await blob.arrayBuffer();
    var audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
    var decoded = await audioCtx.decodeAudioData(arrayBuffer);
    var offlineCtx = new OfflineAudioContext(1, Math.ceil(decoded.duration * 16000), 16000);
    var source = offlineCtx.createBufferSource();
    source.buffer = decoded;
    source.connect(offlineCtx.destination);
    source.start(0);
    var rendered = await offlineCtx.startRendering();
    var wavBuffer = encodeWAV(rendered.getChannelData(0), 16000);
    audioCtx.close();
    return wavBuffer;
  }

  function updateDots(){
    dots.forEach(function(d, i){
      d.classList.toggle("ms-dot-filled", i < listenCount);
    });
  }

  function resetItemUI(){
    listenCount = 0;
    updateDots();
    listenBtn.style.display = "inline-block";
    listenBtn.disabled = false;
    listenBtn.textContent = "▶ Listen";
    recordBtn.style.display = "none";
    stopBtn.style.display = "none";

    playRecordingBtn.style.display = "none";

  }

  function renderItem(index){
    sequenceToken++;
    var item = CURRICULUM[index];
    frenchEl.textContent = item.french;
    englishEl.textContent = item.english;
    itemCounterEl.textContent = "Item " + (index+1) + " of " + CURRICULUM.length;
    tierLabelEl.textContent = item.tier;
    refAudio.src = assetMap[item.asset] || "";
    resetItemUI();
  }

  // ===== Locked auto-play sequence: one click starts everything =====
  listenBtn.addEventListener("click", function(){
    if(!refAudio.src){
      statusEl.textContent = "Reference audio not uploaded yet for this item.";
      return;
    }
    listenBtn.style.display = "none";
    phaseLabelEl.textContent = "Listen intently...";
    runAutoSequence(sequenceToken);
  });

  function runAutoSequence(token){
    if(token !== sequenceToken) return;
    refAudio.currentTime = 0;
    refAudio.play();
  }

  refAudio.addEventListener("ended", function(){
    var token = sequenceToken;

    listenCount++;
    updateDots();

    if(listenCount === 3){
      phaseLabelEl.textContent = "Get ready - you'll record exactly what you hear once the audio stops.";
    }

    if(listenCount >= 6){
      phaseLabelEl.textContent = "Record a replica - the closer, the higher your score!";
      recordBtn.style.display = "inline-block";
      return;
    }

    setTimeout(function(){
      runAutoSequence(token);
    }, 500);
  });

  recordBtn.addEventListener("click", async function(){
    try{
      currentStream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true });
    }catch(err){
      statusEl.textContent = "Microphone access is needed to record.";
      return;
    }
    recordedChunks = [];
    mediaRecorder = new MediaRecorder(currentStream);
    mediaRecorder.ondataavailable = function(e){ recordedChunks.push(e.data); };
    if(window.pauseAppBgMusicForRecording){ window.pauseAppBgMusicForRecording(); }
    mediaRecorder.start();
    recordBtn.style.display = "none";
    stopBtn.style.display = "inline-block";
    statusEl.textContent = "Recording...";
    startWave(currentStream, false);
  });

  stopBtn.addEventListener("click", function(){
    mediaRecorder.stop();
    if(window.resumeAppBgMusicAfterRecording){ window.resumeAppBgMusicAfterRecording(); }
    currentStream.getTracks().forEach(function(t){ t.stop(); });
    stopBtn.style.display = "none";
    stopWave();

    mediaRecorder.addEventListener("stop", function(){
      var blob = new Blob(recordedChunks);
      if(recordedBlobUrl){
        URL.revokeObjectURL(recordedBlobUrl);
      }
      recordedBlobUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      playbackAudioEl.src = recordedBlobUrl;

      playRecordingBtn.style.display = "inline-block";
      rerecordBtn.style.display = "inline-block";
      submitBtn.style.display = "inline-block";
      statusEl.textContent = "Listen back, re-record, or submit when ready.";
    }, { once: true });
  });

  playRecordingBtn.addEventListener("click", function(){
    playRecordingBtn.disabled = true;
    var originalLabel = playRecordingBtn.innerHTML;
    playRecordingBtn.innerHTML = "<span class='ms-loading-pulse'></span>Loading...";

    var onReady = function(){
      playRecordingBtn.innerHTML = originalLabel;
      playRecordingBtn.disabled = false;
      startWave(playbackAudioEl, true);
      playbackAudioEl.currentTime = 0;
      playbackAudioEl.play();
    };

    if(playbackAudioEl.readyState >= 2){
      onReady();
    } else {
      playbackAudioEl.addEventListener("canplay", onReady, { once: true });
    }
  });

  playbackAudioEl.addEventListener("ended", stopWave);

  rerecordBtn.addEventListener("click", function(){
    playRecordingBtn.style.display = "none";
    rerecordBtn.style.display = "none";
    submitBtn.style.display = "none";
    recordBtn.style.display = "inline-block";
    statusEl.textContent = "";
  });

  submitBtn.addEventListener("click", async function(){

    submitBtn.disabled = true;
    preSkipBtn.style.display = "none";
    statusEl.textContent = "Analyzing your pronunciation...";

    try{

      var blob = new Blob(recordedChunks);
      var wavBuffer = await convertBlobToWav(blob);
      var item = CURRICULUM[currentIndex];

      var res = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/assessPronunciation?referenceText=" + encodeURIComponent(item.french), {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "audio/wav" },
        body: wavBuffer
      });

      var data = await res.json();

      if(!res.ok){
        statusEl.textContent = "Could not assess that recording. Please try again.";
        submitBtn.disabled = false;
        preSkipBtn.style.display = "block";
        return;
      }

      var rawScore = data.finalScore || 0;
      var taperBonus = 15 * (1 - (currentIndex / (CURRICULUM.length - 1)));
      var score = Math.min(100, Math.round(rawScore + taperBonus));
      if(score > scores[currentIndex]) scores[currentIndex] = score;

      showFeedback(score);

    }catch(err){
      console.error(err);
      statusEl.textContent = "Something went wrong. Please try again.";
      submitBtn.disabled = false;
      preSkipBtn.style.display = "block";
    }

  });

  function showFeedback(score){
    cardEl.style.display = "none";
    feedbackEl.style.display = "block";
    feedbackScoreEl.textContent = score + "%";

    var passed = score >= PASS_MARK;
    feedbackMsgEl.textContent = passed
      ? passMessages[Math.floor(Math.random()*passMessages.length)]
      : encourageMessages[Math.floor(Math.random()*encourageMessages.length)];

    tryAgainBtn.style.display = "inline-block";
    nextBtn.textContent = passed ? "Next" : "Nah, I'm good";
  }

  tryAgainBtn.addEventListener("click", function(){
    submitBtn.disabled = false;
    renderItem(currentIndex);
  });

  function advanceItem(){
    submitBtn.disabled = false;
    currentIndex++;
    if(currentIndex >= CURRICULUM.length){
      showFinal();
    } else {
      renderItem(currentIndex);
    }
  }

  nextBtn.addEventListener("click", advanceItem);

  function showFinal(){
    try{ if(window.SayBonActivity) window.SayBonActivity.complete("game_complete"); }catch(e){}
    missionEl.querySelector(".ms-topbar").style.display = "none";
    cardEl.style.display = "none";
    feedbackEl.style.display = "none";
    finalEl.style.display = "block";

    var avg = Math.round(scores.reduce(function(a,b){return a+b;},0) / scores.length);
    var passed = avg >= PASS_MARK;

    finalScoreEl.textContent = avg + "%";
    finalPassEl.textContent = passed
      ? "Pass mark: " + PASS_MARK + "% - You passed!"
      : "Pass mark: " + PASS_MARK + "% - Not quite yet.";
    finalPassEl.style.color = passed ? "#3f9f3f" : "#c23e3e";

    playHypeVideo();
  }

  function playHypeVideo(){
    var lastShown = localStorage.getItem("tkHypeLastShown");
    var nextAsset = lastShown === "1" ? "mission-complete-hype-2" : "mission-complete-hype-1";
    var nextFlag = lastShown === "1" ? "2" : "1";

    var url = assetMap[nextAsset];
    if(!url) return;

    var hypeWrap = document.getElementById("msHypeVideo");
    var hypeVideo = document.getElementById("msHypeVideoEl");
    var hypeClose = document.getElementById("msHypeClose");

    hypeVideo.src = url;
    hypeWrap.style.display = "block";
    hypeVideo.play().catch(function(){});

    hypeVideo.addEventListener("click", function(){
      hypeVideo.muted = !hypeVideo.muted;
    });
    hypeClose.addEventListener("click", function(){
      hypeVideo.pause();
      hypeWrap.style.display = "none";
    });
    hypeVideo.addEventListener("ended", function(){
      hypeWrap.style.display = "none";
    });

    localStorage.setItem("tkHypeLastShown", nextFlag);
  }

  retakeBtn.addEventListener("click", function(){
    currentIndex = 0;
    scores = new Array(CURRICULUM.length).fill(0);
    missionEl.querySelector(".ms-topbar").style.display = "flex";
    finalEl.style.display = "none";
    renderItem(0);
  });

  // ===== Guide intro screen =====
  function startMission(){
    var guideAudio = document.getElementById("msGuideAudio");
    guideAudio.pause();
    document.getElementById("msGuideAvatarBtn").classList.remove("ms-guide-active");

    document.getElementById("msGuideIntro").style.display = "none";
    missionEl.style.display = "flex";
    missionEl.style.flexDirection = "column";
    missionEl.style.alignItems = "center";
    renderItem(0);
  }

  function showGuideIntro(){
    preloaderEl.classList.add("ms-preloader-fadeout");
    setTimeout(function(){
      preloaderEl.style.display = "none";
      document.getElementById("msGuideIntro").style.display = "flex";
    }, 600);
  }

  function setupGuideHelp(){
    var avatarImg = document.getElementById("msGuideAvatarImg");
    var avatarBtn = document.getElementById("msGuideAvatarBtn");
    var guideAudio = document.getElementById("msGuideAudio");
    var startBtn = document.getElementById("msGuideStartBtn");
    var skipBtn = document.getElementById("msGuideSkipBtn");

    if(assetMap["guide-photo"]){
      avatarImg.src = assetMap["guide-photo"];
    }
    if(assetMap["guide-instructions"]){
      guideAudio.src = assetMap["guide-instructions"];
    }

    avatarBtn.addEventListener("click", function(){
      if(!guideAudio.src) return;
      if(guideAudio.paused){
        guideAudio.currentTime = 0;
        guideAudio.play();
        avatarBtn.classList.add("ms-guide-active");
      } else {
        guideAudio.pause();
        avatarBtn.classList.remove("ms-guide-active");
      }
    });
    guideAudio.addEventListener("ended", function(){
      avatarBtn.classList.remove("ms-guide-active");
    });

    startBtn.addEventListener("click", startMission);
    skipBtn.addEventListener("click", startMission);
  }

  // ===== Init: load assets, run preloader with mobile-safe fallback =====
  async function init(){

    try{
      var res = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/assets");
      var assets = await res.json();
      assets.forEach(function(a){ assetMap[a.name] = a.url; });
    }catch(err){
      console.error(err);
    }

    if(assetMap["mission-preloader"]){
      preloaderVideo.src = assetMap["mission-preloader"];
      preloaderVideo.muted = true;
      preloaderVideo.defaultMuted = true;
      preloaderNote.style.display = "none";
      preloaderVideo.load();

      var advanced = false;
      var safeAdvance = function(){
        if(advanced) return;
        advanced = true;
        showGuideIntro();
      };

      var attemptPlay = function(){
        preloaderVideo.play().catch(function(){});
      };
      attemptPlay();
      preloaderVideo.addEventListener("canplay", attemptPlay);
      preloaderVideo.addEventListener("ended", safeAdvance);

      setTimeout(function(){

        }
      }, 1800);

    } else {

      setTimeout(showGuideIntro, 1500);
    }

    setupGuideHelp();

  }

  init();

})();

===== FILE: public\talkletics\map.js (4751 bytes) =====
(function(){

  var API_BASE = "https://saybonapp-server.onrender.com";

  var ROW_HEIGHT = 150;
  var TOP_PADDING = 90;
  var BOTTOM_PADDING = 90;
  var RUNOFF = 160;

  var X_DESKTOP = { left: 60, right: 340, center: 200 };
  var X_MOBILE  = { left: 140, right: 260, center: 200 };

  function slugify(name){
    return name.toLowerCase().trim().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-").replace(/(^-|-$)/g, "");
  }

  function buildLayout(locations){

    var n = locations.length;
    var containerHeight = TOP_PADDING + BOTTOM_PADDING + Math.max(0, n - 1) * ROW_HEIGHT;

    var nodesEl = document.getElementById("tkmNodes");
    nodesEl.style.height = containerHeight + "px";

    var points = [];

    for(var i = 0; i < n; i++){
      var top = TOP_PADDING + i * ROW_HEIGHT;
      var side;
      if(i === 0){
        side = "center";
      } else {
        side = (i % 2 === 1) ? "left" : "right";
      }
      points.push({ top: top, side: side, loc: locations[i] });
    }

    renderNodes(points);
    renderPath(points, containerHeight);

  }

  function renderNodes(points){

    var nodesEl = document.getElementById("tkmNodes");
    nodesEl.innerHTML = "";

    points.forEach(function(p, tkmIndex){

      var loc = p.loc;

      var btn = document.createElement("button");
      btn.className = "tkm-node " + (loc.unlocked ? "tkm-node-unlocked" : "tkm-node-locked");
      btn.setAttribute("data-side", p.side);
      btn.setAttribute("data-location-id", loc.id);
      btn.style.top = p.top + "px";
      if(!loc.unlocked){
        btn.tabIndex = -1;
      }

      var badge = document.createElement("span");
      badge.className = "tkm-node-badge";
      badge.textContent = String(loc.order).padStart(2, "0");

      var img = document.createElement("img");
      img.className = "tkm-node-img";
      img.src = loc.imageUrl;
      img.alt = loc.name;

      btn.appendChild(badge);
      btn.appendChild(img);

      if(loc.unlocked){
        btn.addEventListener("click", function(){
          window.location.href = slugify(loc.name) + ".html";
        });
      }

      nodesEl.appendChild(btn);

      setTimeout(function(){ btn.classList.add("tkm-node-visible"); }, tkmIndex * 90);

    });

  }

  function pathD(points, xmap){

    if(points.length === 0) return "";

    var firstX = xmap[points[0].side];
    var entryY = points[0].top - RUNOFF;
    var entryMid = points[0].top - RUNOFF / 2;

    var d = "M" + firstX + "," + entryY;
    d += " C" + firstX + "," + entryMid + " " + firstX + "," + entryMid + " " + firstX + "," + points[0].top;

    for(var i = 1; i < points.length; i++){
      var prev = points[i-1];
      var cur = points[i];
      var x0 = xmap[prev.side];
      var y0 = prev.top;
      var x1 = xmap[cur.side];
      var y1 = cur.top;
      var midY = (y0 + y1) / 2;
      d += " C" + x0 + "," + midY + " " + x1 + "," + midY + " " + x1 + "," + y1;
    }

    var last = points[points.length - 1];
    var lastX = xmap[last.side];
    var tailY = last.top + (RUNOFF * 0.5);
    var tailMid = last.top + (RUNOFF * 0.25);

    d += " C" + lastX + "," + tailMid + " " + lastX + "," + tailMid + " " + lastX + "," + tailY;

    return d;

  }

  function renderPath(points, containerHeight){

    var minY = -RUNOFF;
    var vbHeight = containerHeight + RUNOFF + (RUNOFF * 0.5);
    var viewBox = "0 " + minY + " 400 " + vbHeight;

    document.getElementById("tkmPathDesktop").setAttribute("viewBox", viewBox);
    document.getElementById("tkmPathMobile").setAttribute("viewBox", viewBox);
    document.getElementById("tkmPathDesktop").style.height = vbHeight + "px";
    document.getElementById("tkmPathMobile").style.height = vbHeight + "px";

    var dDesktop = pathD(points, X_DESKTOP);
    var dMobile = pathD(points, X_MOBILE);

    document.getElementById("tkmPathBgDesktop").setAttribute("d", dDesktop);
    document.getElementById("tkmPathLineDesktop").setAttribute("d", dDesktop);
    document.getElementById("tkmPathBgMobile").setAttribute("d", dMobile);
    document.getElementById("tkmPathLineMobile").setAttribute("d", dMobile);

  }

  async function loadLocations(){

    var nodesEl = document.getElementById("tkmNodes");

    try{

      var res = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/locations");
      var locations = await res.json();

      if(!locations.length){
        nodesEl.innerHTML = "<p style='text-align:center;color:#0d2a4d;font-weight:700;padding:40px;'>No locations yet. Check back soon!</p>";
        return;
      }

      buildLayout(locations);

    }catch(err){
      console.error(err);
      nodesEl.innerHTML = "<p style='text-align:center;color:#0d2a4d;font-weight:700;padding:40px;'>Could not load the map. Please try again.</p>";
    }

  }

  loadLocations();

})();

function encodeWAV(samples, rate) {
  var b = new ArrayBuffer(44 + samples.length * 2), v = new DataView(b);
  function w(o, s) { for (var i = 0; i < s.length; i++) v.setUint8(o + i, s.charCodeAt(i)); }
  w(0, "RIFF"); v.setUint32(4, 36 + samples.length * 2, true); w(8, "WAVE"); w(12, "fmt ");
  v.setUint32(16, 16, true); v.setUint16(20, 1, true); v.setUint16(22, 1, true);
  v.setUint32(24, rate, true); v.setUint32(28, rate * 2, true); v.setUint16(32, 2, true); v.setUint16(34, 16, true);
  w(36, "data"); v.setUint32(40, samples.length * 2, true);
  for (var i = 0, o = 44; i < samples.length; i++, o += 2) {
    var s = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, samples[i])); v.setInt16(o, s < 0 ? s * 0x8000 : s * 0x7fff, true);
  }
  return b;
}
async function toWav(blob) {
  var ctx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
  var dec = await ctx.decodeAudioData(await blob.arrayBuffer());
  var off = new OfflineAudioContext(1, Math.ceil(dec.duration * 16000), 16000);
  var src = off.createBufferSource(); src.buffer = dec; src.connect(off.destination); src.start(0);
  var out = await off.startRendering(); ctx.close();
  return encodeWAV(out.getChannelData(0), 16000);
}
function speak(text) {
  if (!window.speechSynthesis) return;
  speechSynthesis.cancel();
  var u = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text); u.lang = "fr-FR"; u.rate = 0.9; speechSynthesis.speak(u);
}

// ---------- media ----------
function mediaHTML(item) {
  var m = item.media; if (!m) return "";
  var a = assets[m.key];
  var url = a && a.url;
  if (m.type === "audio") {
    return '<div class="pl-media"><button class="pl-play" data-say="' + esc(m.transcript) + '"' + (url ? ' data-url="' + esc(url) + '"' : "") + '>🔊 Écouter</button></div>';
  }
  if (m.type === "image") {
    if (url) return '<div class="pl-media"><img src="' + esc(url) + '" alt=""></div>';
    return '<div class="pl-media"><div class="pl-ph"><span class="ic">' + esc(m.icon || "🖼️") + '</span><small>' + esc(m.description) + '</small></div></div>';
  }
  if (m.type === "video") {
    var inner = url ? '<video src="' + esc(url) + '" controls playsinline></video>'
      : '<div class="pl-ph"><span class="ic">' + esc(m.icon || "🎬") + '</span><small>' + esc(m.description || "") + '</small></div>';
    return '<div class="pl-media">' + inner + (m.transcript ? '<button class="pl-play" data-say="' + esc(m.transcript) + '">🔊 Écouter</button>' : "") + "</div>";
  }
  return "";
}
function wirePlay(root) {
  root.querySelectorAll(".pl-play").forEach(function (b) {
    b.onclick = function () {
      if (b.dataset.url) { var au = new Audio(b.dataset.url); au.play().catch(function () { speak(b.dataset.say); }); }
      else speak(b.dataset.say);
    };
  });
}

// ---------- item screen ----------
function render() {
  var item = game.items[idx];
  document.getElementById("plCount").textContent = (idx + 1) + "/" + game.items.length;
  document.getElementById("plBarFill").style.width = (idx / game.items.length * 100) + "%";
  lastScore = null;
  var h = '<div class="pl-card">' + mediaHTML(item);
  if (item.mode === "ref") {
    h += '<p class="pl-fr">' + (item.showText !== false ? esc(item.expected) : "🎧") + '</p><p class="pl-en">' + esc(item.en) + "</p>";
    if (item.media && item.media.type === "image") h += '<p class="pl-task">Dites ce que vous voyez. <small>(' + esc(item.en) + ")</small></p>";
  } else {
    h += '<p class="pl-task">' + esc(item.task) + "</p>";
    if (item.en && item.media && item.media.type !== "image") h += '<p class="pl-en">' + esc(item.en) + "</p>";
    if (item.must && item.must.length) h += '<div class="pl-must">' + item.must.map(function (m) { return "<span>" + esc(m) + "</span>"; }).join("") + "</div>";
    h += '<p class="pl-en" style="margin-top:8px"><small>' + item.min + "–" + item.max + " s</small></p>";
  }
  h += '</div><div class="pl-rec"><button class="pl-mic" id="plMic" aria-label="Record">🎤</button><div class="pl-status" id="plStatus">Appuyez pour parler</div></div><div id="plResult"></div>';
  main.innerHTML = h;
  wirePlay(main);
  document.getElementById("plMic").onclick = toggleRec;
  if (item.media && item.media.type === "audio" && !assets[item.media.key]) setTimeout(function () { speak(item.media.transcript); }, 400);
  else if (item.media && item.media.type === "video" && item.media.transcript) setTimeout(function () { speak(item.media.transcript); }, 400);
  else if (item.voice) setTimeout(function () { speak(item.voice); }, 400);
}

async function toggleRec() {
  if (busy) return;
  var mic = document.getElementById("plMic"), st = document.getElementById("plStatus");
  if (rec && rec.state === "recording") { stopRec(); return; }
  try {
    speechSynthesis && speechSynthesis.cancel();
    stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true });
  } catch (e) { st.textContent = "Microphone bloqué - autorisez-le dans le navigateur."; return; }
  chunks = []; rec = new MediaRecorder(stream);
  rec.ondataavailable = function (e) { if (e.data.size) chunks.push(e.data); };
  rec.onstop = onStopped;
  rec.start(); startedAt = Date.now();
  mic.classList.add("rec"); mic.textContent = "⏹";
  var max = game.items[idx].mode === "free" ? game.items[idx].max : 15;
  var tick = function () {
    var s = Math.round((Date.now() - startedAt) / 1000);
    st.textContent = "Enregistrement… " + s + " s";
    if (s >= max) stopRec();
  };
  tick(); timer = setInterval(tick, 500);
}
function stopRec() {
  clearInterval(timer);
  if (rec && rec.state === "recording") rec.stop();
}
async function onStopped() {
  stream && stream.getTracks().forEach(function (t) { t.stop(); });
  var mic = document.getElementById("plMic"), st = document.getElementById("plStatus");
  mic.classList.remove("rec"); mic.textContent = "🎤";
  if (Date.now() - startedAt < 600) { st.textContent = "Trop court. Réessayez."; return; }
  busy = true; st.textContent = "Analyse en cours…";
  try {
    var wav = await toWav(new Blob(chunks));
    var item = game.items[idx];
    var r = await fetch(API + "/api/talkleticsGradeSpeaking?gameId=" + encodeURIComponent(game.id) + "&itemId=" + encodeURIComponent(item.id), {
      method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "audio/wav", Authorization: "Bearer " + await token() }, body: wav
    });
    var d = await r.json();
    if (!r.ok) { st.textContent = d.error || "Erreur. Réessayez."; busy = false; return; }
    best[item.id] = Math.max(best[item.id] || 0, d.best != null ? d.best : d.score);
    lastScore = d; st.textContent = ""; showResult(d);
  } catch (e) { console.error(e); st.textContent = "Quelque chose a mal tourné. Réessayez."; }
  busy = false;
}

function showResult(d) {
  var pass = d.score >= game.passMark, last = idx === game.items.length - 1;
  var h = '<div class="pl-card"><div class="pl-score ' + (pass ? "pass" : "fail") + '">' + d.score + "%</div>" +
    '<p class="pl-said">« ' + esc(d.recognizedText) + " »</p>";
  if (d.tip) h += '<p class="pl-fb">💡 ' + esc(d.tip) + "</p>";
  if (d.missing && d.missing.length) h += '<p class="pl-fb">À ajouter : ' + d.missing.map(esc).join(" · ") + "</p>";
  if (d.note) h += '<p class="pl-fb">' + esc(d.note) + "</p>";
  h += '<div class="pl-actions"><button class="pl-btn sec" id="plRetry">Réessayer</button><button class="pl-btn" id="plNext">' +
    (last ? "Terminer" : "Suivant") + "</button></div></div>";
  document.getElementById("plResult").innerHTML = h;
  document.getElementById("plRetry").onclick = function () { document.getElementById("plResult").innerHTML = ""; document.getElementById("plStatus").textContent = "Appuyez pour parler"; };
  document.getElementById("plNext").onclick = function () { if (last) summary(); else { idx++; render(); } };
}

async function summary() {
  var scores = {}; scores[game.id] = best;
  var avg = gameAvg(game, scores), done = gameDone(game, scores), st = stars(game, scores);
  document.getElementById("plBarFill").style.width = "100%";
  var nx = nextGame(game);
  var h = '<div class="pl-card"><div class="pl-stars">' + (done ? "★".repeat(st) + "☆".repeat(3 - st) : "☆☆☆") + "</div>" +
    '<div class="pl-score ' + (done ? "pass" : "fail") + '">' + avg + '%</div><p class="pl-en">' +
    (done ? (game.isGraduation ? "🎓 Bravo ! Niveau validé !" : "Bravo ! Jeu réussi.") : "Il faut " + game.passMark + "% pour réussir. Refaites les réponses les plus faibles.") +
    '</p><ul class="pl-sum" style="list-style:none;padding:0">' +
    game.items.map(function (it, i) { return "<li><span>" + (i + 1) + ". " + esc((it.expected || it.task || "").slice(0, 38)) + "</span><b>" + (best[it.id] || 0) + "%</b></li>"; }).join("") +
    '</ul><div class="pl-actions"><button class="pl-btn sec" id="plAgain">Rejouer</button>' +
    (done && nx ? '<button class="pl-btn" id="plGo">Jeu suivant</button>' : '<button class="pl-btn" id="plMap">Le voyage</button>') + "</div></div>";
  main.innerHTML = h;
  document.getElementById("plAgain").onclick = function () { idx = 0; render(); };
  var go = document.getElementById("plGo");
  if (go) go.onclick = function () { location.href = "play.html?game=" + nx.id + (q.get("preview") ? "&preview=1" : ""); };
  var mp = document.getElementById("plMap");
  if (mp) mp.onclick = function () { location.href = "journey.html" + (q.get("preview") ? "?preview=1" : ""); };
}

(function(){

  var API_BASE = "https://saybonapp-server.onrender.com";
  var TIME_KEY = "tkAudioTime";
  var MUTED_KEY = "tkAudioMuted";
  var UNLOCKED_KEY = "tkAudioUnlocked";

  var audio = document.createElement("audio");
  audio.loop = true;
  audio.style.display = "none";
  document.body.appendChild(audio);

  var muteBtn = document.createElement("button");
  muteBtn.setAttribute("aria-label", "Toggle music");
  muteBtn.style.cssText = "position:fixed;bottom:14px;right:14px;width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(20,30,50,.55);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.3);color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:pointer;z-index:999;font-size:18px;";

  function updateMuteIcon(){
    muteBtn.textContent = audio.muted ? "\uD83D\uDD07" : "\uD83D\uDD0A";
  }

  function findBackgroundMusic(){
    return fetch(API_BASE + "/api/assets")
      .then(function(res){ return res.json(); })
      .then(function(assets){
        return assets.find(function(a){
          return a.type === "audio" && a.name.toLowerCase() === "background-music";
        });
      })
      .catch(function(){ return null; });
  }

  function attemptPlay(){
    var playPromise = audio.play();
    if(playPromise !== undefined){
      playPromise.catch(function(){
        // autoplay blocked - wait for the mute button tap to unlock
      });
    }
  }

  findBackgroundMusic().then(function(asset){

    if(!asset) return;

    audio.src = asset.url;

    var savedTime = parseFloat(sessionStorage.getItem(TIME_KEY) || "0");
    var savedMuted = sessionStorage.getItem(MUTED_KEY) === "true";
    var unlocked = sessionStorage.getItem(UNLOCKED_KEY) === "true";

    audio.muted = savedMuted;
    updateMuteIcon();

    audio.addEventListener("loadedmetadata", function(){
      if(savedTime > 0 && savedTime < audio.duration){
        audio.currentTime = savedTime;
      }
      if(unlocked){
        attemptPlay();
      }
    });

    setInterval(function(){
      if(!audio.paused){
        sessionStorage.setItem(TIME_KEY, String(audio.currentTime));
      }
    }, 2000);

    window.addEventListener("pagehide", function(){
      sessionStorage.setItem(TIME_KEY, String(audio.currentTime));
    });

    muteBtn.addEventListener("click", function(){
      sessionStorage.setItem(UNLOCKED_KEY, "true");
      if(audio.paused){
        attemptPlay();
      }
      audio.muted = !audio.muted;
      sessionStorage.setItem(MUTED_KEY, String(audio.muted));
      updateMuteIcon();
    });

    document.body.appendChild(muteBtn);

  });

})();

===== FILE: public\talkletics\tk-common.js (2667 bytes) =====
// Shared helpers for the Talkletics journey. Loaded as an ES module.
import { auth } from "/js/firebase-init.js";
import { onAuthStateChanged } from "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.0/firebase-auth.js";

export const API = "https://saybonapp-server.onrender.com";
export const CUR = window.TK_CURRICULUM;

export function whenUser() {
  return new Promise(function (resolve) {
    var off = onAuthStateChanged(auth, function (u) { off(); resolve(u); });
  });
}
export async function token() { return auth.currentUser ? auth.currentUser.getIdToken() : null; }

export async function loadProgress() {
  try {
    var t = await token();
    var r = await fetch(API + "/api/talkleticsProgress", { headers: { Authorization: "Bearer " + t } });
    if (!r.ok) return {};
    return (await r.json()).scores || {};
  } catch (e) { return {}; }
}

export async function loadAssets() {
  var map = {};
  try {
    var r = await fetch(API + "/api/assets");
    (await r.json()).forEach(function (a) { map[a.name] = a; });
  } catch (e) {}
  return map;
}

// avg of best item scores (missing item = 0)
export function gameAvg(game, scores) {
  var s = scores[game.id] || {};
  var sum = 0;
  game.items.forEach(function (it) { sum += s[it.id] || 0; });
  return Math.round(sum / game.items.length);
}
export function gameDone(game, scores) {
  var s = scores[game.id] || {};
  var all = game.items.every(function (it) { return s[it.id] != null; });
  return all && gameAvg(game, scores) >= game.passMark;
}
export function stars(game, scores) {
  if (!gameDone(game, scores)) return 0;
  var a = gameAvg(game, scores), span = 100 - game.passMark;
  return a >= game.passMark + span * 0.75 ? 3 : a >= game.passMark + span * 0.4 ? 2 : 1;
}
// returns {unlocked, done, avg, stars}
export function status(level, game, scores, unlockAll) {
  var li = CUR.levels.indexOf(level);
  var levelOpen = unlockAll || li === 0 || gameDone(CUR.levels[li - 1].graduation, scores);
  var open = false;
  if (levelOpen) {
    if (game.isGraduation) open = level.games.every(function (g) { return gameDone(g, scores); });
    else open = game.index === 1 || gameDone(level.games[game.index - 2], scores);
  }
  if (unlockAll) open = true;
  return { unlocked: open, done: gameDone(game, scores), avg: gameAvg(game, scores), stars: stars(game, scores) };
}
export function nextGame(game) {
  var all = CUR.allGames();
  var i = all.findIndex(function (g) { return g.id === game.id; });
  return all[i + 1] || null;
}
export function esc(s) {
  return String(s == null ? "" : s).replace(/[&<>"]/g, function (c) { return { "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;" }[c]; });
}

/* ===== OVERVIEW TAB ===== */

async function loadOverview(){

  const res = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/adminOverview");
  const data = await res.json();

  const grid = document.getElementById("statGrid");
  grid.innerHTML = "";

  const cards = [
    { label: "Total Revenue", value: "$" + data.totalRevenue.toFixed(2), cls: "stat-gold" },
    { label: "Open Jobs", value: data.openJobs, sub: data.totalJobs + " total jobs" },
    { label: "Awaiting Review", value: data.awaitingReview, cls: data.awaitingReview > 0 ? "stat-red" : "" },
    { label: "Approved Translators", value: data.approvedTranslators, sub: data.totalTranslators + " total applicants", cls: "stat-green" },
    { label: "Pending Payouts", value: "$" + data.pendingPayoutTotal.toFixed(2), cls: "stat-red" },
    { label: "Paid Out to Date", value: "$" + data.paidPayoutTotal.toFixed(2), cls: "stat-green" }
  ];

  cards.forEach(c=>{
    const card = document.createElement("div");
    card.className = "stat-card";
    card.innerHTML =
      "<div class='stat-label'>" + c.label + "</div>" +
      "<div class='stat-value " + (c.cls||"") + "'>" + c.value + "</div>" +
      (c.sub ? "<div class='stat-sub'>" + c.sub + "</div>" : "");
    grid.appendChild(card);
  });

}


/* ===== JOBS TAB ===== */

async function loadJobs(){

const snapshot=await db.collection("translationJobs").get();

const table=document.getElementById("jobs");

table.innerHTML="";

snapshot.forEach(doc=>{

const job=doc.data();

const row=document.createElement("tr");

row.innerHTML=`

<td>${doc.id}</td>
<td>${job.wordCount||"-"}</td>
<td>${job.plan||"-"}</td>
<td>${job.status||"-"}</td>

<td class="actions">

<button onclick="viewJob('${doc.id}')">View</button>

<button class="btn-complete" onclick="completeJob('${doc.id}')">Complete</button>

</td>

`;

table.appendChild(row);

});

}

function viewJob(id){

alert("Open job: "+id);

}

async function completeJob(id){

await db.collection("translationJobs")
.doc(id)
.update({
status:"completed"
});

alert("Job marked complete");

loadJobs();

}


/* ===== SUBMISSIONS TAB ===== */

async function loadSubmissions(){

const res = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/adminSubmissions");
const submissions = await res.json();

const table = document.getElementById("submissions");
table.innerHTML = "";

if(!submissions.length){
  table.innerHTML = "<tr><td colspan='7' class='empty-note'>No submissions yet.</td></tr>";
  return;
}

submissions.forEach(s=>{

const row = document.createElement("tr");

const statusBadge = s.reviewed
  ? "<span class='badge badge-reviewed'>Reviewed - Rank " + s.rank + (s.passed ? " (Passed)" : " (Failed)") + "</span>"
  : "<span class='badge badge-unreviewed'>Awaiting Review</span>";

const flags = [];

if(s.keystrokeCount === 0){
  flags.push("<span style='color:#e08585;font-weight:600;'>⚠ No keystrokes detected</span>");
}

if(s.timeTakenSeconds > 0 && s.jobWordCount > 0 && s.timeTakenSeconds < (s.jobWordCount * 0.3)){
  flags.push("<span style='color:#F0C77E;font-weight:600;'>⚠ Completed unusually fast (" + s.timeTakenSeconds + "s for " + s.jobWordCount + " words)</span>");
}

if(s.pasteAttempts > 0){
  flags.push("<span style='color:#F0C77E;font-weight:600;'>⚠ " + s.pasteAttempts + " blocked paste attempt(s)</span>");
}

if(s.tabSwitches > 2){
  flags.push("<span style='color:#8FA8A3;'>Switched tabs " + s.tabSwitches + "x</span>");
}

const flagsHtml = flags.length ? flags.join("<br>") : "<span style='color:#8FA8A3;'>No flags</span>";

row.innerHTML =
  "<td>" + (s.jobFile || s.jobId) + "<br><span style='color:#8FA8A3;font-size:10.5px;'>" + s.jobId + "</span></td>" +
  "<td>" + s.translator + "</td>" +
  "<td>" + (s.submitted ? new Date(s.submitted._seconds ? s.submitted._seconds*1000 : s.submitted).toLocaleString() : "-") + "</td>" +
  "<td><div class='translation-preview'>" + (s.translation || "").replace(/</g,"&lt;") + "</div></td>" +
  "<td style='font-size:11px;line-height:1.6;'>" + flagsHtml + "</td>" +
  "<td>" + statusBadge + "</td>" +
  "<td>" +
    "<select class='rank-select' id='rank-" + s.id + "'>" +
      "<option value='1'" + (s.rank===1?" selected":"") + ">1st</option>" +
      "<option value='2'" + (s.rank===2?" selected":"") + ">2nd</option>" +
      "<option value='3'" + (s.rank===3?" selected":"") + ">3rd</option>" +
    "</select>" +
    "<button class='btn-pass' onclick=\"reviewSubmission('" + s.id + "', true)\">Pass</button>" +
    "<button class='btn-fail' onclick=\"reviewSubmission('" + s.id + "', false)\">Fail</button>" +
  "</td>";

table.appendChild(row);

});

}

async function reviewSubmission(submissionId, passed){

const rank = Number(document.getElementById("rank-" + submissionId).value);

const res = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/reviewSubmission", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
  body: JSON.stringify({ submissionId, rank, passed })
});

const data = await res.json();

if(!res.ok){
  alert(data.error || "Could not review this submission.");
  return;
}

alert(passed ? ("Marked passed at rank " + rank + ". Payout: $" + data.amountOwed.toFixed(2)) : "Marked failed. No payout owed.");

loadSubmissions();
loadPayouts();
loadOverview();

}


/* ===== TRANSLATORS TAB ===== */

async function loadTranslators(){

const res = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/adminTranslators");
const translators = await res.json();

const table = document.getElementById("translators");
table.innerHTML = "";

if(!translators.length){
  table.innerHTML = "<tr><td colspan='6' class='empty-note'>No applications yet.</td></tr>";
  return;
}

translators.forEach(t=>{

const row = document.createElement("tr");

const statusBadge = t.passed
  ? "<span class='badge badge-passed'>Approved</span>"
  : "<span class='badge badge-failed'>Not Approved</span>";

const scoreText = t.finalScore !== undefined ? t.finalScore + "%" : "-";

let docsHtml = "<span style='color:#8FA8A3;font-size:11px;'>None on file</span>";

if(t.documents){
  const links = [];
  if(t.documents.id) links.push("<a class='doc-link' href='" + t.documents.id + "' target='_blank'>National ID</a>");
  if(t.documents.cv && t.documents.cv.length) links.push("<a class='doc-link' href='" + t.documents.cv[0] + "' target='_blank'>CV</a>");
  if(t.documents.certifications && t.documents.certifications.length) links.push("<a class='doc-link' href='" + t.documents.certifications[0] + "' target='_blank'>Certification</a>");
  if(links.length) docsHtml = links.join("");
}

row.innerHTML =
  "<td>" + (t.photoUrl ? "<img class='avatar-thumb' src='" + t.photoUrl + "'>" : "") + " " + (t.name || "(no name)") + "</td>" +
  "<td>" + t.email + "<br><span style='color:#8FA8A3;font-size:10.5px;'>" + (t.phone||"-") + " - " + (t.country||"-") + "</span></td>" +
  "<td>" + scoreText + "</td>" +
  "<td>" + statusBadge + "</td>" +
  "<td>" + (t.passkey || "<span style='color:#8FA8A3;'>-</span>") + "</td>" +
  "<td>" + docsHtml + "</td>";

table.appendChild(row);

});

}


/* ===== PAYOUTS TAB ===== */

async function loadPayouts(){

const res = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/adminPayouts");
const payouts = await res.json();

const table = document.getElementById("payouts");
table.innerHTML = "";

if(!payouts.length){
  table.innerHTML = "<tr><td colspan='7' class='empty-note'>No payouts yet.</td></tr>";
  return;
}

payouts.forEach(p=>{

const row = document.createElement("tr");

let pmHtml = "<span class='pm-missing'>No payment method on file</span>";

if(p.paymentMethod){
  const pm = p.paymentMethod;
  if(pm.method === "bank"){
    let lines = ["Bank: " + pm.bankName];
    if(pm.bankRegion === "us"){
      lines.push("Acct: " + pm.accountNumber);
      lines.push("Routing: " + pm.routingNumber);
    }else if(pm.bankRegion === "uk"){
      lines.push("Acct: " + pm.accountNumber);
      lines.push("Sort Code: " + pm.sortCode);
    }else if(pm.bankRegion === "international"){
      lines.push("IBAN: " + pm.iban);
    }else{
      lines.push("Acct: " + pm.accountNumber);
    }
    if(pm.swiftBic){
      lines.push("SWIFT: " + pm.swiftBic);
    }
    lines.push("Name: " + pm.accountName);
    pmHtml = "<div class='pm-details'>" + lines.join("<br>") + "</div>";
  } else {
    pmHtml = "<div class='pm-details'>" + pm.momoNetwork + "<br>" + pm.momoNumber + "</div>";
  }
}

const statusBadge = p.status === "paid"
  ? "<span class='badge badge-paid'>Paid</span>"
  : "<span class='badge badge-pending'>Pending</span>";

row.innerHTML =
  "<td>" + p.jobId + "</td>" +
  "<td>" + p.translatorPasskey + "</td>" +
  "<td>" + p.rank + (p.passed ? "" : " (Failed)") + "</td>" +
  "<td>$" + Number(p.amountOwed||0).toFixed(2) + "</td>" +
  "<td>" + pmHtml + "</td>" +
  "<td>" + statusBadge + "</td>" +
  "<td>" + (p.status === "paid" ? "-" : "<button class='btn-paid' onclick=\"markPaid('" + p.id + "')\">Mark as Paid</button>") + "</td>";

table.appendChild(row);

});

}

async function markPaid(payoutId){

const res = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/markPayoutPaid", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
  body: JSON.stringify({ payoutId })
});

if(!res.ok){
  alert("Could not mark this payout as paid.");
  return;
}

loadPayouts();
loadOverview();

}

===== FILE: public\translation\createJob.js (516 bytes) =====
const qs = new URLSearchParams(location.search)

const plan = qs.get("plan")
const words = qs.get("words")

document.getElementById("continueBtn").onclick = async ()=>{

  const res = await fetch(
    "https://saybonapp-server.onrender.com/api/createJob",
    {
      method:"POST",
      headers:{
        "Content-Type":"application/json"
      },
      body:JSON.stringify({
        words,
        plan
      })
    }
  )

  const job = await res.json()

  location.href =
  "/translation/job.html?id="+job.id

}

<script type="module">

import { db, auth } from "/js/firebase-init.js";
import { doc, getDoc, collection, getDocs } from "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.0/firebase-firestore.js";
import { onAuthStateChanged } from "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.0/firebase-auth.js";

const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
const jobId = params.get("job");
const adminKey = params.get("admin");

const STATUS_BADGE = {
  awaiting_payment: { label: "Awaiting Payment", color: "#9a8b7d" },
  open: { label: "Open", color: "#2f6f68" },
  claimed: { label: "Claimed", color: "#c9714f" },
  completed: { label: "Completed", color: "#3f8f5f" }
};

async function loadAllJobs(){

  document.getElementById("deskGrid").style.display = "none";
  document.getElementById("jobListPanel").style.display = "block";

  const listEl = document.getElementById("jobList");
  listEl.innerHTML = "";

  try{

    const snapshot = await getDocs(collection(db, "translationJobs"));

    if(snapshot.empty){
      listEl.innerHTML = "<div class=\"job-list-empty\">No jobs found.</div>";
      return;
    }

    const jobs = [];
    snapshot.forEach(docSnap => jobs.push({ id: docSnap.id, data: docSnap.data() }));

    jobs.sort((a, b) => {
      const aTime = a.data.createdAt && a.data.createdAt.toMillis ? a.data.createdAt.toMillis() : 0;
      const bTime = b.data.createdAt && b.data.createdAt.toMillis ? b.data.createdAt.toMillis() : 0;
      return bTime - aTime;
    });

    jobs.forEach(({ id, data }) => {

      const badge = STATUS_BADGE[data.status] || { label: data.status || "Unknown", color: "#9a8b7d" };

      const row = document.createElement("div");
      row.className = "job-list-item";
      row.onclick = () => { window.location.href = "/translation/desk.html?job=" + encodeURIComponent(id); };

      row.innerHTML =
        "<div class=\"job-list-left\">" +
          "<div class=\"job-list-code\">" + (data.jobId || id) + "</div>" +
          "<div class=\"job-list-meta\">" + (data.email || "-") + " · " + (data.wordCount ?? "-") + " words · $" + Number(data.price || 0).toFixed(2) + "</div>" +
        "</div>" +
        "<span class=\"job-list-badge\" style=\"background:" + badge.color + "\">" + badge.label + "</span>";

      listEl.appendChild(row);

    });

  }catch(err){
    console.error("ALL JOBS LOAD ERROR:", err);
    listEl.innerHTML = "<div class=\"job-list-empty\">There was a problem loading jobs.</div>";
  }

}


async function loadOtherJobs(email, currentJobId){
  try{
    const res = await fetch("https://saybonapp-server.onrender.com/api/jobsByEmail?email=" + encodeURIComponent(email) + "&excludeJobId=" + encodeURIComponent(currentJobId));
    const jobs = await res.json();
    if(!jobs || jobs.length === 0) return;

    const panel = document.getElementById("otherJobsPanel");
    const listEl = document.getElementById("otherJobsList");
    listEl.innerHTML = "";

    jobs.forEach(function(job){
      const badge = STATUS_BADGE[job.status] || { label: job.status || "Unknown", color: "#9a8b7d" };
      const row = document.createElement("div");
      row.className = "job-list-item";
      row.onclick = function(){ window.location.href = "/translation/desk.html?job=" + encodeURIComponent(job.jobId); };
      row.innerHTML =
        "<div class=\"job-list-left\">" +
          "<div class=\"job-list-code\">" + job.jobId + "</div>" +
          "<div class=\"job-list-meta\">" + job.plan + " · " + job.wordCount + " words · $" + Number(job.price).toFixed(2) + "</div>" +
        "</div>" +
        "<span class=\"job-list-badge\" style=\"background:" + badge.color + "\">" + badge.label + "</span>";
      listEl.appendChild(row);
    });

    panel.style.display = "block";
  }catch(err){
    console.error("OTHER JOBS LOAD ERROR:", err);
  }
}

function setStep(dotId, done){
  const el = document.getElementById(dotId);
  el.className = "step-dot " + (done ? "step-done" : "step-pending");
  el.innerHTML = done
    ? '<svg width="11" height="11" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"/></svg>'
    : "";
}

async function loadJob(){

  if(!jobId){
    document.getElementById("message").innerText = "No job code was provided.";
    return;
  }

  try{

    const jobSnap = await getDoc(doc(db, "translationJobs", jobId));

    if(!jobSnap.exists()){
      document.getElementById("message").innerText = "No job found for this code.";
      return;
    }

    const data = jobSnap.data();

    document.getElementById("job").innerText = data.jobId || jobId;
    document.getElementById("email").innerText = data.email || "-";
    document.getElementById("words").innerText = data.wordCount ?? "-";
    document.getElementById("language").innerText = data.targetLanguage || "-";
    document.getElementById("plan").innerText = data.plan || "-";
    document.getElementById("price").innerText = "$" + Number(data.price || 0).toFixed(2);

    const paid = data.paid === true;
    const status = data.status || "";

    setStep("dot1", paid);
    setStep("dot2", status === "open" || status === "claimed" || status === "completed");
    setStep("dot3", status === "claimed" || status === "completed");
    setStep("dot4", status === "completed");

    if(status === "completed"){
      document.getElementById("message").innerText = "Your translation is complete.";
    }else if(status === "claimed"){
      document.getElementById("message").innerText = "A translator is working on your document.";
    }else if(status === "open"){
      document.getElementById("message").innerText = "Your document is posted and waiting for a translator.";
    }else if(paid){
      document.getElementById("message").innerText = "Payment confirmed. Your job is being prepared.";
    }else{
      document.getElementById("message").innerText = "Awaiting payment confirmation.";
    }

    if(data.email){ loadOtherJobs(data.email, jobId); }

  }catch(err){
    console.error("DESK LOAD ERROR:", err);
    document.getElementById("message").innerText = "There was a problem loading this job.";
  }

}

if(adminKey === "true"){
  onAuthStateChanged(auth, async function(user){
    if(!user){ loadJob(); return; }
    try{
      const res = await fetch("https://saybonapp-server.onrender.com/api/accessControlCheck?email=" + encodeURIComponent(user.email || ""));
      const data = await res.json();
      if(data.authorized){ loadAllJobs(); } else { loadJob(); }
    }catch(err){ loadJob(); }
  });
}else{
  loadJob();
}

</script>

</body>
</html>

<script type="module">

import { segmentText } from "/translation/segment-engine.js";
import { db } from "/js/firebase-init.js";
import { doc, getDoc } from "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.0/firebase-firestore.js";

const API_BASE = "https://saybonapp-server.onrender.com";

const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
const jobId = params.get("job");

let translatorPasskey = sessionStorage.getItem("saybonTranslatorPasskey") || "";

const specialChars = [String.fromCharCode(233),String.fromCharCode(232),String.fromCharCode(234),String.fromCharCode(224),String.fromCharCode(231),String.fromCharCode(249),String.fromCharCode(244),String.fromCharCode(238),String.fromCharCode(339),String.fromCharCode(171),String.fromCharCode(187)];

function buildMiniKeyboard(targetTextarea){
  const row = document.createElement("div");
  row.className = "mini-keyboard";
  specialChars.forEach(ch => {
    const span = document.createElement("span");
    span.className = "key";
    span.textContent = ch;
    span.addEventListener("click", () => insertCharInto(targetTextarea, ch));
    row.appendChild(span);
  });
  return row;
}

function insertCharInto(textarea, ch){
  const start = textarea.selectionStart;
  const end = textarea.selectionEnd;
  const val = textarea.value;
  textarea.value = val.slice(0, start) + ch + val.slice(end);
  textarea.selectionStart = textarea.selectionEnd = start + ch.length;
  textarea.dispatchEvent(new Event("input"));
  textarea.focus();
}

function autoGrow(textarea){
  textarea.style.height = "auto";
  textarea.style.height = (textarea.scrollHeight + 2) + "px";
}

let segments = [];
const container = document.getElementById("segments");
const submitBtn = document.getElementById("submitBtn");

// ===== ANTI-CHEAT TRACKING =====
let keystrokeCount = 0;
let tabSwitches = 0;
let pasteAttempts = 0;
let startTime = null;

function ensureTimerStarted(){
  if(!startTime) startTime = Date.now();
}

document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", () => {
  if(document.hidden && startTime){
    tabSwitches++;
  }
});

window.togglePreview = function(){ var body = document.getElementById("previewBody"); var btn = document.getElementById("previewToggleBtn"); if(body.style.display === "none"){ body.style.display = "block"; btn.innerText = "Hide"; } else { body.style.display = "none"; btn.innerText = "Show"; } }; async function renderPreview(fileUrl, fileType){ var body = document.getElementById("previewBody"); if(!fileUrl){ body.innerHTML = (String.fromCharCode(60) + "div class=" + String.fromCharCode(34) + "preview-empty" + String.fromCharCode(34) + String.fromCharCode(62)) + "No original document was stored for this job." + "</div>"; return; } try{ if(fileType === "pdf"){ body.innerHTML = "<iframe src=" + JSON.stringify(fileUrl) + "></iframe>"; } else if(fileType === "docx"){ var resp = await fetch("https://saybonapp-server.onrender.com/api/proxyFile?url=" + encodeURIComponent(fileUrl)); var buf = await resp.arrayBuffer(); var result = await mammoth.convertToHtml({ arrayBuffer: buf }); body.innerHTML = "<div class=" + JSON.stringify("preview-body-html") + ">" + result.value + "</div>"; } else { var resp2 = await fetch("https://saybonapp-server.onrender.com/api/proxyFile?url=" + encodeURIComponent(fileUrl)); var txt = await resp2.text(); var pre = document.createElement("pre"); pre.textContent = txt; body.innerHTML = ""; body.appendChild(pre); } }catch(err){ console.error("PREVIEW RENDER ERROR:", err); body.innerHTML = "<div class=" + JSON.stringify("preview-empty") + ">Could not load a preview for this document.</div>"; } } function render(){

  container.innerHTML = "";

  segments.forEach(seg => {

    const row = document.createElement("div");
    row.className = "segment";

    const sourceDiv = document.createElement("div");
    sourceDiv.className = "source";
    sourceDiv.innerHTML = "<b>Segment " + seg.id + "</b><br><br>" + seg.source;

    const textarea = document.createElement("textarea");
    textarea.className = "edit";
    textarea.dataset.id = seg.id;
    textarea.placeholder = "Edit translation here";
    textarea.value = seg.edit;

    setTimeout(() => autoGrow(textarea), 0);

    textarea.addEventListener("keydown", () => {
      ensureTimerStarted();
      keystrokeCount++;
    });

    row.appendChild(sourceDiv);
    row.appendChild(textarea);
    row.appendChild(buildMiniKeyboard(textarea));
    container.appendChild(row);

  });

}

document.addEventListener("input", (e) => {
  if(e.target.classList.contains("edit")){
    const id = Number(e.target.dataset.id);
    const seg = segments.find(s => s.id === id);
    if(seg) seg.edit = e.target.value;
    autoGrow(e.target);
    updateProgress();
  }
});

function updateProgress(){
  if(!segments.length) return;
  const done = segments.filter(s => s.edit.trim().length > 0).length;
  const percent = Math.round((done / segments.length) * 100);
  document.getElementById("progress").innerText = "Progress: " + percent + "%";
  submitBtn.disabled = percent === 0;
}

let currentJobWordCount = 0;

async function loadJob(){

  if(!jobId){
    document.getElementById("jobmeta").innerText = "No job code was provided.";
    return;
  }

  try{

    const jobSnap = await getDoc(doc(db, "translationJobs", jobId));

    if(!jobSnap.exists()){
      document.getElementById("jobmeta").innerText = "No job found for this code.";
      return;
    }

    const data = jobSnap.data(); renderPreview(data.originalFileUrl, data.originalFileType);
    currentJobWordCount = data.wordCount || 0;

    document.getElementById("jobmeta").innerText =
      "Job " + (data.jobId || jobId) + "" + (data.sourceLanguage || "?") + " to " + (data.targetLanguage || "?") + " - " + (data.wordCount || 0) + " words";

    if(data.aiTranslationStatus === "completed" && Array.isArray(data.aiSegments) && data.aiSegments.length > 0){ segments = data.aiSegments.map(s => ({ id: s.id, source: s.source, edit: s.translation || "" })); } else { const text = data.documentText && data.documentText.trim().length > 0 ? data.documentText : null; if(!text){ document.getElementById("jobmeta").innerText += " (no source text stored)"; return; } segments = segmentText(text); document.getElementById("jobmeta").innerText += " - no AI draft, translate from source"; } render(); updateProgress();

  }catch(err){
    console.error("EDITOR LOAD ERROR:", err);
    document.getElementById("jobmeta").innerText = "There was a problem loading this job.";
  }

}

window.confirmPasskey = function(){

  const val = document.getElementById("passkeyInput").value.trim();
  const errorEl = document.getElementById("passkeyPromptError");

  if(!val){
    errorEl.innerText = "Please enter your passkey.";
    return;
  }

  translatorPasskey = val;
  sessionStorage.setItem("saybonTranslatorPasskey", translatorPasskey);

  document.getElementById("passkeyPrompt").style.display = "none";
  document.getElementById("workAreaContent").style.display = "block";

}

window.submitEdit = async function(){

  submitBtn.disabled = true;
  submitBtn.innerHTML = "<span class=\"submit-spinner\"></span>Saving...";

  try{

    const translation = segments.map(s => s.edit).join("\n");
    const timeTakenSeconds = startTime ? Math.round((Date.now() - startTime) / 1000) : 0;

    const res = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/submitTranslation", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        jobId: jobId,
        passkey: translatorPasskey,
        translation: translation,
        keystrokeCount: keystrokeCount,
        timeTakenSeconds: timeTakenSeconds,
        tabSwitches: tabSwitches,
        pasteAttempts: pasteAttempts
      })
    });

    const data = await res.json();

    if(!res.ok){
      alert(data.error || "Could not submit. Please try again.");
      submitBtn.disabled = false;
      submitBtn.innerText = "Proceed to Format";
      return;
    }

    window.location.href = "/translation/formatting-workspace.html?job=" + encodeURIComponent(jobId);

  }catch(err){
    alert("Could not submit. Please try again.");
    submitBtn.disabled = false;
    submitBtn.innerText = "Submit Editing";
  }

}

document.addEventListener("copy", e => e.preventDefault());
document.addEventListener("cut", e => e.preventDefault());
document.addEventListener("paste", e => { pasteAttempts++; e.preventDefault(); });
document.addEventListener("contextmenu", e => e.preventDefault());

if(translatorPasskey){
  document.getElementById("passkeyPrompt").style.display = "none";
  document.getElementById("workAreaContent").style.display = "block";
}

loadJob();

</script>

</body>
