<script>
const API_BASE = "https://saybonapp-server.onrender.com";
const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
const jobId = params.get("job");
const translatorPasskey = sessionStorage.getItem("saybonTranslatorPasskey") || "";
let quill = null; let currentFileType = ""; let currentJobId = ""; let currentSubmissionId = "";
async function renderOrigPreview(fileUrl, fileType){
  var body = document.getElementById("origPreview");
  if(!fileUrl){ body.innerHTML = "No original document available."; return; }
  try{
    if(fileType === "pdf"){
      body.innerHTML = "<iframe src=" + JSON.stringify(fileUrl) + "></iframe>";
    } else if(fileType === "docx"){
      var resp = await fetch(fileUrl);
      var buf = await resp.arrayBuffer();
      var result = await mammoth.convertToHtml({arrayBuffer: buf});
      body.innerHTML = "<div class=" + JSON.stringify("orig-preview-html") + ">" + result.value + "</div>";
    } else {
      var resp2 = await fetch(fileUrl);
      var txt = await resp2.text();
      var pre = document.createElement("pre");
      pre.textContent = txt;
      body.innerHTML = "";
      body.appendChild(pre);
    }
  }catch(err){
    console.error("PREVIEW ERROR:", err);
    body.innerHTML = "Could not load preview.";
  }
}
async function init(){
  if(!jobId || !translatorPasskey){
    document.getElementById("jobmeta").innerText = "Access denied - missing job or passkey.";
    return;
  }
  try{
    var res = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/checkFormattingAccess?jobId=" + encodeURIComponent(jobId) + "&passkey=" + encodeURIComponent(translatorPasskey));
    var data = await res.json();
    if(!data.hasAccess){
      document.getElementById("jobmeta").innerText = "You do not have formatting access for this job.";
      return;
    }
    document.getElementById("jobmeta").innerText = "Job: " + (data.clientFile || jobId) + " - " + data.targetLanguage;
    currentFileType = data.originalFileType; currentJobId = jobId; currentSubmissionId = data.submissionId; renderOrigPreview(data.originalFileUrl, data.originalFileType);
    quill = new Quill("#quillEditor", { theme: "snow" });
    quill.setText(data.translation || "");
    document.getElementById("submitFormattingBtn").disabled = false;
  }catch(err){
    console.error("INIT ERROR:", err);
    document.getElementById("jobmeta").innerText = "There was a problem loading this job.";
  }
}
document.getElementById("submitFormattingBtn").addEventListener("click", async function(){
  var btn = document.getElementById("submitFormattingBtn");
  var status = document.getElementById("formattingStatus");
  btn.disabled = true;
  status.innerText = "Generating final PDF...";
  try{
    var el = document.querySelector(".ql-editor");
    var pdfBlob = await html2pdf().from(el).outputPdf("blob");
    status.innerText = "Uploading final document...";
    var finalUrl = await window.uploadFormattedDocToStorage(pdfBlob, "pdf");
    status.innerText = "Grading your work...";
    var gradeRes = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/completeFormatting", { method: "POST", headers: {"Content-Type":"application/json"}, body: JSON.stringify({ submissionId: currentSubmissionId, finalDeliverableUrl: finalUrl }) });
    var gradeData = await gradeRes.json();
    if(gradeData.score){
      sessionStorage.setItem("saybonJustGraded", JSON.stringify({ passed: gradeData.score.passed, score: gradeData.score.finalScore, earned: gradeData.score.payoutAmount || 0, becameWinner: gradeData.score.becameWinner || false, claudeScore: gradeData.score.claudeScore, behavioralScore: gradeData.score.behavioralScore, claudeFeedback: gradeData.score.claudeFeedback }));
    }
    window.location.href = "/translation/job-board.html";
  }catch(err){
    console.error("SUBMIT ERROR:", err);
    status.innerText = "Could not submit. Please try again.";
    btn.disabled = false;
  }
});
init();

<script>

function openSettings(){
document.getElementById("settingsModal").style.display="flex"
}

function checkCode(){

let code=document.getElementById("adminCode").value

if(code==="963281"){

sessionStorage.setItem("saybonAdminVerified","true")
window.location="/translation/admin.html"

}else{

document.getElementById("error").innerText="Incorrect passcode"

}

}

function openDeskLookup(){
document.getElementById("deskModal").style.display="flex"
}

function goToDesk(){

let code=document.getElementById("deskCode").value.trim()

if(!code){
document.getElementById("deskError").innerText="Please enter your job code"
return
}

if(code==="963281"){
window.location="/translation/desk.html?admin=963281"
return
}

window.location="/translation/desk.html?job="+encodeURIComponent(code)

}

</script>

<script type="module">

import { db } from "../js/firebase-config.js";

import {
collection,
getDocs,
doc,
updateDoc,
query,
where
}
from "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.0/firebase-firestore.js";

let allJobs = [];
let activeFilter = "all";
let currentPage = 1;
const JOBS_PER_PAGE = 5;
let expandedJobId = null;

const DELIVERY_TABLE = [
  { maxWords:200,   standard:"1\u20133 hrs",   express:"30\u201360 mins" },
  { maxWords:500,   standard:"3\u20136 hrs",   express:"1\u20133 hrs" },
  { maxWords:1000,  standard:"6\u201312 hrs",  express:"3\u20136 hrs" },
  { maxWords:3000,  standard:"12\u201324 hrs", express:"6\u201312 hrs" },
  { maxWords:10000, standard:"2\u20134 days",  express:"24\u201348 hrs" }
];

function getExpectedDelivery(words, plan){
  const tier = DELIVERY_TABLE.find(t => words <= t.maxWords);
  if(!tier) return "Custom";
  return plan === "express" ? tier.express : tier.standard;
}

document.querySelectorAll(".nav-item[data-tab]").forEach(btn=>{
  btn.addEventListener("click", ()=>{
    document.querySelectorAll(".nav-item[data-tab]").forEach(b=>b.classList.remove("active"));
    btn.classList.add("active");
    document.querySelectorAll(".tab-content").forEach(p=>p.classList.remove("active"));
    document.getElementById("content-"+btn.dataset.tab).classList.add("active");
  });
});

document.querySelectorAll(".filter-pill").forEach(btn=>{
  btn.addEventListener("click", ()=>{
    document.querySelectorAll(".filter-pill").forEach(b=>b.classList.remove("active"));
    btn.classList.add("active");
    activeFilter = btn.dataset.filter;
    currentPage = 1;
    expandedJobId = null;
    renderJobs();
  });
});

document.getElementById("sortSelect").addEventListener("change", ()=>{
  currentPage = 1;
  expandedJobId = null;
  renderJobs();
});

function getFilteredSortedJobs(){

  let list = allJobs.slice();

  if(activeFilter === "editing") list = [];
  if(activeFilter === "standard") list = list.filter(j=>(j.data.plan||"standard")==="standard");
  if(activeFilter === "express") list = list.filter(j=>j.data.plan==="express");

  const sortVal = document.getElementById("sortSelect").value;
  if(sortVal === "price-high") list.sort((a,b)=>(b.data.price||0)-(a.data.price||0));
  else if(sortVal === "price-low") list.sort((a,b)=>(a.data.price||0)-(b.data.price||0));
  else list.sort((a,b)=>{
    const at = a.data.createdAt && a.data.createdAt.toMillis ? a.data.createdAt.toMillis() : 0;
    const bt = b.data.createdAt && b.data.createdAt.toMillis ? b.data.createdAt.toMillis() : 0;
    return bt - at;
  });

  return list;

}

function renderNewJobAlert(count){
  const el = document.getElementById("newJobAlert");
  if(count > 0){
    el.innerHTML =
      "<div class=\"new-job-alert\">" +
        "<svg viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"currentColor\" stroke-width=\"2\"><path d=\"m12 3 1.5 4.5L18 9l-4.5 1.5L12 15l-1.5-4.5L6 9l4.5-1.5z\"/></svg>" +
        "<div class=\"alert-text\"><div class=\"at1\">Brand new jobs available for bidding!</div><div class=\"at2\">Be the first to bid and win.</div></div>" +
        "<span class=\"blinker\"></span>" +
      "</div>";
  } else {
    el.innerHTML = "";
  }
}

  const slotsFilled = participants.length;
  let slotDotsHtml = "";
  for(let s=0; s<3; s++){
    slotDotsHtml += "<span class=\"exp-slot-dot" + (s < slotsFilled ? " filled" : "") + "\"></span>";
  }

  const div = document.createElement("div");
  div.className = "expanded-job";

  div.innerHTML =

      "<div><div class=\"exp-filename\">" + (data.clientFile||"Untitled document") + "</div><div class=\"exp-jobid\">" + (data.jobId||id) + "</div></div>" +
      "<div class=\"exp-right\">" +
        "<div class=\"exp-price\">$" + (price*0.6).toFixed(2) + "</div>" +
        "<div class=\"avail-badge\">Available</div>" +
        "<div class=\"exp-slots\">" + slotsFilled + "/3 slots filled</div>" +
        "<div class=\"exp-slot-dots\">" + slotDotsHtml + "</div>" +
      "</div>" +
    "</div>" +

    "<div class=\"exp-meta-row\">" +
      "<div class=\"exp-meta-item\"><svg viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"currentColor\" stroke-width=\"2\"><path d=\"M14 2H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v16a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V8z\"/><path d=\"M14 2v6h6\"/></svg><div><span class=\"eml\">Type</span><span class=\"emv\">Translation</span></div></div>" +
      "<div class=\"exp-meta-item\"><svg viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"currentColor\" stroke-width=\"2\"><path d=\"m5 8 6 6M4 14l6-6 2-3M2 5h12M7 2h1M22 22l-5-10-5 10M14 18h6\"/></svg><div><span class=\"eml\">Language</span><span class=\"emv\">" + (data.sourceLanguage||"?") + " \u2192 " + (data.targetLanguage||"?") + "</span></div></div>" +
      "<div class=\"exp-meta-item\"><svg viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"currentColor\" stroke-width=\"2\"><path d=\"M14 2H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v16a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V8z\"/><path d=\"M14 2v6h6M9 13h6M9 17h6\"/></svg><div><span class=\"eml\">Word Count</span><span class=\"emv\">" + words + "</span></div></div>" +
      "<div class=\"exp-meta-item\"><svg viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"currentColor\" stroke-width=\"2\"><circle cx=\"12\" cy=\"12\" r=\"10\"/><path d=\"M12 6v6l4 2\"/></svg><div><span class=\"eml\">Delivery</span><span class=\"emv\">" + expectedDelivery + "</span></div></div>" +
    "</div>" +

    "<div class=\"about-block\">" +
      "<h4>About this job</h4>" +
      "<p>Up to three translators/editors may participate in this assignment. Payment is based on submission order and passing quality review, not on comparing scores between participants.</p>" +

    "<div class=\"split-boxes\">" +
      "<div class=\"split-box\">" +
        "<h5>Payment by position</h5><div class=\"subh\">From stated job price</div>" +
        "<div class=\"payout-row\"><span>1st to Pass Review (60%)</span><span class=\"amt\">$" + (price*0.6).toFixed(2) + "</span></div>" +
        "<div class=\"payout-row\"><span>2nd to Pass Review (10%)</span><span class=\"amt\">$" + (price*0.1).toFixed(2) + "</span></div>" +
        "<div class=\"payout-row\"><span>3rd to Pass Review (10%)</span><span class=\"amt\">$" + (price*0.1).toFixed(2) + "</span></div>" +
        "<div class=\"payout-row\"><span>Fail (Below 85)</span><span class=\"amt\">$0.00</span></div>" +
      "</div>" +
      "<div class=\"split-box\">" +

function buildCompactRow({ id, data }){

  const words = data.wordCount || 0;
  const plan = data.plan || "standard";
  const priorityLabel = plan === "express" ? "Express" : "Standard";
  const expectedDelivery = getExpectedDelivery(words, plan);

  const div = document.createElement("div");
  div.className = "compact-row";
  div.onclick = ()=> selectJob(id);

  div.innerHTML =
    "<div class=\"compact-icon\"><svg viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"currentColor\" stroke-width=\"2\"><path d=\"M14 2H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v16a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V8z\"/><path d=\"M14 2v6h6\"/></svg></div>" +
    "<div class=\"compact-name\">" + (data.clientFile||"Untitled document") + "</div>" +
    "<div class=\"compact-meta\">Translation \u00b7 " + (data.sourceLanguage||"?") + " \u2192 " + (data.targetLanguage||"?") + " \u00b7 " + words + " words \u00b7 " + priorityLabel + " \u00b7 " + expectedDelivery + "</div>" +
    "<div class=\"compact-price\">$" + (Number(data.price||0)*0.6).toFixed(2) + "</div>" +
    "<div class=\"compact-see\">See more<svg viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"currentColor\" stroke-width=\"2\"><path d=\"m6 9 6 6 6-6\"/></svg></div>";

  return div;

}

function renderJobs(){

  const container = document.getElementById("jobs");
  container.innerHTML = "";

  const fullList = getFilteredSortedJobs();

  renderNewJobAlert(fullList.length);

  if(!fullList.length){
    container.innerHTML = "<div class=\"empty-state\">No jobs match this view right now.</div>";
    document.getElementById("pagination").innerHTML = "";
    updateNdaCard(null);
    return;
  }

  const totalPages = Math.ceil(fullList.length / JOBS_PER_PAGE);
  if(currentPage > totalPages) currentPage = totalPages;

  const pageStart = (currentPage - 1) * JOBS_PER_PAGE;
  const pageList = fullList.slice(pageStart, pageStart + JOBS_PER_PAGE);

  if(!expandedJobId || !pageList.find(j=>j.id===expandedJobId)){
    expandedJobId = pageList[0].id;
  }

  pageList.forEach(job=>{
    if(job.id === expandedJobId){
      container.appendChild(buildExpandedJob(job));
    } else {
      container.appendChild(buildCompactRow(job));
    }
  });

  renderPagination(totalPages);
  updateNdaCard(fullList.find(j=>j.id===expandedJobId));

}

function renderPagination(totalPages){

  const el = document.getElementById("pagination");
  el.innerHTML = "";

  if(totalPages <= 1) return;

  const prev = document.createElement("button");
  prev.className = "page-btn";
  prev.textContent = "\u2039";
  prev.disabled = currentPage === 1;
  prev.onclick = ()=>{ currentPage--; expandedJobId=null; renderJobs(); };
  el.appendChild(prev);

  for(let p=1; p<=totalPages; p++){
    const btn = document.createElement("button");
    btn.className = "page-btn" + (p===currentPage ? " active" : "");
    btn.textContent = p;
    btn.onclick = ()=>{ currentPage=p; expandedJobId=null; renderJobs(); };
    el.appendChild(btn);
  }

  const next = document.createElement("button");
  next.className = "page-btn";
  next.textContent = "\u203a";
  next.disabled = currentPage === totalPages;
  next.onclick = ()=>{ currentPage++; expandedJobId=null; renderJobs(); };
  el.appendChild(next);

}

let ndaModalJobId = null;

function updateNdaCard(job){
  const btn = document.getElementById("ndaAcceptBtn");
  if(!job){
    btn.disabled = true;
    btn.onclick = null;
    return;
  }
  btn.disabled = false;
  btn.onclick = ()=> openNdaModal(job.id);
}

function updateConfirmBtnState(){
  const passkey = document.getElementById("ndaPasskeyInput").value.trim();
  const agreed = document.getElementById("ndaAgreeCheckbox").checked;
  const original = document.getElementById("ndaOriginalWorkCheckbox").checked;
  document.getElementById("ndaConfirmBtn").disabled = !(passkey && agreed && original);
}

document.getElementById("ndaPasskeyInput").addEventListener("input", updateConfirmBtnState);
document.getElementById("ndaAgreeCheckbox").addEventListener("change", updateConfirmBtnState);
document.getElementById("ndaOriginalWorkCheckbox").addEventListener("change", updateConfirmBtnState);

function openNdaModal(jobId){
  ndaModalJobId = jobId;
  document.getElementById("ndaPasskeyInput").value = "";
  document.getElementById("ndaAgreeCheckbox").checked = false;
  document.getElementById("ndaOriginalWorkCheckbox").checked = false;
  document.getElementById("ndaModalError").innerText = "";
  updateConfirmBtnState();
  document.getElementById("ndaModal").style.display = "flex";
}

function closeNdaModal(){
  document.getElementById("ndaModal").style.display = "none";
  ndaModalJobId = null;
}

document.getElementById("ndaCancelBtn").addEventListener("click", closeNdaModal);

document.getElementById("ndaConfirmBtn").addEventListener("click", async ()=>{

  const passkey = document.getElementById("ndaPasskeyInput").value.trim();
  const agreed = document.getElementById("ndaAgreeCheckbox").checked;
  const original = document.getElementById("ndaOriginalWorkCheckbox").checked;
  const errorEl = document.getElementById("ndaModalError");
  const confirmBtn = document.getElementById("ndaConfirmBtn");

  if(!passkey || !agreed || !original){
    errorEl.innerText = "Please enter your passkey and check both boxes before continuing.";
    return;
  }

  confirmBtn.disabled = true;
  confirmBtn.innerText = "Submitting...";
  errorEl.innerText = "";

  try{

    const res = await fetch("https://saybonapp-server.onrender.com/api/acceptJobWithNda", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ jobId: ndaModalJobId, passkey: passkey, agreedToTerms: agreed, confirmedOriginalWork: original })
    });

    const data = await res.json();

    if(!res.ok){
      errorEl.innerText = data.error || "Could not accept this job. Please try again.";
      confirmBtn.disabled = false;
      confirmBtn.innerText = "I Agree & Accept Job";
      return;
    }

    document.getElementById("ndaModal").style.display = "none";
    document.getElementById("goToWorkspaceBtn").onclick = () => {
      window.location.href = "editor-workspace.html?job=" + encodeURIComponent(ndaModalJobId);
    };
    document.getElementById("acceptSuccessModal").style.display = "flex";

  }catch(err){
    errorEl.innerText = "Could not reach the server. Please try again.";
    confirmBtn.disabled = false;
    confirmBtn.innerText = "I Agree & Accept Job";
  }

});

window.selectJob = function(id){
  expandedJobId = id;
  renderJobs();
  document.getElementById("jobs").scrollIntoView({ behavior:"smooth", block:"start" });
}

async function loadJobs(){

const snapshot = await getDocs(collection(db,"translationJobs"));

allJobs = [];

snapshot.forEach(job=>{
const data = job.data();
if(data.status === "open" && !data.formattingUnlocked){
allJobs.push({ id: job.id, data });
}
});

renderJobs();

}

loadJobs();

async function loadMyJobs(){
  const passkey = sessionStorage.getItem("saybonTranslatorPasskey");
  const container = document.getElementById("content-myjobs");
  const badge = document.querySelector('.nav-item[data-tab="myjobs"] .nav-badge');
  if(!passkey){
    container.innerHTML = "<div class=\"empty-state\">Enter your passkey above to see jobs you have accepted.</div>";
    return;
  }
  try{
    const q = query(collection(db,"translationJobs"), where("participants","array-contains",passkey));
    const snapshot = await getDocs(q);
    if(snapshot.empty){
      container.innerHTML = "<div class=\"empty-state\">You have not accepted any jobs yet.</div>";
      if(badge) badge.textContent = "0";
      return;
    }
    container.innerHTML = "";
    let count = 0;
    snapshot.forEach(function(docSnap){
      const data = docSnap.data();
      const id = docSnap.id;
      count++;
      const words = data.wordCount || 0;
      const div = document.createElement("div");
      div.className = "compact-row";
      div.onclick = function(){ window.location.href = "/translation/editor-workspace.html?job=" + encodeURIComponent(id); };
      div.innerHTML =
        "<div class=\"compact-icon\"><svg viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"currentColor\" stroke-width=\"2\"><path d=\"M14 2H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v16a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V8z\"/><path d=\"M14 2v6h6\"/></svg></div>" +
        "<div class=\"compact-name\">" + (data.clientFile||"Untitled document") + "</div>" +
        "<div class=\"compact-meta\">" + (data.sourceLanguage||"?") + " to " + (data.targetLanguage||"?") + " - " + words + " words - Status: " + (data.status||"open") + "</div>" +
        "<div class=\"compact-price\">$" + (Number(data.price||0)*0.6).toFixed(2) + "</div>" +
        "<div class=\"compact-see\">Open Workspace<svg viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"currentColor\" stroke-width=\"2\"><path d=\"m6 9 6 6 6-6\"/></svg></div>";
      container.appendChild(div);
    });
    if(badge) badge.textContent = String(count);
  }catch(err){
    console.error("MY JOBS LOAD ERROR:", err);
    container.innerHTML = "<div class=\"empty-state\">There was a problem loading your jobs.</div>";
  }
}
loadMyJobs();
async function loadUnderReview(){
  const passkey = sessionStorage.getItem("saybonTranslatorPasskey");
  const container = document.getElementById("content-review");
  const badge = document.querySelector('.nav-item[data-tab="review"] .nav-badge');
  if(!passkey){
    container.innerHTML = "<div class=\"empty-state\">Enter your passkey above to see your submissions under review.</div>";
    return;
  }
  try{
    const q = query(collection(db,"jobSubmissions"), where("translator","==",passkey), where("passed","==",true));
    const snapshot = await getDocs(q);
    const rows = [];
    for(const docSnap of snapshot.docs){
      const sub = docSnap.data();
      const jobDoc = await getDocs(query(collection(db,"translationJobs")));
      const jobSnap = jobDoc.docs.find(function(d){ return d.id === sub.jobId; });
      if(!jobSnap) continue;
      const job = jobSnap.data();
      if(!job.formattingComplete){
        const isWinner = job.selectedSubmissionId === docSnap.id;
        rows.push({ id: sub.jobId, job: job, sub: sub, isWinner: isWinner });
      }
    }
    if(rows.length === 0){
      container.innerHTML = "<div class=\"empty-state\">You have no submissions currently under review.</div>";
      if(badge) badge.textContent = "0";
      return;
    }
    container.innerHTML = "";
    rows.forEach(function(r){
      const div = document.createElement("div");
      div.className = "compact-row";
      div.innerHTML =
        "<div class=\"compact-icon\"><svg viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"currentColor\" stroke-width=\"2\"><path d=\"M14 2H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v16a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V8z\"/><path d=\"M14 2v6h6\"/></svg></div>" +
        "<div class=\"compact-name\">" + (r.job.clientFile||"Untitled document") + "</div>" +
        "<div class=\"compact-meta\">Score: " + r.sub.finalScore + " - " + (r.isWinner ? "Leading submission, awaiting client confirmation" : "Passed, not currently the winning submission") + "</div>" +
        "<div class=\"compact-price\">$" + (Number(r.job.price||0)*(r.isWinner?0.6:0.1)).toFixed(2) + "</div>";
      container.appendChild(div);
    });
    if(badge) badge.textContent = String(rows.length);
  }catch(err){
    console.error("UNDER REVIEW LOAD ERROR:", err);
    container.innerHTML = "<div class=\"empty-state\">There was a problem loading your submissions.</div>";
  }
}
loadUnderReview();
function showJustGradedAlert(){
  const raw = sessionStorage.getItem("saybonJustGraded");
  if(!raw) return;
  sessionStorage.removeItem("saybonJustGraded");
  try{
    const info = JSON.parse(raw);
    const banner = document.getElementById("justGradedAlert");
    let topText = "";
    if(info.passed){
      const roleText = info.becameWinner ? "Your work was selected as the winning submission!" : "Your work passed review!";
      topText = roleText + " Score: " + info.score + " - You earned $" + Number(info.earned).toFixed(2);
      banner.classList.remove("failed");
    } else {
      topText = "Your work did not pass review this time. Score: " + info.score + " - Tap for details";
      banner.classList.add("failed");
    }
    banner.innerHTML =

async function fetchTrackRecord(passkey){

  const res = await fetch("https://saybonapp-server.onrender.com/api/translatorTrackRecord?key=" + encodeURIComponent(passkey));
  const data = await res.json();

  if(!res.ok){
    throw new Error(data.error || "Could not find that passkey.");
  }

  return data;

}

function renderTrackBadge(data){

  const greetingEl = document.getElementById("greetingText");
  const firstName = (data.name || "").trim().split(/\s+/)[0];

  if(firstName){
    greetingEl.innerText = "Hi, " + firstName;
    greetingEl.style.display = "flex";
  }

  const badge = document.getElementById("trackBadge");
  const text = document.getElementById("trackBadgeText");

  if(data.totalReviewed === 0){
    text.innerText = "New Translator";
  }else{
    text.innerText = data.passedCount + " passed \u00b7 " + data.passRate + "% pass rate";
  }

  badge.style.display = "flex";

}

async function loadWallet(passkey){

  try{

    const res = await fetch("https://saybonapp-server.onrender.com/api/translatorWallet?key=" + encodeURIComponent(passkey));
    const data = await res.json();

    if(!res.ok) return;

    document.getElementById("walletAvailable").innerText = "$" + data.availableBalance.toFixed(2);
    document.getElementById("walletPending").innerText = "$" + data.pendingClearance.toFixed(2);
    document.getElementById("walletTotal").innerText = "$" + data.totalBalance.toFixed(2);
    document.getElementById("walletPaid").innerText = "$" + data.paidOut.toFixed(2);
    document.getElementById("walletClearanceNote").innerText = "Clears " + data.clearanceDays + " business days after passing review";

    document.getElementById("walletBar").style.display = "flex";

  }catch(err){
    // fails silently, wallet stays hidden
  }

}

function resetTrackRecord(){
  sessionStorage.removeItem("saybonTranslatorPasskey");
  document.getElementById("greetingText").style.display = "none";
  document.getElementById("trackBadge").style.display = "none";
  document.getElementById("walletBar").style.display = "none";
  document.getElementById("gatePasskeyInput").value = "";
  document.getElementById("gateError").innerText = "";
  document.getElementById("passkeyGateModal").style.display = "flex";
}

async function continueFromGate(){

  const passkey = document.getElementById("gatePasskeyInput").value.trim();
  const errorEl = document.getElementById("gateError");
  const btn = document.getElementById("gateContinueBtn");

  if(!passkey){
    errorEl.innerText = "Please enter your passkey.";
    return;
  }

  btn.disabled = true;
  btn.innerText = "Checking...";
  errorEl.innerText = "";

  try{
    const data = await fetchTrackRecord(passkey);
    renderTrackBadge(data);
    loadWallet(passkey);
    sessionStorage.setItem("saybonTranslatorPasskey", passkey);
    document.getElementById("passkeyGateModal").style.display = "none";
  }catch(err){
    errorEl.innerText = err.message || "Could not verify that passkey.";
    btn.disabled = false;
    btn.innerText = "Continue";
  }

}

const storedTrackPasskey = sessionStorage.getItem("saybonTranslatorPasskey");

if(storedTrackPasskey){
  fetchTrackRecord(storedTrackPasskey).then(renderTrackBadge).catch(()=>{});
  loadWallet(storedTrackPasskey);
}else{
  document.getElementById("passkeyGateModal").style.display = "flex";
}

window.continueFromGate = continueFromGate;
window.resetTrackRecord = resetTrackRecord;

async function loadJobs(){

const response = await fetch("jobs.json");
const jobs = await response.json();

const table = document.getElementById("jobRows");
table.innerHTML = "";

jobs.forEach(job => {

let status = job.accepted + " / " + job.max;

let disabled = job.accepted >= job.max ? "disabled" : "";

let row = `
<tr>

<td>${job.jobId}</td>
<td>${job.words}</td>
<td>${job.deadline}</td>
<td>${job.plan}</td>
<td>${status}</td>

<td>
<button onclick="acceptJob('${job.jobId}')" ${disabled}>
Accept Job
</button>
</td>

</tr>
`;

table.innerHTML += row;

});

}


async function acceptJob(id){

const response = await fetch("jobs.json");
const jobs = await response.json();

const job = jobs.find(j => j.jobId === id);

if(job.accepted >= job.max){

alert("Job already closed");

return;

}

job.accepted++;

alert("Job accepted");

loadJobs();

}

loadJobs();

const API_BASE = "https://saybonapp-server.onrender.com";
const PAYSTACK_PUBLIC_KEY = "pk_live_adbd997a6cb7382da7c9e3e77c0ca487b93d73ab";

const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
const plan = params.get("plan");
const words = parseInt(params.get("words")) || 0;
const language = params.get("language");
const email = params.get("email");
const price = params.get("price");

let selectedProvider = "stripe";
let convertedAmount = null;
let selectedCurrency = "GHS";

document.getElementById("plan").innerText = plan;
document.getElementById("words").innerText = words;
document.getElementById("language").innerText = language;

  document.getElementById("price").innerText = "$" + Number(price).toFixed(2);

function loadPaystackQuote(){
  if(!price) return;
  selectedCurrency = paystackLocationSelect.value;
  ghsNote.textContent = "Converting price...";
  fetch(API_BASE + "/api/convertUsdToCurrency?amount=" + encodeURIComponent(price) + "&currency=" + encodeURIComponent(selectedCurrency))
    .then(r => r.json())
    .then(function(data){
      if(data.convertedAmount){
        convertedAmount = data.convertedAmount;
        ghsNote.textContent = "You will be charged " + selectedCurrency + " " + convertedAmount.toFixed(2);
      } else {
        ghsNote.textContent = "Could not load exchange rate - try Stripe instead";
      }
    })
    .catch(function(){ ghsNote.textContent = "Could not load exchange rate - try Stripe instead"; });
}

async function startStripePayment(){
  payButton.innerText = "Processing...";
  payButton.disabled = true;
  document.getElementById("payStatus").textContent = "";

  try{
    const documentText = sessionStorage.getItem("saybon_doc_text") || "";
    const sourceLanguage = sessionStorage.getItem("saybon_source_language") || "";
    const clientFile = sessionStorage.getItem("saybon_client_file") || ""; const originalFileUrl = sessionStorage.getItem("saybon_original_file_url") || ""; const originalFileType = sessionStorage.getItem("saybon_original_file_type") || "";

    const res = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/createTranslationRequestCheckout", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        email: email, plan: plan, wordCount: words,
        targetLanguage: language, sourceLanguage: sourceLanguage,
        clientFile: clientFile, documentText: documentText, price: price, originalFileUrl: originalFileUrl, originalFileType: originalFileType      })
    });

    const data = await res.json();

    if(!res.ok || !data.url){
      document.getElementById("payStatus").textContent = "Could not start payment. Please try again.";
      payButton.innerText = "Pay Securely";
      payButton.disabled = false;
      return;
    }

    document.getElementById("jobCode").innerText = "Job Code: " + data.jobId;
    window.location = data.url;

  }catch(err){
    document.getElementById("payStatus").textContent = "Could not start payment. Please try again.";
    payButton.innerText = "Pay Securely";
    payButton.disabled = false;
  }
}

async function startPaystackPayment(){
  if(!convertedAmount){
    document.getElementById("payStatus").textContent = "Please wait for the price to load first.";
    return;
  }

  payButton.innerText = "Processing...";
  payButton.disabled = true;
  document.getElementById("payStatus").textContent = "";

  try{
    const documentText = sessionStorage.getItem("saybon_doc_text") || "";
    const sourceLanguage = sessionStorage.getItem("saybon_source_language") || "";
    const clientFile = sessionStorage.getItem("saybon_client_file") || ""; const originalFileUrl = sessionStorage.getItem("saybon_original_file_url") || ""; const originalFileType = sessionStorage.getItem("saybon_original_file_type") || "";

    const jobRes = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/createTranslationJobForPaystack", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        email: email, plan: plan, wordCount: words,
        targetLanguage: language, sourceLanguage: sourceLanguage,
        clientFile: clientFile, documentText: documentText, price: price, priceGhs: convertedAmount, originalFileUrl: originalFileUrl, originalFileType: originalFileType
      })
    });
    const jobData = await jobRes.json();

    if(!jobRes.ok || !jobData.jobId){
      document.getElementById("payStatus").textContent = "Could not create job. Please try again.";
      payButton.innerText = "Pay Securely";
      payButton.disabled = false;
      return;
    }

    document.getElementById("jobCode").innerText = "Job Code: " + jobData.jobId;

    var handler = PaystackPop.setup({
      key: PAYSTACK_PUBLIC_KEY,
      email: email,
      amount: Math.round(convertedAmount * 100),
      currency: selectedCurrency,
      ref: "SB-PS-" + Date.now(),
      callback: function(response){
        document.getElementById("payStatus").textContent = "Verifying payment...";
        fetch(API_BASE + "/api/verifyPaystackTranslation", {
          method: "POST",
          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
          body: JSON.stringify({ reference: response.reference, jobId: jobData.jobId })
        }).then(r => r.json()).then(function(verifyData){
          if(verifyData.verified){
            document.getElementById("payStatus").textContent = "Payment confirmed! Redirecting...";
            localStorage.setItem("saybon_last_job", jobData.jobId);
            setTimeout(function(){
              window.location = "/translation/success.html";
            }, 1200);
          } else {
            document.getElementById("payStatus").textContent = "Could not verify payment. Please contact support with your job code.";
            payButton.innerText = "Pay Securely";
            payButton.disabled = false;
          }
        }).catch(function(){
          document.getElementById("payStatus").textContent = "Could not verify payment. Please contact support with your job code.";
          payButton.innerText = "Pay Securely";
          payButton.disabled = false;
        });
      },
      onClose: function(){
        payButton.innerText = "Pay Securely";
        payButton.disabled = false;
      }
    });
    handler.openIframe();

  }catch(err){
    document.getElementById("payStatus").textContent = "Could not start payment. Please try again.";
    payButton.innerText = "Pay Securely";
    payButton.disabled = false;
  }
}
function copyJobCode(){
  var el = document.getElementById("jobCode");
  var text = el.innerText.replace("Job Code: ", "");
  if(!text) return;
  navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(function(){
    var original = el.innerText;
    el.innerText = "Copied!";
    setTimeout(function(){ el.innerText = original; }, 1200);
  });
}

  { name:"Basic",    maxWords:500,   standard:12.50,  express:25.00,  standardDelivery:"3-6 hrs",   expressDelivery:"1-3 hrs" },

]

function getPackageForWords(words){
  for(let i=0; i<PACKAGES.length; i++){
    if(words <= PACKAGES[i].maxWords){
      return PACKAGES[i]
    }
  }
  return null
}

  if(fileInput.files[0]){

function readFileAsText(file){
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const reader = new FileReader()
    reader.onload = e => resolve(e.target.result || "")
    reader.onerror = reject
    reader.readAsText(file)
  })
}

function readFileAsArrayBuffer(file){
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const reader = new FileReader()
    reader.onload = e => resolve(e.target.result)
    reader.onerror = reject
    reader.readAsArrayBuffer(file)
  })
}

async function extractDocxText(file){
  const arrayBuffer = await readFileAsArrayBuffer(file)
  const result = await mammoth.extractRawText({ arrayBuffer })
  return result.value || ""
}

async function extractPdfText(file){
  const arrayBuffer = await readFileAsArrayBuffer(file)
  const pdf = await pdfjsLib.getDocument({ data: arrayBuffer }).promise
  let fullText = ""
  for(let i = 1; i <= pdf.numPages; i++){
    const page = await pdf.getPage(i)
    const content = await page.getTextContent()
    fullText += content.items.map(item => item.str).join(" ") + "\n"
  }
  return fullText
}

function processExtractedText(text){

currentDocumentText = text

let words=text.trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length

if(words<1){
words=1
}

currentWords=words

const pkg = getPackageForWords(words)
currentPackage = pkg

document.querySelector(".word-count").innerHTML=
"WORDS: "+words+' <span class="package-badge" id="packageBadge">'+(pkg?pkg.name:"Custom")+'</span>'

if(pkg){

standardPrice = pkg.standard.toFixed(2)
expressPrice = pkg.express.toFixed(2)

document.getElementById("standardPriceLabel").innerText = "STANDARD $"+standardPrice
document.getElementById("expressPriceLabel").innerText = "EXPRESS $"+expressPrice

document.getElementById("standardDelivery").innerText = "Delivery: "+pkg.standardDelivery
document.getElementById("expressDelivery").innerText = "Delivery: "+pkg.expressDelivery

} else {

standardPrice = null
expressPrice = null

document.getElementById("standardPriceLabel").innerText = "STANDARD - Custom quote"
document.getElementById("expressPriceLabel").innerText = "EXPRESS - Custom quote"

document.getElementById("standardDelivery").innerText = "Delivery: contact us"
document.getElementById("expressDelivery").innerText = "Delivery: contact us"

}

}

uploadBtn.addEventListener("click", async () => {

const file=fileInput.files[0]

if(!file){
alert("Please choose a document first")
return
}

currentFileName = file.name || "Untitled document";
const ext = file.name.split(".").pop().toLowerCase()

try{ const originalFileUrl = await window.uploadOriginalToStorage(file); sessionStorage.setItem("saybon_original_file_url", originalFileUrl); sessionStorage.setItem("saybon_original_file_type", ext); }catch(uploadErr){ console.error("ORIGINAL FILE UPLOAD ERROR:", uploadErr); }

uploadBtn.disabled = true
const originalUploadHtml = uploadBtn.innerHTML
uploadBtn.innerHTML = "PROCESSING..."

try{

let text = ""

if(ext === "txt"){
  text = await readFileAsText(file)
}else if(ext === "docx"){
  text = await extractDocxText(file)
}else if(ext === "pdf"){
  text = await extractPdfText(file)
}else{
  alert("Please upload a .txt, .docx, or .pdf file.")
  uploadBtn.disabled = false
  uploadBtn.innerHTML = originalUploadHtml
  return
}

if(!text || !text.trim()){
  alert("We could not read any text from that file. Please check the document and try again.")
  uploadBtn.disabled = false
  uploadBtn.innerHTML = originalUploadHtml
  return
}

processExtractedText(text)

}catch(err){
  console.error("DOCUMENT EXTRACTION ERROR:", err)
  alert("We could not read that file. Please make sure it is a valid .txt, .docx, or .pdf document.")
}

uploadBtn.disabled = false
uploadBtn.innerHTML = originalUploadHtml

})

if(currentWords===0){
alert("Please upload a document first")

}

if(!currentPackage){

let url="/translation/payment.html?plan="+type+

"&price="+price+
"&language="+language+
"&email="+email

===== FILE: public\translation\request.js (1884 bytes) =====
let selectedPlan = null;

const uploadBtn = document.getElementById("uploadBtn");
const fileInput = document.getElementById("fileInput");
const wordCountDisplay = document.getElementById("wordCount");

const standardCard = document.getElementById("standardCard");
const expressCard = document.getElementById("expressCard");
const continueBtn = document.getElementById("continueBtn");

standardCard.onclick = () => {
selectedPlan = "standard";
continueBtn.style.display = "block";
};

expressCard.onclick = () => {
selectedPlan = "express";
continueBtn.style.display = "block";
};

uploadBtn.onclick = async () => {

const file = fileInput.files[0];

if(!file){
alert("Please choose a file first.");
return;
}

let text = "";

if(file.name.endsWith(".txt")){
text = await file.text();
}

else if(file.name.endsWith(".docx")){
const arrayBuffer = await file.arrayBuffer();
const result = await mammoth.extractRawText({arrayBuffer});
text = result.value;
}

else if(file.name.endsWith(".pdf")){
const arrayBuffer = await file.arrayBuffer();
const pdf = await pdfjsLib.getDocument({data:arrayBuffer}).promise;

for(let i=1;i<=pdf.numPages;i++){

const page = await pdf.getPage(i);
const content = await page.getTextContent();

content.items.forEach(item=>{
text += item.str + " ";
});

}
}

const words = text.trim().split(/\s+/).length;

wordCountDisplay.innerText = "WORDS: " + words;

const standardPrice = (words * 0.025).toFixed(2);
const expressPrice = (words * 0.05).toFixed(2);

document.querySelector("#standardCard .quote-price").innerText =
"STANDARD $" + standardPrice;

document.querySelector("#expressCard .quote-price").innerText =
"EXPRESS $" + expressPrice;

};

continueBtn.onclick = () => {

const words = parseInt(
wordCountDisplay.innerText.replace(/\D/g,'')
);

location.href =
"https://saybonapp.com/translation/job.html?plan="+selectedPlan+"&words="+words;

};


===== FILE: public\translation\segment-engine.js (208 bytes) =====
export function segmentText(text){

const sentences = text
.replace(/\n+/g," ")
.split(/(?<=[.!?])\s+/)
.filter(s => s.trim().length > 0);

return sentences.map((s,i)=>({
 id:i+1,
 source:s,
 edit:""
}));

}

<script type="module">

import { db } from "/js/firebase-init.js";
import { doc, getDoc } from "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.0/firebase-firestore.js";

const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
const sessionId = params.get("session_id");
const fallbackJob = localStorage.getItem("saybon_last_job");

async function resolveJobId(){
  if(!sessionId){
    return fallbackJob;
  }

  try{
    const res = await fetch("https://saybonapp-server.onrender.com/api/session-job?session_id=" + encodeURIComponent(sessionId));
    const data = await res.json();

    if(data.jobId){
      localStorage.setItem("saybon_last_job", data.jobId);
      return data.jobId;
    }

    return fallbackJob;
  }catch(err){
    console.error("SESSION LOOKUP ERROR:", err);
    return fallbackJob;
  }
}

async function loadInvoice(){
  try{
    const jobId = await resolveJobId();

    if(!jobId){
      document.getElementById("message").innerText = "No job reference was found for this invoice.";
      return;
    }

    const jobSnap = await getDoc(doc(db, "translationJobs", jobId));

    if(!jobSnap.exists()){
      document.getElementById("message").innerText = "Invoice data could not be found.";
      return;
    }

    const data = jobSnap.data();

    document.getElementById("job").innerText = data.jobId || "-";
    document.getElementById("email").innerText = data.email || "-";
    document.getElementById("plan").innerText = data.plan || "-";
    document.getElementById("language").innerText = data.targetLanguage || "-";

    let rate = data.plan === "express" ? 0.05 : 0.025;
    document.getElementById("rate").innerText = "$" + rate.toFixed(3);
    document.getElementById("words").innerText = data.wordCount ?? "-";
    document.getElementById("price").innerText = "$" + Number(data.price || 0).toFixed(2);
    document.getElementById("subtotal").innerText = "$" + Number(data.price || 0).toFixed(2);
    document.getElementById("total").innerText = "$" + Number(data.price || 0).toFixed(2);

    const words = Number(data.wordCount || 0);
    const isExpress = data.plan === "express";

    let timeline = "";

    if(words <= 300){
      timeline = isExpress ? "30-60 mins" : "1-3 hrs";
    }else if(words <= 1000){
      timeline = isExpress ? "1-3 hrs" : "3-6 hrs";
    }else if(words <= 3000){
      timeline = isExpress ? "3-6 hrs" : "6-12 hrs";
    }else if(words <= 6000){
      timeline = isExpress ? "6-12 hrs" : "12-24 hrs";
    }else if(words <= 10000){
      timeline = isExpress ? "12-24 hrs" : "24-48 hrs";
    }else if(words <= 20000){
      timeline = isExpress ? "24-48 hrs" : "2-4 days";
    }else{
      timeline = "Custom";
    }

    document.getElementById("timeline").innerText = timeline;

    if(data.status === "paid"){
      document.getElementById("message").innerText = "Payment confirmed. Your translation request is now in queue.";
    }else{
      document.getElementById("message").innerText = "";
    }
  }catch(err){
    console.error("INVOICE LOAD ERROR:", err);
    document.getElementById("message").innerText = "There was a problem loading your invoice.";
  }
}

function openDesk(){
  const currentJob = localStorage.getItem("saybon_last_job") || "";
  window.location = "/translation/desk.html?job=" + encodeURIComponent(currentJob);
}

function downloadInvoice(){
  html2pdf().from(document.getElementById("invoice")).save("SayBon-Invoice.pdf");
}

window.openDesk = openDesk;
window.downloadInvoice = downloadInvoice;

function copyInvoiceId(){
  var el = document.getElementById("job");
  var text = el.innerText;
  if(!text || text === "-" || text === "Loading...") return;
  navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(function(){
    var original = el.innerText;
    el.innerText = "Copied!";
    setTimeout(function(){ el.innerText = original; }, 1200);
  });
}
window.copyInvoiceId = copyInvoiceId;

loadInvoice();

</script>

</body>
</html>

<script>

let currentMethod = "bank";

function setMethod(method){
  currentMethod = method;
  document.getElementById("bankToggle").classList.toggle("active", method === "bank");
  document.getElementById("momoToggle").classList.toggle("active", method === "momo");
  document.getElementById("bankFields").classList.toggle("hidden", method !== "bank");
  document.getElementById("momoFields").classList.toggle("hidden", method !== "momo");
}

function updateBankRegionFields(){
  const region = document.getElementById("bankRegion").value;

  document.getElementById("accountNumberField").classList.toggle("hidden", region === "international");
  document.getElementById("routingNumberField").classList.toggle("hidden", region !== "us");
  document.getElementById("sortCodeField").classList.toggle("hidden", region !== "uk");
  document.getElementById("ibanField").classList.toggle("hidden", region !== "international");
  document.getElementById("swiftField").classList.toggle("hidden", region === "ghana");
}

async function savePaymentMethod(){

  const passkey = document.getElementById("passkeyInput").value.trim();
  const msgEl = document.getElementById("msg");
  const btn = document.getElementById("saveBtn");

  if(!passkey){
    msgEl.className = "msg error";
    msgEl.innerText = "Please enter your translator passkey.";
    return;
  }

  const body = { passkey, method: currentMethod };

  if(currentMethod === "bank"){
    body.bankRegion = document.getElementById("bankRegion").value;
    body.bankName = document.getElementById("bankName").value.trim();
    body.accountNumber = document.getElementById("accountNumber").value.trim();
    body.routingNumber = document.getElementById("routingNumber").value.trim();
    body.sortCode = document.getElementById("sortCode").value.trim();
    body.iban = document.getElementById("iban").value.trim();
    body.swiftBic = document.getElementById("swiftBic").value.trim();
    body.accountName = document.getElementById("accountName").value.trim();
  } else {
    body.momoNetwork = document.getElementById("momoNetwork").value;
    body.momoNumber = document.getElementById("momoNumber").value.trim();
  }

  btn.disabled = true;
  btn.innerText = "Saving...";
  msgEl.innerText = "";

  try{

    const res = await fetch("https://saybonapp-server.onrender.com/api/savePaymentMethod", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify(body)
    });

    const data = await res.json();

    if(!res.ok){
      msgEl.className = "msg error";
      msgEl.innerText = data.error || "Could not save. Please try again.";
      btn.disabled = false;
      btn.innerText = "Save Payment Method";
      return;
    }

    msgEl.className = "msg success";
    msgEl.innerText = "Saved. This will be used for your future payouts.";
    btn.disabled = false;
    btn.innerText = "Save Payment Method";

  }catch(err){
    msgEl.className = "msg error";
    msgEl.innerText = "Could not reach the server. Please try again.";
    btn.disabled = false;
    btn.innerText = "Save Payment Method";
  }

}

</script>

</body>
</html>

<script type="module">

import { initializeApp } from "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.0/firebase-app.js";
import { getStorage, ref, uploadBytes, getDownloadURL } from "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.0/firebase-storage.js";
import { getAuth, signInAnonymously } from "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.0/firebase-auth.js";

const firebaseConfig = {
apiKey:"[REDACTED]",
authDomain:"saybon-3e3c2.firebaseapp.com",
projectId:"saybon-3e3c2",
storageBucket:"saybon-3e3c2.firebasestorage.app",
messagingSenderId:"75085012344",
appId:"1:75085012344:web:0b18581cb0a30c3df47c8d"
};

const app = initializeApp(firebaseConfig);
const storage = getStorage(app);
const auth = getAuth(app);

signInAnonymously(auth).catch(err => console.error("Anonymous sign-in failed:", err));

const API_BASE = "https://saybonapp-server.onrender.com";

let currentPasskey = null;
let selectedPhotoFile = null;
let currentPhotoUrl = "";

window.lookupProfile = async function(){

  const passkey = document.getElementById("lookupPasskey").value.trim();
  const msgEl = document.getElementById("lookupMsg");

  if(!passkey){
    msgEl.className = "msg error";
    msgEl.innerText = "Please enter your passkey.";
    return;
  }

  msgEl.className = "msg";
  msgEl.innerText = "Loading...";

  try{

    const res = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/translatorProfile?key=" + encodeURIComponent(passkey));
    const data = await res.json();

    if(!res.ok){
      msgEl.className = "msg error";
      msgEl.innerText = data.error || "Could not find that passkey.";
      return;
    }

    currentPasskey = passkey;
    currentPhotoUrl = data.photoUrl || "";

    const displayNameInput = document.getElementById("displayName");
    displayNameInput.value = data.name || data.defaultName || "";

    document.getElementById("nameHint").innerText = data.name
      ? "This is what other pages will greet you by."
      : "This default was derived from your email - feel free to change it.";

    const avatarEl = document.getElementById("avatarPreview");
    if(currentPhotoUrl){
      avatarEl.innerHTML = "<img src=\"" + currentPhotoUrl + "\" />";
    }else{
      const initial = (displayNameInput.value || "?").trim().charAt(0).toUpperCase();
      avatarEl.innerText = initial || "?";
    }

    document.getElementById("lookupCard").style.display = "none";
    document.getElementById("editCard").style.display = "block";

  }catch(err){
    msgEl.className = "msg error";
    msgEl.innerText = "Could not reach the server. Please try again.";
  }

};

document.getElementById("photoUpload").addEventListener("change", (e) => {
  selectedPhotoFile = e.target.files[0] || null;

  if(selectedPhotoFile){
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = (ev) => {
      document.getElementById("avatarPreview").innerHTML = "<img src=\"" + ev.target.result + "\" />";
    };
    reader.readAsDataURL(selectedPhotoFile);
  }
});

window.saveProfile = async function(){

  const saveBtn = document.getElementById("saveProfileBtn");
  const msgEl = document.getElementById("saveMsg");

  saveBtn.disabled = true;
  saveBtn.innerText = "Saving...";
  msgEl.innerText = "";

  try{

    let photoUrl = currentPhotoUrl;

    if(selectedPhotoFile){

      if(!auth.currentUser){
        await signInAnonymously(auth);
      }

      const fileRef = ref(storage, "translatorProfiles/" + currentPasskey + "/" + Date.now() + "_" + selectedPhotoFile.name);
      await uploadBytes(fileRef, selectedPhotoFile);
      photoUrl = await getDownloadURL(fileRef);

    }

    const name = document.getElementById("displayName").value.trim();

    const res = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/updateTranslatorProfile", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ passkey: currentPasskey, name, photoUrl })
    });

    const data = await res.json();

    if(!res.ok){
      msgEl.className = "msg error";
      msgEl.innerText = data.error || "Could not save your profile.";
      saveBtn.disabled = false;
      saveBtn.innerText = "Save Changes";
      return;
    }

    currentPhotoUrl = photoUrl;
    selectedPhotoFile = null;

    msgEl.className = "msg success";
    msgEl.innerText = "Profile updated.";
    saveBtn.disabled = false;
    saveBtn.innerText = "Save Changes";

  }catch(err){
    msgEl.className = "msg error";
    msgEl.innerText = "Something went wrong. Please try again.";
    saveBtn.disabled = false;
    saveBtn.innerText = "Save Changes";
  }

};

</script>

</body>

<script type="module">

import { initializeApp } from "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.0/firebase-app.js";
import { getStorage, ref, uploadBytes, getDownloadURL } from "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.0/firebase-storage.js";
import { getAuth, signInAnonymously } from "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.0/firebase-auth.js";

const firebaseConfig = {
apiKey:"[REDACTED]",
authDomain:"saybon-3e3c2.firebaseapp.com",
projectId:"saybon-3e3c2",
storageBucket:"saybon-3e3c2.firebasestorage.app",
messagingSenderId:"75085012344",
appId:"1:75085012344:web:0b18581cb0a30c3df47c8d"
};

const app = initializeApp(firebaseConfig);
const storage = getStorage(app);
const auth = getAuth(app);

// Storage rules require an authenticated request. Applicants
// aren't asked to create an account, so this signs them in
// anonymously behind the scenes just so uploads are permitted.
signInAnonymously(auth).catch(err => console.error("Anonymous sign-in failed:", err));

const API_BASE = "https://saybonapp-server.onrender.com";

const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
const testId = params.get("testId");

if(!testId){
  document.getElementById("formError").innerText = "No test result found. Please take the translator test first.";
}

const requiredFieldEls = [
  document.getElementById("email"),
  document.getElementById("phone"),
  document.getElementById("country"),
  document.getElementById("experience")
];

const idUpload = document.getElementById("idUpload");
const certUpload = document.getElementById("certUpload");
const cvUpload = document.getElementById("cvUpload");

const idNotice = document.getElementById("idNotice");
const certNotice = document.getElementById("certNotice");
const cvNotice = document.getElementById("cvNotice");

const uploadBucket = document.getElementById("uploadBucket");
const submitBtn = document.getElementById("submitBtn");

const allowed = ["pdf","doc","docx","png","jpg","jpeg"];

let idValid = false;
let cvValid = false;

let idFiles = [];
let certFiles = [];
let cvFiles = [];

function validateFiles(files, notice, required){
  let valid = files.length > 0 || !required;
  notice.innerHTML = "";

  for(const file of files){
    const ext = file.name.split(".").pop().toLowerCase();

    if(!allowed.includes(ext)){
      notice.innerHTML += "✓- " + file.name + " - unsupported file type<br>";
      valid = false;
      continue;
    }

    if(file.size > 10000000){
      notice.innerHTML += "✓- " + file.name + " - too large (max 10MB)<br>";
      valid = false;
      continue;
    }

    notice.innerHTML += "✓-œ " + file.name + " accepted<br>";
  }

  notice.className = valid ? "notice accept" : "notice reject";
  return valid;
}

function renderBucket(){
  const all = [...idFiles, ...certFiles, ...cvFiles];

  if(!all.length){
    uploadBucket.innerHTML = "<div class=\"bucket-empty\">No files selected yet</div>";
    return;
  }

  uploadBucket.innerHTML = "";

  all.forEach(file => {
    const row = document.createElement("div");
    row.className = "bucket-row";
    row.innerHTML =
      "<svg viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"currentColor\" stroke-width=\"2\"><path d=\"M14 2H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v16a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V8z\"/><path d=\"M14 2v6h6\"/></svg>" +
      "<span>" + file.name + "</span>";
    uploadBucket.appendChild(row);
  });
}

idUpload.onchange = () => {
  idFiles = Array.from(idUpload.files);
  idValid = validateFiles(idFiles, idNotice, true);
  renderBucket();
  checkForm();
};

certUpload.onchange = () => {
  certFiles = Array.from(certUpload.files);
  validateFiles(certFiles, certNotice, false);
  renderBucket();
  checkForm();
};

cvUpload.onchange = () => {
  cvFiles = Array.from(cvUpload.files);
  cvValid = validateFiles(cvFiles, cvNotice, true);
  renderBucket();
  checkForm();
};

requiredFieldEls.forEach(f => { f.oninput = checkForm; });
document.getElementById("fullName").oninput = checkForm;

function checkForm(){
  const filled = requiredFieldEls.every(f => f.value.trim().length > 0);
  submitBtn.disabled = !(filled && idValid && cvValid && testId);
}

async function uploadFile(file, folder){
  const fileRef = ref(storage, folder + "/" + Date.now() + "_" + file.name);
  await uploadBytes(fileRef, file);
  return await getDownloadURL(fileRef);
}

submitBtn.onclick = async () => {

  submitBtn.disabled = true;
  submitBtn.innerText = "Submitting...";
  document.getElementById("formError").innerText = "";

  try{

    if(!auth.currentUser){
      await signInAnonymously(auth);
    }

    const idUrl = await uploadFile(idFiles[0], "translatorDocs/id");

    const certUrls = [];
    for(const f of certFiles){
      certUrls.push(await uploadFile(f, "translatorDocs/certifications"));
    }

    const cvUrls = [];
    for(const f of cvFiles){
      cvUrls.push(await uploadFile(f, "translatorDocs/cv"));
    }

    const res = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/completeTranslatorApplication", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        testId,
        name: document.getElementById("fullName").value,
        email: document.getElementById("email").value,
        phone: document.getElementById("phone").value,
        country: document.getElementById("country").value,
        experience: document.getElementById("experience").value,
        idUrl,
        certUrls,
        cvUrls
      })
    });

    const data = await res.json();

    if(!res.ok){
      document.getElementById("formError").innerText = data.error || "Could not submit your application.";
      submitBtn.disabled = false;
      submitBtn.innerHTML = '<svg width="15" height="15" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#012225" stroke-width="2"><path d="M12 19V5M5 12l7-7 7 7"/></svg>Submit Application';
      return;
    }

    window.location = "/translation/translator-result.html?id=" + encodeURIComponent(data.applicationId);

  }catch(err){
    document.getElementById("formError").innerText = "Something went wrong while uploading. Please try again.";
    submitBtn.disabled = false;
    submitBtn.innerHTML = '<svg width="15" height="15" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#012225" stroke-width="2"><path d="M12 19V5M5 12l7-7 7 7"/></svg>Submit Application';
  }

};

</script>

</body>
</html>

const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
const id = params.get("id");

async function load(){

  if(!id){
    document.getElementById("status").innerText = "Result unavailable";
    return;
  }

  document.getElementById("jobCodeLabel").innerText = id;

  try{

    const res = await fetch("https://saybonapp-server.onrender.com/api/applicationResult?id=" + encodeURIComponent(id));
    const data = await res.json();

    if(!res.ok){
      document.getElementById("status").innerText = "Result not found";
      return;
    }

    document.getElementById("metricList").style.display = "flex";

    document.getElementById("accuracyBar").style.width = data.accuracy + "%";
    document.getElementById("accuracyValue").innerText = data.accuracy + "%";

    document.getElementById("terminologyBar").style.width = data.terminology + "%";
    document.getElementById("terminologyValue").innerText = data.terminology + "%";

    document.getElementById("completenessValue").innerText = data.completenessOk ? "Passed" : "Incomplete";
    document.getElementById("finalScoreValue").innerText = data.finalScore + "%";

    const statusEl = document.getElementById("status");

    if(data.passed){
      statusEl.innerText = "Accepted Into Translator Pool";
      statusEl.className = "status pass";
      document.getElementById("passkeyBox").style.display = "block";
      document.getElementById("passkeyCode").innerText = data.passkey;
      document.getElementById("jobBtn").style.display = "inline-block";
    }else{
      statusEl.innerText = "Application Not Accepted";
      statusEl.className = "status fail";
    }

  }catch(err){
    document.getElementById("status").innerText = "Could not load your result. Please try again.";
  }

}

document.addEventListener("click", (e)=>{
  if(e.target && e.target.id === "passkeyCode"){
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(e.target.innerText);
    const original = e.target.innerText;
    e.target.innerText = "Copied";
    setTimeout(()=>{ e.target.innerText = original; }, 1500);
  }
});

load();

</div>

<script>

const API_BASE = "https://saybonapp-server.onrender.com";

let timeLeft = 480; // 8 minutes
let timerStarted = false;
let timerInterval = null;
let tabSwitches = 0;
let submitted = false;

async function loadPassages(){
  try{
    const res = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/translatorTestPassages");
    const data = await res.json();
    document.getElementById("frSource").innerText = data.frToEnSource;
    document.getElementById("enSource").innerText = data.enToFrSource;
  }catch(err){
    document.getElementById("frSource").innerText = "Could not load the test passage. Please refresh the page.";
    document.getElementById("enSource").innerText = "Could not load the test passage. Please refresh the page.";
  }
}

function startTimer(){
  if(timerStarted) return;
  timerStarted = true;

  timerInterval = setInterval(()=>{
    timeLeft--;
    const m = Math.floor(timeLeft/60);
    const s = timeLeft%60;
    document.getElementById("timer").innerText = String(m).padStart(2,"0") + ":" + String(s).padStart(2,"0");

    if(timeLeft<=0){
      clearInterval(timerInterval);
      submitTest();
    }
  },1000);
}

document.getElementById("frToEnAnswer").addEventListener("focus", startTimer);
document.getElementById("enToFrAnswer").addEventListener("focus", startTimer);

document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", ()=>{
  if(document.hidden && timerStarted && !submitted){
    tabSwitches++;
  }
});

const accents = ["é","è","ê","à","ç","ù","ô","î","œ","«","»"];
const keyboardEl = document.getElementById("accentKeyboard");

accents.forEach(ch=>{
  const span = document.createElement("span");
  span.className = "accent-key";
  span.textContent = ch;
  span.onclick = ()=>{
    const box = document.getElementById("enToFrAnswer");
    const start = box.selectionStart;
    box.value = box.value.slice(0,start) + ch + box.value.slice(start);
    box.selectionStart = box.selectionEnd = start + ch.length;
    box.focus();
  };
  keyboardEl.appendChild(span);
});

async function submitTest(){

  if(submitted) return;
  submitted = true;

  clearInterval(timerInterval);

  const submitBtn = document.getElementById("submitBtn");
  submitBtn.disabled = true;
  submitBtn.innerText = "Submitting...";

  const frToEnAnswer = document.getElementById("frToEnAnswer").value;
  const enToFrAnswer = document.getElementById("enToFrAnswer").value;
  const timeTakenSeconds = 480 - timeLeft;

  try{

    const res = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/submitTranslatorTest", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ frToEnAnswer, enToFrAnswer, tabSwitches, timeTakenSeconds })
    });

    const data = await res.json();

    if(!res.ok){
      alert(data.error || "Could not submit your test. Please try again.");
      submitted = false;
      submitBtn.disabled = false;
      submitBtn.innerText = "Submit Test";
      return;
    }

    window.location = "/translation/translator-register.html?testId=" + encodeURIComponent(data.testId);

  }catch(err){
    alert("Could not reach the server. Please try again.");
    submitted = false;
    submitBtn.disabled = false;
    submitBtn.innerText = "Submit Test";
  }

}

window.submitTest = submitTest;

document.addEventListener("copy", e => e.preventDefault());
document.addEventListener("paste", e => e.preventDefault());
document.addEventListener("cut", e => e.preventDefault());
document.addEventListener("contextmenu", e => e.preventDefault());

loadPassages();

</script>

</body>

===== FILE: routes\jobs.js (928 bytes) =====
const express = require("express");
const router = express.Router();
const admin = require("firebase-admin");

function generateJobId(){
    const rand = Math.random().toString(36).substring(2,6).toUpperCase();
    return `JOB-${Date.now()}-${rand}`;
}

router.post("/create-job", async (req,res)=>{

    try{

        const {email,language,words,price,service} = req.body;

        const jobId = generateJobId();

        const db = admin.firestore();

        await db.collection("translation_jobs").doc(jobId).set({

            email,
            language,
            words,
            price,
            service,

            status:"pending_payment",
            createdAt: Date.now()

        });

        res.json({
            success:true,
            jobId
        });

    }catch(err){

        console.error(err);
        res.status(500).json({error:"job creation failed"});

    }

});

module.exports = router;


===== FILE: routes\stripe-webhook.js (1010 bytes) =====
const express = require("express");
const router = express.Router();
const admin = require("firebase-admin");

router.post("/stripe-webhook", async (req, res) => {

    try {

        const event = req.body;

        if (event.type === "checkout.session.completed") {

            const session = event.data.object;

            const jobId = session.client_reference_id;

            if (!jobId) {
                console.log("No job ID found");
                return res.json({received:true});
            }

            const db = admin.firestore();

            await db.collection("translation_jobs")
                .doc(jobId)
                .update({
                    status: "paid",
                    paidAt: Date.now()
                });

            console.log("Job marked paid:", jobId);

        }

        res.json({received:true});

    } catch (err) {

        console.error("Webhook error:", err);
        res.status(500).send("Webhook failed");

    }

});

module.exports = router;


===== FILE: routes\upload-document.js (1354 bytes) =====
const express = require("express");
const router = express.Router();
const admin = require("firebase-admin");
const multer = require("multer");

const upload = multer({ storage: multer.memoryStorage() });

router.post("/upload-document", upload.single("file"), async (req,res)=>{

    try{

        const file = req.file;

        if(!file){
            return res.status(400).json({error:"no file uploaded"});
        }

        const bucket = admin.storage().bucket();

        const fileName = Date.now() + "_" + file.originalname;

        const fileUpload = bucket.file("translation_docs/" + fileName);

        const stream = fileUpload.createWriteStream({
            metadata:{contentType:file.mimetype}
        });

        stream.on("error",err=>{
            console.error(err);
            res.status(500).json({error:"upload failed"});
        });

        stream.on("finish", async ()=>{

            const publicUrl =
            "https://storage.googleapis.com/" +
            bucket.name +
            "/translation_docs/" +
            fileName;

            res.json({
                success:true,
                fileUrl:publicUrl
            });

        });

        stream.end(file.buffer);

    }catch(err){

        console.error(err);
        res.status(500).json({error:"server error"});

    }

});

module.exports = router;

===== FILE: server\translator-evaluator.js (1356 bytes) =====
import admin from "firebase-admin";
import OpenAI from "openai";

const db = admin.firestore();

const openai = new OpenAI({
  apiKey: process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY
});

export async function evaluateTranslator(applicationId){

try{

const doc = await db.collection("translatorApplications")
.doc(applicationId)
.get();

if(!doc.exists){
console.log("Application not found");
return;
}

const data = doc.data();

const english = data.englishTranslation;
const french = data.frenchTranslation;

const prompt = `
You are a professional translation evaluator.

Score the translation across:

Accuracy
Grammar
Fluency
Terminology

Return JSON only with:

accuracy
grammar
fluency
terminology
overallScore

English translation:
${english}

French translation:
${french}
`;

const completion = await openai.chat.completions.create({

model:"gpt-4o-mini",

messages:[
{role:"system",content:"You evaluate translation tests."},
{role:"user",content:prompt}
],

temperature:0

});

const result = JSON.parse(completion.choices[0].message.content);

const admitted = result.overallScore >= 80;

await db.collection("translatorApplications")
.doc(applicationId)
.update({

aiEvaluation: result,

status:{
approved: admitted,
rejected: !admitted,
evaluated: true
}

});

console.log("Evaluation complete");

}catch(err){

console.error("Evaluation error:",err);

}

}


===== FILE: server\webhook.js (1032 bytes) =====
import express from "express"
import Stripe from "stripe"
import admin from "firebase-admin"

const stripe = new Stripe(process.env.STRIPE_SECRET)

const endpointSecret = process.env.STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET

admin.initializeApp({
credential: admin.credential.applicationDefault()
})

const db = admin.firestore()

const app = express()

app.post("/stripe-webhook", express.raw({type:"application/json"}), async (req,res)=>{

const sig = req.headers["stripe-signature"]

let event

try{

event = stripe.webhooks.constructEvent(
req.body,
sig,
endpointSecret
)

}catch(err){

console.log("Webhook signature error",err.message)
return res.status(400).send()

}

if(event.type === "checkout.session.completed"){

const session = event.data.object

const jobId = session.client_reference_id

console.log("Payment received for job:",jobId)

await db.collection("translationJobs")
.doc(jobId)
.update({

status:"paid",
paidAt:new Date()

})

}

res.json({received:true})

})

app.listen(3000,()=>{

console.log("Stripe webhook running")

})
